FILE Main/Features/WarOfTheRingMomentum/UI/MomentumPopupController.cs
    1: using TaleWorlds.Engine.GauntletUI;
    2: using TaleWorlds.GauntletUI.Data;
    3: using TaleWorlds.InputSystem;
    4: using TaleWorlds.ScreenSystem;
    5: 
    6: namespace TAOM.Features.WarOfTheRingMomentum.UI;
    7: 
    8: /// <summary>
    9: /// Pushes the MomentumView popup as a GauntletLayer onto the map screen (LOTRAOM
   10: /// parity source: MomentumInterface + GenericInterface, minus the AccessTools2
   11: /// reflection — LoadMovie/ReleaseMovie are public on 1.4.6). Owned by the indicator
   12: /// MapView, which also drives Escape-close via IsEscapeRequested.
   13: /// </summary>
   14: public class MomentumPopupController
   15: {
   16:     private readonly IMomentumQueryService _query;
   17: 
   18:     private GauntletLayer _layer;
   19:     private GauntletMovieIdentifier _movie;
   20:     private MomentumPopupVM _vm;
   21:     private ScreenBase _screen;
   22: 
   23:     public MomentumPopupController(IMomentumQueryService query)
   24:     {
   25:         _query = query;
   26:     }
   27: 
   28:     public bool IsOpen => _layer != null;
   29: 
   30:     /// <summary>True when the open popup's Exit hotkey (Escape) was released this frame.</summary>
   31:     public bool IsEscapeRequested => _layer != null && _layer.Input.IsHotKeyReleased("Exit");
   32: 
   33:     public void Show(ScreenBase screen)
   34:     {
   35:         if (IsOpen || screen == null)
   36:             return;
   37: 
   38:         _screen = screen;
   39:         _layer = new GauntletLayer("MomentumPopup", 209);
   40:         _layer.InputRestrictions.SetInputRestrictions();
   41:         // "Exit" (Escape) lives in GenericPanelGameKeyCategory, NOT the ...CampaignPanels...
   42:         // category (which has only window-toggle keys) — using the wrong one silently
   43:         // disables Escape-close. TAOM precedent: GauntletFiefManagementScreen.
   44:         _layer.Input.RegisterHotKeyCategory(HotKeyManager.GetCategory("GenericPanelGameKeyCategory"));
   45:         _layer.IsFocusLayer = true;
   46:         _vm = new MomentumPopupVM(_query, Close);
   47:         _movie = _layer.LoadMovie("MomentumView", _vm);
   48:         screen.AddLayer(_layer);
   49:         ScreenManager.TrySetFocus(_layer);
   50:     }
   51: 
   52:     public void Close()
   53:     {
   54:         if (!IsOpen)
   55:             return;
   56: 
   57:         _layer.InputRestrictions.ResetInputRestrictions();
   58:         ScreenManager.TryLoseFocus(_layer);
   59:         _layer.ReleaseMovie(_movie);
   60:         _screen.RemoveLayer(_layer);
   61:         _vm.OnFinalize();
   62: 
   63:         _movie = null;
   64:         _layer = null;
   65:         _vm = null;
   66:         _screen = null;
   67:     }
   68: }
FILE Main/Features/WarOfTheRingMomentum/UI/MomentumPopupVM.cs
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Linq;
    3: using TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem;
    4: using TaleWorlds.Core.ViewModelCollection.ImageIdentifiers;
    5: using TaleWorlds.Library;
    6: using TaleWorlds.Localization;
    7: using TaleWorlds.ObjectSystem;
    8: using TAOM.Features.WarOfTheRingMomentum.Domain;
    9: 
   10: namespace TAOM.Features.WarOfTheRingMomentum.UI;
   11: 
   12: /// <summary>
   13: /// Data source for MomentumView.xml (LOTRAOM parity source: MomentumVM). Property
   14: /// names Good*/Evil* are pinned by the prefab bindings — the code sides are Free/Evil.
   15: /// Computes once in the ctor AND live-recomputes on MomentumChanged while open
   16: /// (LOTRAOM only ctor-computed). Leader banners: Gondor (empire_w) vs Mordor
   17: /// (empire_s), falling back to the first enrolled kingdom of the side.
   18: /// </summary>
   19: public sealed class MomentumPopupVM : ViewModel
   20: {
   21:     private const string FreeLeaderKingdomId = "empire_w"; // Gondor
   22:     private const string EvilLeaderKingdomId = "empire_s"; // Mordor
   23: 
   24:     private static readonly MomentumActionType[] ActionTypes =
   25:         (MomentumActionType[])Enum.GetValues(typeof(MomentumActionType));
   26: 
   27:     private readonly IMomentumQueryService _query;
   28:     private readonly Action _onClose;
   29: 
   30:     public MomentumPopupVM(IMomentumQueryService query, Action onClose)
   31:     {
   32:         _query = query;
   33:         _onClose = onClose;
   34: 
   35:         GoodFactionLeader = new MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM>();
   36:         EvilFactionLeader = new MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM>();
   37:         GoodFactionParticipants = new MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM>();
   38:         GoodFactionParticipants2 = new MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM>();
   39:         EvilFactionParticipants = new MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM>();
   40:         EvilFactionParticipants2 = new MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM>();
   41:         MomentumBreakdown = new MBBindingList<BreakdownVM>();
   42:         StatsBreakdown = new MBBindingList<BreakdownVM>();
   43: 
   44:         Rebuild();
   45:         _query.MomentumChanged += Rebuild;
   46:     }
   47: 
   48:     public override void OnFinalize()
   49:     {
   50:         _query.MomentumChanged -= Rebuild;
   51:         base.OnFinalize();
   52:     }
   53: 
   54:     public void ExecuteClose() => _onClose?.Invoke();
   55: 
   56:     // ---- static labels ----
   57: 
   58:     [DataSourceProperty] public string ScreenName => new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_title}War of the Ring").ToString();
   59:     [DataSourceProperty] public string LeadersLabel => new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_leaders}Leaders").ToString();
   60:     [DataSourceProperty] public string AlliesLabel => new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_allies}Allies").ToString();
   61:     [DataSourceProperty] public string BreakdownLabel => new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_breakdown_header}Momentum Breakdown").ToString();
   62:     [DataSourceProperty] public string StatsLabel => new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_total_stats_header}Total Stats").ToString();
   63: 
   64:     // ---- live-rebuilt state ----
   65: 
   66:     [DataSourceProperty] public string Momentum { get; private set; }
   67:     [DataSourceProperty] public ImageIdentifierVM GoodAllianceVisual { get; private set; }
   68:     [DataSourceProperty] public ImageIdentifierVM EvilAllianceVisual { get; private set; }
   69:     [DataSourceProperty] public MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM> GoodFactionLeader { get; private set; }
   70:     [DataSourceProperty] public MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM> EvilFactionLeader { get; private set; }
   71:     [DataSourceProperty] public MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM> GoodFactionParticipants { get; private set; }
   72:     [DataSourceProperty] public MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM> GoodFactionParticipants2 { get; private set; }
   73:     [DataSourceProperty] public MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM> EvilFactionParticipants { get; private set; }
   74:     [DataSourceProperty] public MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM> EvilFactionParticipants2 { get; private set; }
   75:     [DataSourceProperty] public MBBindingList<BreakdownVM> MomentumBreakdown { get; private set; }
   76:     [DataSourceProperty] public MBBindingList<BreakdownVM> StatsBreakdown { get; private set; }
   77: 
   78:     private void Rebuild()
   79:     {
   80:         var total = new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_total}Total: {MOMENTUM}");
   81:         total.SetTextVariable("MOMENTUM", (int)_query.InternalMomentum);
   82:         Momentum = total.ToString();
   83:         OnPropertyChangedWithValue(Momentum, nameof(Momentum));
   84: 
   85:         RebuildLeadersAndBanners();
   86:         RebuildParticipants();
   87:         RebuildBreakdown();
   88:         RebuildStats();
   89:     }
   90: 
   91:     private void RebuildLeadersAndBanners()
   92:     {
   93:         var freeLeader = ResolveLeaderKingdom(MomentumSide.Free, FreeLeaderKingdomId);
   94:         var evilLeader = ResolveLeaderKingdom(MomentumSide.Evil, EvilLeaderKingdomId);
   95: 
   96:         GoodFactionLeader.Clear();
   97:         EvilFactionLeader.Clear();
   98:         if (freeLeader != null)
   99:             GoodFactionLeader.Add(new FactionRelationshipVM(freeLeader));
  100:         if (evilLeader != null)
  101:             EvilFactionLeader.Add(new FactionRelationshipVM(evilLeader));
  102: 
  103:         GoodAllianceVisual = new BannerImageIdentifierVM(freeLeader?.Banner, nineGrid: true);
  104:         EvilAllianceVisual = new BannerImageIdentifierVM(evilLeader?.Banner, nineGrid: true);
  105:         OnPropertyChangedWithValue(GoodAllianceVisual, nameof(GoodAllianceVisual));
  106:         OnPropertyChangedWithValue(EvilAllianceVisual, nameof(EvilAllianceVisual));
  107:     }
  108: 
  109:     private void RebuildParticipants()
  110:     {
  111:         FillSplit(GoodFactionParticipants, GoodFactionParticipants2, MomentumSide.Free);
  112:         FillSplit(EvilFactionParticipants, EvilFactionParticipants2, MomentumSide.Evil);
  113:     }
  114: 
  115:     private void FillSplit(MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM> row1,
  116:         MBBindingList<FactionRelationshipVM> row2, MomentumSide side)
  117:     {
  118:         row1.Clear();
  119:         row2.Clear();
  120: 
  121:         var kingdoms = _query.GetKingdomIds(side)
  122:             .Select(ResolveKingdom)
  123:             .Where(k => k != null)
  124:             .ToList();
  125: 
  126:         // LOTRAOM parity: even indices → row 1, odd → row 2.
  127:         for (int i = 0; i < kingdoms.Count; i++)
  128:         {
  129:             (i % 2 == 0 ? row1 : row2).Add(new FactionRelationshipVM(kingdoms[i]));
  130:         }
  131:     }
  132: 
  133:     private void RebuildBreakdown()
  134:     {
  135:         MomentumBreakdown.Clear();
  136:         foreach (MomentumActionType type in ActionTypes)
  137:         {
  138:             MomentumBreakdown.Add(new BreakdownVM(
  139:                 ActionTypeLabel(type),
  140:                 _query.GetEvents(MomentumSide.Free, type),
  141:                 _query.GetEvents(MomentumSide.Evil, type)));
  142:         }
  143:     }
  144: 
  145:     private void RebuildStats()
  146:     {
  147:         var free = _query.GetTotalStats(MomentumSide.Free);
  148:         var evil = _query.GetTotalStats(MomentumSide.Evil);
  149: 
  150:         StatsBreakdown.Clear();
  151:         StatsBreakdown.Add(new BreakdownVM(
  152:             new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_enemies_killed}Enemies Killed").ToString(),
  153:             free.TotalKills.ToString(), evil.TotalKills.ToString()));
  154:         StatsBreakdown.Add(new BreakdownVM(
  155:             new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_settlements_captured}Settlements Captured").ToString(),
  156:             free.TotalSettlementsCaptured.ToString(), evil.TotalSettlementsCaptured.ToString()));
  157:         StatsBreakdown.Add(new BreakdownVM(
  158:             new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_villages_raided}Villages Raided").ToString(),
  159:             free.TotalVillagesRaided.ToString(), evil.TotalVillagesRaided.ToString()));
  160:     }
  161: 
  162:     private static string ActionTypeLabel(MomentumActionType type)
  163:     {
  164:         switch (type)
  165:         {
  166:             case MomentumActionType.BattleWon:
  167:                 return new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_battles_won}Battles Won").ToString();
  168:             case MomentumActionType.VillageRaided:
  169:                 return new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_villages_raided}Villages Raided").ToString();
  170:             case MomentumActionType.Sieges:
  171:                 return new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_fiefs_captured}Fiefs Captured").ToString();
  172:             case MomentumActionType.ArmyGathered:
  173:                 return new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_army_gathered}Armies Gathered").ToString();
  174:             case MomentumActionType.RelativeStrength:
  175:                 return new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_relative_strength}Relative Strength").ToString();
  176:             default:
  177:                 return "";
  178:         }
  179:     }
  180: 
  181:     private Kingdom ResolveLeaderKingdom(MomentumSide side, string preferredId)
  182:     {
  183:         var preferred = ResolveKingdom(preferredId);
  184:         if (preferred != null)
  185:             return preferred;
  186: 
  187:         return _query.GetKingdomIds(side).Select(ResolveKingdom).FirstOrDefault(k => k != null);
  188:     }
  189: 
  190:     private static Kingdom ResolveKingdom(string kingdomId)
  191:     {
  192:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(kingdomId))
  193:             return null;
  194:         return MBObjectManager.Instance?.GetObject<Kingdom>(kingdomId);
  195:     }
  196: }

    1: using System.Collections.Generic;
    2: using System.Linq;
    3: using TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem;
    4: using TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.ViewModelCollection;
    5: using TaleWorlds.Core.ViewModelCollection.Information;
    6: using TaleWorlds.Library;
    7: using TaleWorlds.Localization;
    8: using TAOM.Features.WarOfTheRingMomentum.Domain;
    9: 
   10: namespace TAOM.Features.WarOfTheRingMomentum.UI;
   11: 
   12: /// <summary>
   13: /// One three-column row (Free value | label | Evil value). Momentum rows carry
   14: /// accumulating tooltips listing each contributing event; stats rows are plain.
   15: /// Values render at internal scale (raw ÷ 100).
   16: /// </summary>
   17: public class BreakdownVM : ViewModel
   18: {
   19:     [DataSourceProperty] public string Text { get; set; }
   20:     [DataSourceProperty] public string Number1 { get; set; }
   21:     [DataSourceProperty] public string Number2 { get; set; }
   22:     [DataSourceProperty] public BasicTooltipViewModel ValueFaction1 { get; set; }
   23:     [DataSourceProperty] public BasicTooltipViewModel ValueFaction2 { get; set; }
   24: 
   25:     /// <summary>Momentum row: per-side event lists → summed values + tooltip breakdown.</summary>
   26:     public BreakdownVM(string label, IReadOnlyList<MomentumEvent> freeEvents, IReadOnlyList<MomentumEvent> evilEvents)
   27:     {
   28:         Text = label;
   29: 
   30:         var freeExplained = BuildExplained(freeEvents);
   31:         var evilExplained = BuildExplained(evilEvents);
   32:         Number1 = ((int)freeExplained.ResultNumber).ToString();
   33:         Number2 = ((int)evilExplained.ResultNumber).ToString();
   34:         ValueFaction1 = new BasicTooltipViewModel(() => GetExplainerTooltip(freeEvents));
   35:         ValueFaction2 = new BasicTooltipViewModel(() => GetExplainerTooltip(evilEvents));
   36:     }
   37: 
   38:     /// <summary>Stats row: plain numbers, no tooltip.</summary>
   39:     public BreakdownVM(string label, string freeValue, string evilValue)
   40:     {
   41:         Text = label;
   42:         Number1 = freeValue;
   43:         Number2 = evilValue;
   44:     }
   45: 
   46:     private static ExplainedNumber BuildExplained(IReadOnlyList<MomentumEvent> events)
   47:     {
   48:         var explained = new ExplainedNumber(0f, includeDescriptions: true);
   49:         foreach (var ev in events)
   50:             explained.Add(ev.Value / (float)MomentumWarState.MomentumScale, new TextObject(ev.Description));
   51:         return explained;
   52:     }
   53: 
   54:     private static List<TooltipProperty> GetExplainerTooltip(IReadOnlyList<MomentumEvent> events)
   55:     {
   56:         var explained = BuildExplained(events);
   57:         return CampaignUIHelper.GetTooltipForAccumulatingPropertyWithResult(
   58:             new TextObject("{=taom_wotr_momentum}Momentum").ToString(),
   59:             explained.ResultNumber, ref explained);
   60:     }
   61: }

FILE docs/features/war-of-the-ring.md
    1: # War of the Ring System
    2: 
    3: ## Overview
    4: 
    5: The War of the Ring system creates a scripted, phased escalation into total war between the Free Peoples and Dark Powers of Middle-earth. Once activated, hostile kingdoms are permanently locked in conflict — no peace treaties, no truces, no diplomacy.
    6: 
    7: ## Why This Exists
    8: 
    9: Vanilla Bannerlord allows kingdoms to freely make peace, which breaks the LOTR narrative. Mordor shouldn't negotiate a truce with Gondor mid-campaign. The War of the Ring is an inevitable, permanent conflict that defines the Third Age.
   10: 
   11: Key design goals:
   12: - **Phased escalation** — Isengard strikes first (lore-accurate), then the full war erupts
   13: - **Configurable timing** — adjustable via MCM or JSON for testing and balance
   14: - **Southern free-for-all** — Harad, Umbar, Khand, and Easterlings can still fight each other freely; they're vassals of convenience, not permanent allies
   15: - **Peace blocking** — Once the full war starts, hostile kingdoms cannot make peace through any mechanism
   16: 
   17: ## War Phases
   18: 
   19: | Phase | Name | Trigger | Effects |
   20: |-------|------|---------|---------|
   21: | 0 | **Peace** | Game start | Normal diplomacy. Alliances and hostility tiers from `diplomacy.json` apply. |
   22: | 1 | **Isengard War** | Day 1 (configurable) | Isengard and Dunland declare war on Rohan. No peace blocking yet. |
   23: | 2 | **Full War** | Day 1 (configurable) | All `Hostile`-tier kingdom pairs go to war. Peace is permanently blocked between hostile pairs. |
   24: 
   25: ### Phase 1: The Isengard War
   26: 
   27: At the configured day (default: 1), the system declares war:
   28: - **Isengard** → **Rohan** (vlandia)
   29: - **Dunland** (empire) → **Rohan** (vlandia)
   30: 
   31: This mirrors the lore — Saruman's assault on Rohan is the opening salvo of the War of the Ring.
   32: 
   33: ### Phase 2: The Full War
   34: 
   35: At the configured day (default: 1), the system:
   36: 1. Iterates all kingdom pairs from `diplomacy.json` that have `Hostile` tier
   37: 2. Declares war between any hostile pair not already at war
   38: 3. Activates permanent peace blocking
   39: 
   40: **What gets blocked:** Any pair with `Hostile` relationship tier cannot make peace. This includes Gondor-Mordor, Rohan-Isengard, Erebor-Gundabad, all Elven kingdoms vs all evil kingdoms, etc.
   41: 
   42: **What stays free:** Southern kingdoms (Harad, Umbar, Khand) have `Natural` or `Neutral` relationships with each other. They are NOT blocked from making peace with each other. Note: Rhun (Easterlings) is now a Dark Power with Permanent alliances to Mordor, Isengard, Gundabad, and Dol Guldur — it is fully hostile to all Free Peoples and cannot make peace with them.
   43: 
   44: ## Three-Layer Peace Blocking
   45: 
   46: The system uses three independent layers to ensure peace cannot be made during the War of the Ring:
   47: 
   48: ### Layer 1: TaomDiplomacyModel (GameModel)
   49: 
   50: Overrides `DefaultDiplomacyModel.IsAtConstantWar(IFaction, IFaction)`. When WotR is active and the pair is hostile, returns `true`. The vanilla `IsPeaceDecisionAllowedBetweenKingdoms` already checks this and blocks peace proposals in the UI with "These kingdoms can not declare peace at this time."
   51: 
   52: ### Layer 2: TaomKingdomDecisionPermissionModel (GameModel)
   53: 
   54: Overrides `IsPeaceDecisionAllowedBetweenKingdoms`. When WotR blocks peace for the pair, returns `false` with the message: "The War of the Ring rages. There can be no peace."
   55: 
   56: ### Layer 3: MakePeaceAction Harmony Patch
   57: 
   58: Prefix on `MakePeaceAction.ApplyInternal` (private static method with signature `void ApplyInternal(IFaction, IFaction, int, int, MakePeaceDetail)`). Safety net that catches any peace attempt that bypasses the GameModel checks (e.g., direct API calls, other mods). Returns `false` to skip execution.
   59: 
   60: ### Verified Coverage (All Vanilla Peace Paths)
   61: 
   62: The three layers were verified against decompiled 1.3.x source to cover every vanilla peace-making path:
   63: 
   64: | Path | Blocked By |
   65: |------|-----------|
   66: | AI proposes kingdom peace decision | Layer 1 (AI checks `IsAtConstantWar` before proposing) |
   67: | Player proposes peace in kingdom menu | Layer 2 (`IsPeaceDecisionAllowed` returns false) |
   68: | AI peace offer to player (ruler accepts directly) | Layer 3 (Harmony prefix on `ApplyInternal`) |
   69: | AI peace offer to player (vassal, goes to vote) | Layer 2 (`IsAllowed()` fails) |
   70: | Clan joining kingdom triggers auto-peace | Layer 1 (checks `IsAtConstantWar` first) |
   71: | Clan leaving kingdom triggers auto-peace | Layer 1 (checks `IsAtConstantWar` first) |
   72: | Minor faction/clan AI peace | Layer 1 (checks `IsAtConstantWar`) |
   73: | Cheat console `declare_peace` | Layer 1 (checks `IsAtConstantWarAgainstFaction`) |
   74: 
   75: All paths ultimately funnel through `MakePeaceAction.ApplyInternal`, which Layer 3 catches as an absolute safety net.
   76: 
   77: ## Configuration
   78: 
   79: ### JSON: `Main/_Module/ModuleData/diplomacy/war_of_the_ring.json`
   80: 
   81: ```json
   82: {
   83:   "enabled": true,
   84:   "phase1": {
   85:     "triggerDay": 1,
   86:     "wars": [
   87:       { "attacker": "isengard", "defender": "vlandia" },
   88:       { "attacker": "empire", "defender": "vlandia" }
   89:     ]
   90:   },
   91:   "phase2": {
   92:     "triggerDay": 1,
   93:     "autoWarBetweenHostileTiers": true,
   94:     "blockPeaceBetweenHostileTiers": true,
   95:     "wars": []
   96:   },
   97:   "testMode": {
   98:     "enabled": false,
   99:     "phase1Day": 2,
  100:     "phase2Day": 5
  101:   }
  102: }
  103: ```
  104: 
  105: | Field | Description |
  106: |-------|-------------|
  107: | `enabled` | Master switch for the entire WotR system |
  108: | `phase1.triggerDay` | Days after campaign start to trigger Phase 1 |
  109: | `phase1.wars` | Explicit war declarations for Phase 1 |
  110: | `phase2.triggerDay` | Days after campaign start to trigger Phase 2 |
  111: | `phase2.autoWarBetweenHostileTiers` | If true, automatically declares war between all `Hostile` pairs from `diplomacy.json` |
  112: | `phase2.blockPeaceBetweenHostileTiers` | If true, blocks peace between `Hostile` pairs |
  113: | `testMode.enabled` | Overrides trigger days with short values for testing |
  114: 
  115: ### MCM Settings (In-Game)
  116: 
  117: The MCM options menu (via `Bannerlord.MCM.v5`) provides runtime overrides:
  118: 
  119: | Setting | Default | Description |
  120: |---------|---------|-------------|
  121: | Enable War of the Ring | true | Master toggle |
  122: | Phase 1 Start Day | 30 | Overrides JSON phase1.triggerDay |
  123: | Phase 2 Start Day | 45 | Overrides JSON phase2.triggerDay |
  124: | Enable Test Mode | false | Uses 2/5 day delays for rapid testing |
  125: 
  126: **Precedence order** (highest to lowest):
  127: 1. MCM Test Mode enabled → uses JSON `testMode.phase1Day` / `testMode.phase2Day`
  128: 2. JSON `testMode.enabled = true` → uses JSON `testMode.phase1Day` / `testMode.phase2Day`
  129: 3. MCM Phase 1/2 day values (when MCM is available)
  130: 4. JSON `phase1.triggerDay` / `phase2.triggerDay` (fallback when MCM is unavailable)
  131: 
  132: For the master enable/disable toggle: MCM `WarOfTheRingEnabled` takes precedence over JSON `enabled` when MCM is available.
  133: 
  134: JSON provides the structural data (which kingdoms fight, war declarations). MCM provides timing and toggle overrides.
  135: 
  136: ## Architecture
  137: 
  138: ### Component Diagram
  139: 
  140: ```
  141: war_of_the_ring.json     TaomSettings (MCM)
  142:          \                  /
  143:     WarOfTheRingConfig   ITaomSettingsProvider
  144:         Provider        (injected, testable)
  145:               \          /
  146:           WarOfTheRingService ←── IDiplomacyService (hostile tier lookup)
  147:              /       |       \
  148:             /        |        \
  149:     TaomDiplomacy  TaomKingdom   MakePeace
  150:     Model          DecisionModel  Patch
  151:     (IsAtConstant  (IsPeaceAllow  (Harmony
  152:      War)           ed)            prefix)
  153:             \        |        /
  154:              \       |       /
  155:           WarOfTheRingBehavior
  156:           (DailyTick — uses CampaignStartTime)
  157: ```
  158: 
  159: ### Stateless Design
  160: 
  161: The WotR system stores **no save data**. Each campaign tick:
  162: 1. Calculates elapsed campaign days via `CampaignStartTime.ElapsedDaysUntilNow` (engine-provided, survives save/load)
  163: 2. Compares against phase thresholds (from MCM or JSON config)
  164: 3. Declares wars only for pairs not already at war (`AreAtWar` guard)
  165: 4. Peace blocking checks elapsed time in real-time
  166: 
  167: The behavior uses the engine's built-in `Campaign.Current.Models.CampaignTimeModel.CampaignStartTime.ElapsedDaysUntilNow` — the same pattern vanilla uses internally. This is computed from the persisted `MapTimeTracker` ticks and the deterministic campaign start constant. No custom `SyncData` serialization is needed, avoiding any save/load performance impact.
  168: 
  169: Benefits: MCM config changes take effect immediately on next tick. No save migration needed. Phase state is reconstructed from elapsed time on every tick, so save/load is seamless.
  170: 
  171: ### MCM Integration via ITaomSettingsProvider
  172: 
  173: MCM settings are accessed through an injected `ITaomSettingsProvider` interface rather than direct static access to `TaomSettings.Instance`. This:
  174: - Keeps the service testable (tests inject a mock with `IsAvailable = false`)
  175: - Follows the explicit-dependency-via-constructor-injection principle
  176: - Gracefully falls back to JSON config when MCM is unavailable
  177:

  179: 
  180: | File | Purpose |
  181: |------|---------|
  182: | `Main/Features/Diplomacy/Models/WarPhase.cs` | Phase enum (Peace/IsengardWar/FullWar) |
  183: | `Main/Features/Diplomacy/Models/WarOfTheRingConfig.cs` | Config data models |

  187: | `Main/Features/Diplomacy/IWarOfTheRingConfigProvider.cs` | Config loading interface |
  188: | `Main/Features/Diplomacy/WarOfTheRingConfigProvider.cs` | JSON loader |
  189: | `Main/Features/Diplomacy/ITaomSettingsProvider.cs` | MCM settings interface (testable) |

  191: | `Main/Features/Diplomacy/WarOfTheRingBehavior.cs` | DailyTick timer (uses CampaignStartTime) |

  197: 
  198: ## Dependencies
  199: 
  200: - `IDiplomacyService` — Relationship tier lookups (determines which pairs are "Hostile")
  201: - `IAllianceAdapter` — War declaration and war-status checks
  202: - `ITaomSettingsProvider` — MCM settings access (injected, testable)
  203: - `IPathService` / `IModLogger` — Standard infrastructure
  204: 
  205: ## Relationship to Diplomacy Feature
  206: 
  207: The WotR system **extends** the existing Diplomacy feature, not replaces it:
  208: - It uses the same `diplomacy.json` relationship tiers (Hostile pairs become war targets)
  209: - It reuses `IAllianceAdapter` for war declarations
  210: - `TaomKingdomDecisionPermissionModel` now serves both alliance blocking AND peace blocking
  211: - `DiplomacyIoC` registers all WotR services alongside diplomacy services
  212: 
  213: ## Tests
  214: 
  215: - `TAOM.Tests/Features/Diplomacy/WarOfTheRingServiceTests.cs` — 15 tests covering phase transitions, war declarations, peace blocking, test mode, idempotent re-checks
  216: - `TAOM.Tests/Features/Diplomacy/PeaceActionHookTests.cs` — 3 tests for hook behavior
  217: 
  218: ## How to Test In-Game
  219: 
  220: 1. Set `testMode.enabled = true` in `war_of_the_ring.json` (or enable Test Mode in MCM)
  221: 2. Start a new campaign
  222: 3. Phase 1 triggers on Day 2 — check Rohan is at war with Isengard and Dunland
  223: 4. Phase 2 triggers on Day 5 — check all hostile pairs are at war, peace proposals blocked
  224: 5. Verify Harad/Umbar/Khand can still make peace with each other (Rhun cannot — it's a Dark Power)
  225: 
  226: ## How to Add New War Phases
  227: 
  228: 1. Add a new `PhaseConfig` to `WarOfTheRingConfig`
  229: 2. Add a new `WarPhase` enum value
  230: 3. Add transition logic in `WarOfTheRingService.CheckPhaseTransition`
  231: 4. Update tests

  277:     protected override void OnBeforeInitialModuleScreenSetAsRoot()
  278:     {
  279:         base.OnBeforeInitialModuleScreenSetAsRoot();
  280:         IoC.Resolve<IMainMenuCustomizerService>().CustomizeMenu();
  281: 
  282:         // Patch55_BasicTableauRaceGuard — MUST be applied HERE, not in OnGameInitializationFinished.
  283:         // The Save/Load hero preview (BasicCharacterTableau) renders on the COLD main menu, before any
  284:         // game-init callback fires. The sibling CharacterTableau patches live in Patch2_RefreshTableau,
  285:         // applied in OnGameInitializationFinished (campaign init) — too late to guard the save-list CTD
  286:         // (Codex C1, issue #299). By here, IoC.Configure() (OnSubModuleLoad) has already set the guard,
  287:         // and the initial module screen has not been pushed yet, so the prefix attaches before the save
  288:         // list can render. Process-static one-shot; fail-open (a missing guard is no worse than vanilla).
  289:         if (!_basicTableauGuardApplied)
  290:         {
  291:             _basicTableauGuardApplied = true;
  292:             try
  293:             {
  294:                 _harmony.PatchCategory("Patch55_BasicTableauRaceGuard");
  295:             }
  296:             catch (System.Exception ex)
  297:             {
  298:                 IoC.Resolve<IModLogger>().LogError($"[HeroRace] Patch55_BasicTableauRaceGuard apply failed: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}");
  299:             }
  300:         }
  301: 
  302:         // BattleLoadDiagnostics collection: a battle/scene load that hung last session left
  303:         // an inflight marker (phase-4 wrote it; phase-6/end never ran to clear it). If it
  304:         // survived to this main menu, the previous load never finished — surface a notice so
  305:         // the player knows to send the diagnostic log. See docs/features/battle-load-diagnostics.md.
  306:         try
  307:         {
  308:             var stallMarker = IoC.Resolve<Features.BattleLoadDiagnostics.IBattleLoadStallMarker>();
  309:             var stale = stallMarker?.TryConsumeStaleMarker();
  310:             if (stale != null)
  311:                 Features.BattleLoadDiagnostics.StallReportNotifier.Notify(stale);
  312:         }
  313:         catch { /* never block the main menu over a diagnostic */ }
  314: 
  315:         // NativeSkinFixes — three native MinHook detours that fix engine bugs
  316:         // TaleWorlds won't: covers_head morph freeze, hair cloth orphan, beard
  317:         // cloth orphan. Loads TAOM.NativeSkinFixes.dll from Main/_Module/bin
  318:         // and pattern-scans TaleWorlds.Native.dll for the hook targets at
  319:         // install time. Failure is logged and the game continues vanilla — no
  320:         // crash, no NRE. See docs/features/native-skin-fixes.md.
  321:         //
  322:         // GATED OFF BY DEFAULT (MCM "Native Skin Fixes → Enable Native Skin
  323:         // Fixes"). These hooks write to hardcoded offsets inside the native
  324:         // engine DLL; a pattern/offset mismatch for the installed game build
  325:         // corrupts memory (the 2026-06-30 infinite-load / battle CTD). The gate
  326:         // is fail-closed: if MCM isn't available this early, Instance is null
  327:         // and we skip install. Opt in only once the byte patterns are authored
  328:         // + verified for the installed build.
  329:         bool nsfEnabled = false;
  330:         try { nsfEnabled = TaomSettings.Instance?.EnableNativeSkinFixes == true; }
  331:         catch { /* MCM not ready — fail closed */ }
  332:         if (nsfEnabled)
  333:             NativeSkinFixesInstaller.Install(IoC.Resolve<IModLogger>());
  334:         else
  335:             IoC.Resolve<IModLogger>().LogInfo(
  336:                 "[NativeSkinFixes] disabled (MCM 'Enable Native Skin Fixes' is off) — engine rendering is vanilla");
  337: 
  338:         // Pre-compile Shaders — RE-ENABLED 2026-06-17 (issue #287). Walks the all-characters battle
  339:         // (character/equipment shaders) then each TAOM battle scene (terrain + forced-atmosphere
  340:         // shaders — the d3dcompiler battle-load CTD class). Drives ShaderPrecompileRunner; progress
  341:         // shows on the loading screen + a 1 Hz status toast. See docs/features/shader-precompilation.md.
  342:         if (Module.CurrentModule.GetInitialStateOptionWithId("TaomPrecompileShaders") == null)
  343:         {
  344:             Module.CurrentModule.AddInitialStateOption(new InitialStateOption(
  345:                 id:                  "TaomPrecompileShaders",
  346:                 name:                new TextObject("{=taom_precompile_shaders}Pre-compile Shaders"),
  347:                 orderIndex:          100,
  348:                 action:              () => InformationManager.ShowInquiry(new InquiryData(
  349:                     "Shader Pre-compilation",
  350:                     "Loads a battle with all TAOM troops, then walks each TAOM battle scene, to " +
  351:                     "pre-compile every shader the game would otherwise compile mid-battle.\n\n" +
  352:                     "THIS TAKES A LONG TIME (1-2 hours+). Leave it running — progress shows on the " +
  353:                     "loading screen and as a status line. One-time process; it eliminates in-game " +
  354:                     "stutter and the intermittent battle-load crash/hang.\n\n" +
  355:                     "When you see 'Shader pre-compilation COMPLETE', you can play.",
  356:                     true, true, "Start", "Cancel",
  357:                     () =>
  358:                     {
  359:                         _shaderTickAccumulator = 0f;
  360:                         _shaderRunner?.Begin();
  361:                     },
  362:                     () => InformationManager.HideInquiry())),
  363:                 isDisabledAndReason: () => (false, new TextObject("")),
  364:                 enabledHint:         new TextObject("{=taom_precompile_hint}Pre-compiles shaders to eliminate in-game stutter + the battle-load crash. Run once after installing TAOM."),
  365:                 // Hidden live when the MCM master toggle is off (no relaunch needed). Defaults to shown
  366:                 // if settings aren't resolvable yet. The "Include Scene Passes" toggle is read inside Begin().
  367:                 isHidden:            () => !(Features.TaomSettings.Instance?.EnableShaderPrecompilation ?? true)));
  368:         }
  369:     }

  371:     protected override void OnGameStart(Game game, IGameStarter gameStarterObject)
  372:     {
  373:         base.OnGameStart(game, gameStarterObject);
  374: 
  375:         // Session-level diagnostic snapshot: OS / CLR / mod list / mod-stack
  376:         // assembly versions / campaign context. Runs once per session and is
  377:         // idempotent so OnGameStart on save-load doesn't spam.
  378:         try
  379:         {
  380:             IoC.Resolve<Features.MissionDiagnostic.IMissionDiagnosticService>()?.LogSessionSnapshot();
  381:         }
  382:         catch { /* diagnostic is best-effort, never break OnGameStart */ }
  383: 
  384:         if (gameStarterObject is CampaignGameStarter campaignStarter)
  385:         {
  386:             // Registration order is preserved exactly from the pre-extraction inline block:
  387:             // vanilla-behavior removals precede their TAOM replacements, and the LotrIssues suppression
  388:             // must run inside this OnGameStart (after Sandbox registered its behaviors) — so the
  389:             // groups below are invoked in the original statement order.
  390:             // Phase 9b #173 — careerPassives resolved once for the whole CulturalFeats + CareerSystem
  391:             // + TroopProgression model registration block. Replaces all CareerPassiveHelper static
  392:             // calls with instance-injected ICareerPassiveService.
  393:             var careerPassives = IoC.Resolve<TAOM.Features.CareerSystem.ICareerPassiveService>();
  394:             // Hoisted: TaomVolunteerModel consumes ICulturalFeatsService for the village
  395:             // volunteer-respawn-rate feats (Dunland/Gundabad/Dol Guldur/Mordor); the cultural-feat
  396:             // model group reuses this same reference.
  397:             var culturalFeats = IoC.Resolve<TAOM.Features.CulturalFeats.ICulturalFeatsService>();
  398: 
  399:             RegisterProgressionAndIdentity(campaignStarter, careerPassives, culturalFeats);
  400:             RegisterRaceAgeAndFamily(campaignStarter);
  401:             RegisterDiplomacyAndConflict(campaignStarter);
  402:             RegisterCulturalFeatModels(campaignStarter, culturalFeats, careerPassives);
  403:             RegisterBattleBalanceAndTargeting(campaignStarter);
  404:             RegisterSpecialResourcesAndCareers(campaignStarter, careerPassives);
  405:             RegisterCampaignLifeBehaviors(campaignStarter);
  406:         }
  407:     }

  415:     {
  416:         var racePersistenceService = IoC.Resolve<IRacePersistenceService>();
  417:         campaignStarter.AddBehavior(new RacePersistenceBehavior(racePersistenceService));
  418: 
  419:         var bannerInjectionService = IoC.Resolve<IBannerInjectionService>();
  420:         var bannerExclusionService = IoC.Resolve<IBannerExclusionService>();
  421:         campaignStarter.AddBehavior(new BannerInjectionBehavior(bannerInjectionService, bannerExclusionService));
  422: 
  423:         var ccContentService = IoC.Resolve<ICharacterCreationContentService>();
  424:         var ccLogger = IoC.Resolve<IModLogger>();
  425:         campaignStarter.AddBehavior(new CharacterCreationRegistrationBehavior(ccContentService, ccLogger));
  426:

  428:         var childGenService = IoC.Resolve<IInitialChildGenerationService>();
  429:         campaignStarter.AddBehavior(new TaomInitialChildGenerationBehavior(childGenService));
  430: 
  431:         var costService = IoC.Resolve<ITroopCostService>();
  432:         // Phase 9b #180 / partial #148 — IWageModifierService extraction. Hoists garrison-wage
  433:         // feat loop + Mordor/Gundabad/Umbar party-wage feats + Rohan mounted-wage scaling +
  434:         // recruitment-cost feats out of the model body, satisfying gamemodels.md rule 4.
  435:         var wageModifiers = IoC.Resolve<IWageModifierService>();
  436:         var volunteerService = IoC.Resolve<IVolunteerTierService>();
  437:         var recruitmentService = IoC.Resolve<IVolunteerRecruitmentService>();

  439:         var recruitmentAlignment = IoC.Resolve<TAOM.Features.AlignmentRecruitment.IRecruitmentAlignmentService>();
  440:         campaignStarter.AddModel(new TaomCharacterStatsModel());
  441:         campaignStarter.AddModel(new TaomPartyWageModel(costService, careerPassives, wageModifiers));
  442:         campaignStarter.AddModel(new TaomVolunteerModel(volunteerService, recruitmentService, volunteerContextAdapter, culturalFeats, recruitmentAlignment));
  443: 
  444:         // NavalTravel — PARKED 2026-06-26: TAOM_Map's navmesh isn't set up to take advantage of naval
  445:         // travel (no naval region navmesh → AI can't route at sea; #296/#120), so the feature is disabled
  446:         // at the wiring level — registering nothing keeps vanilla DefaultPartyNavigationModel + vanilla
  447:         // navmesh regardless of any persisted MCM toggle. All code/tests/fixes are preserved for re-enable.
  448:         // RE-ENABLE: uncomment this model registration + the Patch54/Patch57 blocks in
  449:         // OnGameInitializationFinished, and flip the `enabled` defaults back to true.
  450:         // campaignStarter.AddModel(new TaomPartyNavigationModel(IoC.Resolve<INavalTravelService>(), IoC.Resolve<IModLogger>()));
  451:     }

  546:     // Special-resource economy + the career system (behaviors, quests, and career GameModels).
  547:     private static void RegisterSpecialResourcesAndCareers(
  548:         CampaignGameStarter campaignStarter,
  549:         ICareerPassiveService careerPassives)
  550:     {
  551:         var specialResourceService = IoC.Resolve<ISpecialResourceService>();
  552:         var specialResourceStorage = IoC.Resolve<ISpecialResourceStorageService>();
  553:         var specialResourceConfig = IoC.Resolve<ISpecialResourceConfigProvider>();
  554:         var specialResourceLogger = IoC.Resolve<IModLogger>();
  555:         var specialResourceBehavior = new SpecialResourcesBehavior(
  556:             specialResourceService, specialResourceStorage, specialResourceConfig, specialResourceLogger);
  557:         campaignStarter.AddBehavior(specialResourceBehavior);
  558:         PartyScreenLogic_AddCommand_Patch.SetBehavior(specialResourceBehavior);
  559: 
  560:         // TEMPORARY: troop-count diagnostic (special-currency undercount investigation). Dumps the
  561:         // main party's raw + weighted counts to the log on party-screen open. Remove with the behavior.
  562:         campaignStarter.AddBehavior(IoC.Resolve<TroopCountDiagnosticsBehavior>());
  563: 
  564:         var careerDataService = IoC.Resolve<ICareerDataService>();
  565:         var careerRegistry = IoC.Resolve<ICareerRegistry>();
  566:         var careerPassiveService = IoC.Resolve<ICareerPassiveService>();
  567:         var careerLogger = IoC.Resolve<IModLogger>();
  568:         campaignStarter.AddBehavior(new CareerPersistenceBehavior(careerDataService, careerLogger));
  569:         var careerCreationHandler = IoC.Resolve<ICareerCreationHandler>();
  570:         var careerAbilityServiceForBehavior = IoC.Resolve<Features.CareerSystem.Abilities.ICareerAbilityService>();
  571:         campaignStarter.AddBehavior(new CareerCampaignBehavior(
  572:             careerDataService, careerRegistry, careerPassiveService, careerCreationHandler, careerAbilityServiceForBehavior, careerLogger));
  573: 
  574:         var careerAdapterFactory = IoC.Resolve<ICareerHeroAdapterFactory>();
  575:         // CareerSwitchDialogueBehavior used to take ICareerSwitchService too; that dependency
  576:         // moved to GauntletCareerScreen.OnChooseSwitchTarget (Codex Review #32 cleanup).
  577:         campaignStarter.AddBehavior(new CareerSwitchDialogueBehavior(
  578:             careerDataService, careerRegistry, careerAdapterFactory, careerLogger));
  579: 
  580:         // Career-tied quest system (Phase 6) — offers/starts tier quests; CareerQuest : QuestBase
  581:         // is registered for saving by the auto-discovered CareerQuestSaveableTypeDefiner.

  644:

  844:         // CancelStanceOnMove) only once Mission.Current is non-null — MovementOrder's
  845:         // type initializer constructs static fields whose ctor reads
  846:         // Mission.Current.CurrentTime. Applying earlier crashes JIT prep with NRE.

  868: 
  869:         // MissionDiagnostic: added LAST so it sees all behaviors added by TAOM AND
  870:         // every other mod in the load chain. Dumps MissionBehaviors + MissionLogics
  871:         // on first OnMissionTick to taom_debug_*.log so user-uploaded crash logs
  872:         // contain enough data to identify mod-conflict bugs (BehaviorType=Logic +
  873:         // !MissionLogic null-cast offenders) and action-set anomalies.
  874:         var diagSvc = IoC.Resolve<Features.MissionDiagnostic.IMissionDiagnosticService>();

  881:         // the loading window so the stall watchdog stands down and phase-5 stops logging.
  882:         var battleLoadDiagSvc = IoC.Resolve<Features.BattleLoadDiagnostics.IBattleLoadDiagnosticsService>();

  885:                 battleLoadDiagSvc, IoC.Resolve<Features.BattleLoadDiagnostics.IBattleLoadStallMarker>()));
  886:

  888:         // TaomDevTriggerException on the next OnMissionTick when the player flips
  889:         // "Throw On Next Mission Tick". QA only — no-op in normal play.
  890:         mission.AddMissionBehavior(new Features.CrashReport.DevTriggers.CrashReportDevTriggerMissionBehavior());
  891: 
  892:         var careerAbilityService = IoC.Resolve<Features.CareerSystem.Abilities.ICareerAbilityService>();
  893:         if (careerAbilityService != null && Campaign.Current != null)
  894:         {

  896:                 IoC.Resolve<ICareerDataService>(),

  899:                 IoC.Resolve<Features.CareerSystem.UI.IAbilityHudController>(),
  900:                 IoC.Resolve<Features.CareerSystem.Abilities.IAbilityEffectExecutor>(),
  901:                 IoC.Resolve<Features.CareerSystem.ICareerPassiveService>(),
  902:                 IoC.Resolve<IModLogger>()));
  903:         }

  906:     protected override void OnApplicationTick(float dt)
  907:     {
  908:         _timeAccelerationService?.OnTick();
  909: 
  910:         // Shader pre-compilation walk: tick the runner every frame (responsive state transitions),
  911:         // and surface its status as a 1 Hz toast when a loading screen isn't already showing it.
  912:         var runner = _shaderRunner;
  913:         if (runner != null && runner.IsActive)
  914:         {
  915:             runner.Tick();
  916:             _shaderTickAccumulator += dt;
  917:             if (_shaderTickAccumulator >= 1f)
  918:             {
  919:                 _shaderTickAccumulator = 0f;
  920:                 if (!LoadingWindow.IsLoadingWindowActive && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(runner.StatusLine))
  921:                     InformationManager.DisplayMessage(new InformationMessage(runner.StatusLine));
  922:             }
  923:         }
  924:     }
  925: 
  926:     protected override void OnSubModuleUnloaded()
  927:     {
  928:         base.OnSubModuleUnloaded();
  929:         // Detach the AppDomain.UnhandledException subscription BEFORE IoC disposal so
  930:         // the hook doesn't hold a stale reference to a disposed CrashReportService
  931:         // across game-restart-in-same-process. Deep-review INC 3 (2026-05-25).
  932:         try { IoC.Resolve<TAOM.Features.CrashReport.Hooks.AppDomainExceptionHook>()?.Unsubscribe(); }
  933:         catch { /* IoC may already be torn down — best-effort */ }
  934: 
  935:         // Reverse NativeSkinFixes hooks so DLL unload during reload-in-same-process
  936:         // doesn't leave dangling MinHook trampolines. Best-effort — swallows.
  937:         try { NativeSkinFixesInstaller.Uninstall(); }
  938:         catch { /* shutdown — never block */ }
  939:

   73:         };

   52:         // never decay). Pin that exact semantics.
   53:         for (int i = 0; i < MomentumSideData.MaxEventsPerType; i++)
   54:             _sut.AddEvent(Event(1));
   55:         Assert.AreEqual(100, _sut.SideMomentum);

   58:

   68:             _sut.AddEvent(Event(1));

   45:     /// <summary>+500 internal = +50000 raw.</summary>

FILE Main/Features/Execution/AlignmentService.cs
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using TAOM.Core.Logging;
    4: 
    5: namespace TAOM.Features.Execution;
    6: 
    7: public class AlignmentService : IAlignmentService
    8: {
    9:     private readonly Dictionary<string, FactionSide> _kingdomSides;
   10: 
   11:     public AlignmentService(IAlignmentConfigProvider configProvider, IModLogger logger)
   12:     {
   13:         _kingdomSides = new Dictionary<string, FactionSide>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   14: 
   15:         var alignments = configProvider.LoadAlignments();
   16:         foreach (var kvp in alignments)
   17:         {
   18:             if (Enum.TryParse<FactionSide>(kvp.Value, ignoreCase: true, out var side))
   19:             {
   20:                 _kingdomSides[kvp.Key] = side;
   21:             }
   22:             else
   23:             {
   24:                 logger.LogWarning($"AlignmentService: Unknown side '{kvp.Value}' for kingdom '{kvp.Key}', defaulting to Neutral");
   25:                 _kingdomSides[kvp.Key] = FactionSide.Neutral;
   26:             }
   27:         }
   28: 
   29:         logger.LogInfo($"AlignmentService: Loaded {_kingdomSides.Count} kingdom alignments");
   30:     }
   31: 
   32:     public FactionSide GetKingdomSide(string kingdomId) => GetSide(kingdomId);
   33: 
   34:     public FactionSide GetCultureSide(string cultureId) => GetSide(cultureId);
   35: 
   36:     private FactionSide GetSide(string id)
   37:     {
   38:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
   39:             return FactionSide.Neutral;
   40: 
   41:         return _kingdomSides.TryGetValue(id, out var side) ? side : FactionSide.Neutral;
   42:     }
   43: 
   44:     public bool AreEnemyAlignments(string kingdomIdA, string kingdomIdB)
   45:     {
   46:         var sideA = GetKingdomSide(kingdomIdA);
   47:         var sideB = GetKingdomSide(kingdomIdB);
   48: 
   49:         if (sideA == FactionSide.Neutral || sideB == FactionSide.Neutral)
   50:             return true;
   51: 
   52:         return sideA != sideB;
   53:     }
   54: 
   55:     public bool AreSameAlignment(string kingdomIdA, string kingdomIdB)
   56:     {
   57:         var sideA = GetKingdomSide(kingdomIdA);
   58:         var sideB = GetKingdomSide(kingdomIdB);
   59: 
   60:         if (sideA == FactionSide.Neutral || sideB == FactionSide.Neutral)
   61:             return false;
   62: 
   63:         return sideA == sideB;
   64:     }
   65: }
FILE Main/Features/Execution/AlignmentConfigProvider.cs
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.IO;
    4: using Newtonsoft.Json;
    5: using TAOM.Core.Infrastructure;
    6: using TAOM.Core.Logging;
    7: 
    8: namespace TAOM.Features.Execution;
    9: 
   10: public class AlignmentConfigProvider : IAlignmentConfigProvider
   11: {
   12:     private readonly IPathService _pathService;
   13:     private readonly IModLogger _logger;
   14: 
   15:     public AlignmentConfigProvider(IPathService pathService, IModLogger logger)
   16:     {
   17:         _pathService = pathService;
   18:         _logger = logger;
   19:     }
   20: 
   21:     public Dictionary<string, string> LoadAlignments()
   22:     {
   23:         var path = Path.Combine(_pathService.ModuleDataPath, "execution", "alignment.json");
   24: 
   25:         if (!File.Exists(path))
   26:         {
   27:             _logger.LogWarning($"AlignmentConfigProvider: alignment.json not found: {path}");
   28:             return new Dictionary<string, string>();
   29:         }
   30: 
   31:         try
   32:         {
   33:             var json = File.ReadAllText(path);
   34:             var alignments = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<Dictionary<string, string>>(json);
   35:             _logger.LogInfo($"Loaded {alignments.Count} kingdom alignments");
   36:             return alignments;
   37:         }
   38:         catch (Exception ex)
   39:         {
   40:             _logger.LogError($"AlignmentConfigProvider: Failed to parse alignment.json: {ex.Message}");
   41:             return new Dictionary<string, string>();
   42:         }
   43:     }
   44: }

C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:34:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_dead_3_1}A Haradrim warlord who led the desert cavalry at the Battle of the Black Gate. He fell to Gondorian arrows but is revered as a martyr in the south.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:77:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_1}Brenin Wulf rules the wild clans of Dunland with an iron fist. Known as the Ironhand, he united the scattered hill tribes through conquest and cunning. He dreams of reclaiming the lands taken by the Horse-lords of Rohan.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:104:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_411}Grimwulf Ironfang carries on his father's legacy of raiding and warfare against Rohan.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:546:<!-- ======================= KINGDOM 1: GONDOR (Empire West) ======================= -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:551:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_7}Denethor II, Steward of Gondor, rules from the White Tower of Minas Tirith. Once a man of great wisdom, he has grown proud and unyielding. He resists the return of the king, believing only he can save Gondor from the shadow of Mordor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:559:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_75}Boromir, eldest son of Denethor, is Captain-General of Gondor. A great warrior of renown, he seeks any weapon to defend his people against the darkness.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:568:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_8}Húrioneth serves the House of Húrinionath, a steadfast keeper of the lore of Gondor's stewards.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:578:<xsl:attribute name="faction">Faction.clan_empire_west_1</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:589:<xsl:attribute name="faction">Faction.clan_empire_west_2</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:606:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_9}Imrahil II, Prince of Dol Amroth, is the greatest knight of Gondor. His line carries Elvish blood, and he is said to be the fairest lord in all the realm. His Swan Knights are legendary throughout Middle-earth.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:615:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_9_5}Lothwen, Princess of Dol Amroth, has stood beside Imrahil through decades of service to Gondor. She is known for her grace and quiet wisdom.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:617:<xsl:attribute name="faction">Faction.clan_empire_west_2</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:625:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_10}Aranel, wife of Elphir, is a noble lady of Gondor known for her dignity and keen mind.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:664:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_11}Ciryandur commands the northern defenses of Gondor, a seasoned veteran of many orc raids. He is methodical and relentless in defending the borders of the realm.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:691:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_36}Ivriniel, daughter of Ciryandur, has grown up in the northern marches of Gondor and shows both her father's resilience and her mother's wisdom.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:701:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_26}Hirgon, brother of Ciryandur, serves as an errand-rider of Gondor. Swift and reliable, he carries messages between the lords of the realm.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:710:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_40}Borhador, Lord of Barahirionath, is one of the eldest lords of Gondor. His long years have given him wisdom, though his body weakens with age. His counsel is respected by all.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:719:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_40_1}Lindariel, wife of Borhador, has been the strength of their house through many long years. She is a gracious and enduring presence in Gondor's nobility.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:801:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_57_2}Imloth is daughter of Baranor, learning the ways of Gondor's nobility in the valleys of Lossarnach.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:811:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_52}Hirluin the Fair, Lord of Pinnath Gelin, leads his green-clad warriors from the hills of Gondor. He is known for his valor and loyalty to the Steward.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:895:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_71}Golasgil, Lord of Anfalas, commands the long coastline against Corsair raids. He is a weathered sea-lord who has defended Gondor's shores for decades.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:932:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_WE9_l}Duinhir, Lord of Morthond, leads his archers from the Black Root Vale to the defense of Gondor. He is a stern and capable commander.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:941:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_WE9_u}Duilin, elder son of Duinhir, leads his own company of archers and fights alongside his father in defense of Gondor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:957:<!-- ======================= KINGDOM 1: MORDOR (Empire South) ======================= -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1008:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_37}Goshank commands a regiment of Mordor orcs with cruel efficiency.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1026:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_47_1}Mina serves the dark powers of Mordor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1045:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_47_3}Colambea dwells in the darkness of Mordor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1072:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_16}The Knight of Umbar was once a lord of the Corsairs before taking the Ring.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1097:<xsl:attribute name="faction">Faction.clan_dolguldur_1</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1106:<xsl:attribute name="faction">Faction.clan_dolguldur_1</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1115:<xsl:attribute name="faction">Faction.clan_dolguldur_1</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1123:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_48_3}The Shadow of Umbar haunts the southern coasts.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1124:<xsl:attribute name="faction">Faction.clan_dolguldur_1</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1133:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_177}Khorgath serves as a high officer in the armies of Mordor, a son of Sauron raised to the muster of war. He drives his legions toward the lands of Men with the cold patience of one who knows the Eye is always watching.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1143:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_29}Herumarth, a Black Númenórean of Sauron's own blood, commands a fortress on the marches of Mordor. Cold and proud, he keeps the old Númenórean cruelty sharpened by the Shadow that sired him.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1153:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_17}Sauron the Great, Dark Lord of Mordor and Lord of the Rings, has risen again. From the black tower of Barad-dûr his Eye sweeps the lands of the West, and the legions of Gorgoroth muster beneath his banner. The Free Peoples reckoned him beaten, but the Shadow only bided its time. Now he marches to break them and bind all of Middle-earth under one dominion. Let the kings of Men despair, for the age of Sauron is come.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1161:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_18}Morgha stands at the Dark Lord's side, mistress of the inner hierarchy of Lugbúrz. Her word carries the weight of the Eye, and the captains of Mordor fear her counsel as much as Sauron's wrath.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1180:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_30}Gothmog, Lieutenant of Morgul, commands the armies of Mordor at the Pelennor Fields. A brutal and cunning Orc, he leads from the front.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1198:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_49}Skarnak leads a company of Mordor orcs, a brutal captain who claws his way up the muster by breaking those above him. The lash and the Eye are the only laws he keeps.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1226:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_30_2}Callinia serves the dark powers of Mordor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1249:<!-- whole house -> Dunland: move from clan_empire_south_4 (Mordor) to parents' clan_empire_north_8 -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1297:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_74}Bûrznak commands a regiment of Mordor orcs, a mounted captain who rides down stragglers and deserters alike.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1306:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_74_1}Zena serves the dark masters of Mordor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1316:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_54}Shagrat, Captain of Cirith Ungol, guards the pass into Mordor. He is known for his cruelty even among Orcs.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1334:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_68}Gorthak is an orc captain holding the high pass into Mordor, watchful and merciless to any who would slip past the Eye.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1363:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_1_69}Grukhash commands a fortress on the borders of Mordor, a wary keeper of the Shadow's marches.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1418:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_SE8_c}An Orc bred in the pits of Mordor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1427:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_SE9_l}A Black Numenorean lord who commands a fortress in Mordor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:1921:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_3_1}Khadurak is the Taskral of Harad, supreme commander of the southern armies. He leads the Mumakil war elephants against the enemies of his people, allied with Mordor against Gondor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:2037:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_3_5}Haldir commands the coastal Haradrim, allied with the Corsairs of Umbar.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:2056:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_3_12}Manan raids the coastal settlements of Gondor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:2369:<!-- ======================= KINGDOM 4: ROHAN (Vlandia) ======================= -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:2374:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_4_1}Theoden, King of Rohan, rules from Meduseld in Edoras. Once bewitched by Saruman's servant Grima, he was freed by Gandalf and led his people to glory at Helm's Deep and the Pelennor Fields.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:2382:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_4_2}Elfhild was queen of Rohan, mother of Theodred. She died in childbirth, a grief that shadowed Theoden's reign.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\heroes.xslt:2390:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hero_4_7}Theodred was the only son of King Theoden, Prince of Rohan. He fell defending the Fords of Isen against Saruman's Uruk-hai.</xsl:attribute>

C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:744:<xsl:attribute name="default_party_template">PartyTemplate.kingdom_hero_party_rohan_vlandia_11_template</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:871:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_ghilman_text}The Serpent Guard are mounted soldiers in the service of the Serpentlord of Near Harad. Bred in the saddle on the rolling plains south of the Ephel Dúath, they are unmatched as horse-archers in all of Middle-earth's southern lands. In times of peace between Harad and Mordor, the Guard hires its services to Haradrim lords and to any other power rich enough to afford their golden fee.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:899:<!-- Company of the Boar → Corsair Blades (Umbar ex-pirates) -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:905:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_company_text}The Corsair Blades are veteran sea-fighters from the harbours of Umbar who have taken to selling their skills on land. They fight as crossbowmen — the preferred arm of shipboard warfare — and are as comfortable in a siege as they are on a rolling deck. Their captain, a scarred Númenórean exile, keeps them to their contracts with iron discipline, knowing that their reputation is their most valuable cargo.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:930:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_wolfskins_text}The Variag Ravagers are war-bands of young Variag warriors from the steppes of Khand who spend their early manhood in a state of ritual warfare: they may own no cooked food, sleep under no permanent roof, and take no mercy. While most eventually return to the settled life of their clans, some never do, and these form the Ravagers — outlaws who prey on the roads of Khand and raid across its borders into Harad and Gondor.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:936:<!-- Brotherhood of the Woods → Dunlending Reavers (culture change: vlandia → empire) -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:949:<!-- Hidden Hand → The Mouth's Servants (Mordor intelligence network) -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:955:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_hidden_hand_text}The Mouth's Servants are the Eyes of Barad-dûr operating beyond the Black Gate — informants, enforcers, and spies embedded among the peoples bordering Mordor. Where Sauron's armies cannot yet reach, these agents collect tribute and silence dissent. They work through bribery, blackmail, and quiet murder, ensuring that no conspiracy against the Dark Lord takes root before it is uprooted and crushed.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:1004:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_karakhuzaits_text}The Wild Easterlings are the unconquered steppe clans of the Sea of Rhûn, who have resisted the authority of every lord who has tried to bring them to heel — Rhûn chieftain, Mordor lieutenant, and King of Dale alike. They range across the grasslands east of the Celduin, rounding up horses, raiding flocks, and collecting road tribute from any caravan foolish enough to cross their steppe without an armed escort.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:1148:gundabad_raiders, umbar_corsairs) and migrated all 99 TAOM_Map hideouts to
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:21:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=aom_empire_desc}The Dunlendings are a rugged and fierce people, dwelling in the wild hills and untamed lands west of Rohan. Long resentful of the Rohirrim, whom they see as invaders of their ancestral homes, the Dunlendings are united by their shared heritage and fierce independence. Skilled in guerrilla warfare and survival, they rely on cunning and ferocity to overcome their enemies. Though often dismissed as simple hill folk, the Dunlendings are a proud and enduring people, fiercely protective of their lands and ways of life. Driven by a deep-seated grudge against Rohan, they have allied themselves with the forces of darkness, seeking revenge and the restoration of their lost lands.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:107:<item id="Item.empire_sword_1_t2" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:108:<item id="Item.empire_sword_2_t3" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:109:<item id="Item.empire_sword_6_t5" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:311:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=aom_aserai_desc}The Haradrim are a proud and fierce people hailing from the deserts and savannahs of the distant south. Renowned for their mastery of exotic beasts such as mûmakil, their warriors combine skill, resilience, and deadly precision in battle. Harad is a land of extremes, with its scorching sun, golden sands, and vibrant oases. Its people are united by ancient traditions, loyalty to their tribes, and the call of their chieftains and kings. Often allied with the forces of darkness, the Haradrim are driven by vengeance against Gondor and the promise of power and dominion offered by Sauron.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:583:<!-- Rename vlandia to Rohirrim -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:584:<xsl:template match="Culture[@id='vlandia']">
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:590:<xsl:attribute name="name">{=aom_vlandia_name}Rohirrim</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:591:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=aom_vlandia_desc}The Rohirrim, or Horse-lords of Rohan, are renowned for their unmatched cavalry and deep bond with their steeds. Proud and free-spirited, they dwell in the rolling plains of the Riddermark, living in villages and strongholds like Edoras. Guided by their King and loyal to their people, the Rohirrim prize honor, loyalty, and courage. Their warriors ride fearlessly into battle, forming the backbone of Middle-earth’s resistance against the shadow. Though steadfast in their traditions, the Rohirrim are ever ready to defend their land and allies, wielding spears, swords, and shields with precision.</xsl:attribute>

C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:1260:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=TAOM_battania_desc}The Variags of Khand are a fierce and warlike people, hailing from the dry and rugged lands east of Mordor. Known for their mercenary prowess and loyalty to Sauron, the Variags fight with unmatched ferocity. They ride swift warhorses into battle, wielding curved blades and long spears with deadly precision. Their bronze and crimson armor, adorned with intricate designs, reflects their proud and martial heritage. Divided into tribes and clans, the Variags unite under powerful warlords, bringing fear and chaos to the enemies of the Dark Lord.</xsl:attribute>

C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:62:text="{{=TAOM_gondor_desc}}Gondor stands as a proud bastion of strength and resilience in Middle-earth, known for its towering white stone cities, ancient lineage, and skilled armies. Founded by Elendil and his sons after the fall of Numenor, Gondor has long guarded the realms of men against the growing darkness in the east. With Minas Tirith as its capital, the kingdom is renowned for its valor, discipline, and loyalty to the Free Peoples. While beset by years of conflict with Mordor, Gondor's warriors and Stewards have kept hope alive, awaiting the return of the king to restore its former glory.">

C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:93:ruler_title="{{=TAOM_mordor_ruler}}Dark Lord"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:94:text="{{=TAOM_mordor_desc}}Mordor is a dark, desolate realm forged in shadow and ruled by the Dark Lord Sauron. Nestled behind the towering black mountains, this kingdom brims with orc armies, ruthless trolls, and fiery forges crafting weapons of war. From his fortress in Barad-dur, Sauron commands an unstoppable force, poised to spread his dominion across Middle-earth. Mordor's skies are clouded with ash, and its lands are barren, a fitting domain for Sauron's twisted ambition and dark magic.">
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:129:kingdom="Kingdom.vlandia"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:154:text="{{=TAOM_harad_desc}}Harad, a vast and diverse region south of Gondor, encompasses arid deserts, lush jungles, and fertile oases. Its geography is as varied as its people, with sprawling dunes giving way to dense forests and rivers teeming with life. Harad's history is steeped in ancient lore, with grand cities and fortresses dotting the landscape, built by rulers whose legacies echo through the ages. The Great Desert of Haradwaith separates its northern frontier from the heartland, while its southern coasts are bustling with trade and piracy. United under the banners of Sauron, Harad's many tribes and kingdoms channel their deep-rooted traditions into their war efforts, transforming this vibrant land into a powerhouse of culture and conflict.">
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:157:kingdom="Kingdom.empire_s"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:164:<!-- Replace vlandia with Rohan -->
