C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:167:id="vlandia"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:175:culture="Culture.vlandia"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:178:name="{{=TAOM_rohan}}Rohan"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:179:short_name="{{=TAOM_rohan_short}}Rohan"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:180:title="{{=TAOM_rohan_title}}Kingdom of Rohan"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:181:ruler_title="{{=TAOM_rohan_ruler}}King"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:182:text="{{=TAOM_rohan_desc}}Known as the Riddermark, Rohan is a vast and sweeping kingdom of open plains and rolling hills, where the mighty Rohirrim—skilled horsemen and fierce warriors—dwell. Founded by Eorl the Young after his legendary ride to Gondor's aid, Rohan has long stood as a steadfast ally of Gondor against the darkness of Mordor. From the golden halls of Meduseld in Edoras, its kings rule over a proud and resilient people who live by the bond of horse and rider. The Rohirrim are famed for their cavalry charges, their songs of valor, and their unwavering courage. Though the shadow of Saruman has threatened their borders, the sons and daughters of Rohan remain ever ready to answer the call to arms, defending their homeland and the free peoples of Middle-earth.">
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:210:text="{{=TAOM_khand_desc}}Khand, a rugged land of rolling steppes and arid plains, lies southeast of Mordor and serves as a critical corridor between the east and west. Its people, the Variags, are fierce and nomadic, known for their swift horses and deadly curved blades. Living in a harsh environment, they have honed their skills as raiders and warriors, often clashing with their neighbors and serving as mercenaries for the highest bidder. Khand's allegiance has long been courted by the Dark Lord, and many of its warriors have ridden to war under the shadow of Mordor. Yet the Variags are a proud and independent people, loyal first to their clans and chieftains, who rule from fortified encampments scattered across the windswept plains.">
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:213:kingdom="Kingdom.empire_w"
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:238:text="{{=TAOM_rhun_desc}}Far beyond the Sea of Rhûn, past the withered steppes and the red dust of forgotten empires, lies the vast and veiled East. Here dwell the Easterlings, a proud and ancient people whose history predates even the rise of Gondor. Their lands stretch endlessly beneath wide skies, from the shores of the inland sea to the shadowed mountains that mark the edge of the known world. The Easterlings are no single nation, but a tapestry of tribes and kingdoms, united only in their reverence for strength and their long memory of grievance against the West. Some have served the Dark Lord willingly, drawn by promises of power and vengeance; others resist, clinging to old ways and older gods. Their warriors are feared for their discipline and their mastery of chariot and bow, and their golden armor gleams like fire beneath the eastern sun.">

C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:6:<string id="taom_career_ranger_of_ithilien_desc" text="{=taom_career_ranger_of_ithilien_desc}An elite scout who strikes from the shadows of Ithilien, ambushing enemies of Gondor with deadly precision." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:8:<string id="taom_career_captain_of_osgiliath_desc" text="{=taom_career_captain_of_osgiliath_desc}A battle-hardened infantry officer who commands Gondor's frontline defense at the ruins of Osgiliath, forging order from chaos in brutal urban combat. The Captain holds the line where others would break, rallying soldiers through sheer force of will." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:10:<string id="taom_career_knight_of_belfalas_desc" text="{=taom_career_knight_of_belfalas_desc}An armored champion of the coastal fiefdom of Belfalas, whose thundering charge has broken countless enemy formations. The Knight of Belfalas combines Gondorian discipline with Dol Amroth's proud cavalry tradition, becoming an immovable wall of steel." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:12:<string id="taom_career_black_uruk_captain_desc" text="{=taom_career_black_uruk_captain_desc}An iron-muscled champion of Mordor who leads Black Uruk warbands into the breach, absorbing punishment that would fell lesser warriors and turning the tide through sheer brutish dominance." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:16:<string id="taom_career_snaga_rider_desc" text="{=taom_career_snaga_rider_desc}A wiry Snaga cavalry raider who slips behind enemy lines with unnerving silence, striking supply columns and isolated units before vanishing into the smoke of Mordor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:24:<string id="taom_career_watchman_of_stangard_desc" text="{=taom_career_watchman_of_stangard_desc}A grizzled river-warden of Stangard who patrols the Anduin crossings by flatboat and on foot, guarding Rohan's eastern flank through endurance, local knowledge, and a boatswain's tenacious grip on contested ground." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:312:<string id="taom_buc_t1_a_p3_desc" text="{=taom_buc_t1_a_p3_desc}Your guttural roar steadies Mordor troops. +3% troop morale." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:330:<string id="taom_buc_t2_a_p2_desc" text="{=taom_buc_t2_a_p2_desc}Mordor troops fight harder under your command. +6% troop damage." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:419:<string id="taom_mc_t3_b_p1_desc" text="{=taom_mc_t3_b_p1_desc}Mordor's armies fight in Sauron's name. +12% troop damage." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:426:<string id="taom_sr_root_desc" text="{=taom_sr_root_desc}Sneak-Creeping grants +5% movement speed and lets the rider vanish into Mordor's shadow." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:428:<string id="taom_sr_t1_a_key_desc" text="{=taom_sr_t1_a_key_desc}You vanish into Mordor's dark. Sneak-Creeping radius +3." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:446:<string id="taom_sr_t1_b_p4_desc" text="{=taom_sr_t1_b_p4_desc}Riding in Mordor hardens the body. +30 health." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:466:<string id="taom_sr_t2_b_p4_desc" text="{=taom_sr_t2_b_p4_desc}Mordor leather and iron rings protect rider and beast. +40 health." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:475:<string id="taom_sr_t3_a_p4" text="{=taom_sr_t3_a_p4}Terror of Mordor" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:477:<string id="taom_sr_t3_b_key" text="{=taom_sr_t3_b_key}Mordor's Vanguard" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:482:<string id="taom_sr_t3_b_p2_desc" text="{=taom_sr_t3_b_p2_desc}Mordor's host covers ground without rest. +8% party movement speed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:536:<string id="taom_ohw_t3_a_p4" text="{=taom_ohw_t3_a_p4}Mordor's Hammer" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:545:<string id="taom_ohw_t3_b_p3_desc" text="{=taom_ohw_t3_b_p3_desc}Your deeds are sung in the dark halls of Mordor. +14% battle renown gain." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:566:<string id="taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc" text="{=taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc}You read the plains of Rohan as a book. +5% party spotting range." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:594:<string id="taom_moa_t3_a_p2_desc" text="{=taom_moa_t3_a_p2_desc}You are the finest shot in all of Rohan. +75 health." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:608:<string id="taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc" text="{=taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc}The finest bowmen of Rohan rally to your banner. +5 party size." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:624:<string id="taom_ew_t1_b_p2" text="{=taom_ew_t1_b_p2}Rohan Warband" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:637:<string id="taom_ew_t2_a_p3_desc" text="{=taom_ew_t2_a_p3_desc}The cry of Rohan heartens all who hear it. +8% troop morale." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:658:<string id="taom_ew_t3_a_p4" text="{=taom_ew_t3_a_p4}Rohan's Glory" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:9:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_1_text}Noble Houses of Gondor" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:11:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_1_desc}Your family belonged to one of Gondor's noble houses, sworn to defend the White Tree. Your father was a knight who fought bravely in service to the Steward, while your mother managed the family's lands and affairs." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:13:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_2_text}Merchants of the White City" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:15:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_2_desc}Your family were prosperous traders within Minas Tirith, dealing in fine goods and wares. Their influence within the city's merchant guilds brought wealth and respect to your household." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:17:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_3_text}Farmers of the Pelennor" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:19:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_3_desc}Your family tilled the rich soil of the Pelennor Fields, providing sustenance for Minas Tirith. They also served as levy soldiers, standing in defense of the city during times of war." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:21:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_4_text}Artisans of Minas Tirith" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:23:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_4_desc}Your family were skilled craftsmen in Minas Tirith, creating fine armor, weapons, and tapestries that adorned the halls of the White City. Their artistry was renowned across Gondor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:25:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_5_text}Rangers of Ithilien" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:27:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_5_desc}Your family were members of the Rangers of Ithilien, skilled in the arts of stealth and archery. They patrolled the wilds, protecting Gondor's borders from the forces of Mordor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:29:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_6_text}Street Urchins of Osgiliath" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:31:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_gondor_6_desc}Your family lived among the ruins of Osgiliath, surviving through cunning and resourcefulness. They scavenged what they could and occasionally served under Gondor's banners as irregular troops." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:33:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_1_text}Servants of the Dark Tower" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:35:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_1_desc}Your family served directly under the command of the Dark Tower. Your father was a brutal enforcer, while your mother worked to instill the will of Sauron among the lesser folk." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:37:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_2_text}Merchants of the Black Road" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:39:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_2_desc}Your family managed trade and supplies within Mordor, ensuring the armies of Sauron were equipped for war. Their dealings were shadowed by intrigue and violence." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:41:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_3_text}Slaves of Barad-dur" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:43:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_3_desc}Your family were enslaved laborers, toiling in the forges and quarries of Mordor to fuel the war machine of the Dark Lord. Their resilience became a testament to their will to survive." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:45:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_4_text}Orc Taskmasters" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:47:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_4_desc}Your family were tasked with overseeing the labor of Orcs and Men alike, ensuring that Sauron's orders were carried out with ruthless efficiency." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:49:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_5_text}Hunters of Gorgoroth" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:51:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_5_desc}Your family roamed the volcanic plains of Gorgoroth, hunting and tracking prey to sustain the armies of Mordor. Their skill in the wilderness was unmatched." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:53:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_6_text}Uruk Overseers" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:55:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_mordor_6_desc}Your family served as overseers for the Uruk-hai legions, enforcing discipline and maintaining order within Sauron's ranks." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:171:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc}Your family were scouts and trackers, ensuring Saruman's forces moved unseen across the plains of Rohan." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:201:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_text}Servants of the Necromancer" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:203:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_1_desc}Your family served directly under the Necromancer, performing his dark bidding and enforcing his will across the region." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:205:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_text}Crafters of Shadowed Steel" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:207:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_2_desc}Your family forged weapons and armor imbued with the dark magic of Dol Guldur, equipping its armies for conquest." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:209:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_text}Miners of the Shadowed Halls" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:211:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_3_desc}Your family labored deep within the caverns of Dol Guldur, extracting resources to feed its war machine." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:213:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_text}Warriors of the Enchanted Wood" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:215:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_4_desc}Your family were fierce warriors who fought to extend the shadow of Dol Guldur over the surrounding lands." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:217:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_text}Hunters of the Dark Forest" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:219:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_5_desc}Your family hunted the twisted creatures of the forest and tracked those who dared trespass into the Necromancer's domain." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:221:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_text}Rogues of Dol Guldur" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:223:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_dolguldur_6_desc}Your family were spies and saboteurs, spreading the influence of Dol Guldur through deception and fear." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:225:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_1_text}Corsair Captains" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:227:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_1_desc}Your family were leaders among the Corsairs of Umbar, commanding ships and raiding the coasts of Gondor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:229:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_2_text}Merchants of the Black Tide" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:231:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_2_desc}Your family conducted trade across the seas, often smuggling goods to fund the Corsairs' endeavors." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:233:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_3_text}Shipwrights of Umbar" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:235:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_3_desc}Your family constructed the vessels that carried the Corsairs to war, crafting ships of speed and stealth." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:237:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_4_text}Pirates of the Coasts" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:239:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_4_desc}Your family were Corsairs who raided the shores of Gondor and beyond, striking fear into the hearts of their enemies." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:241:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_5_text}Navigators of the High Seas" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:243:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_5_desc}Your family were skilled navigators, charting the dangerous seas and leading the Corsairs to victory." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:245:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_6_text}Smugglers of Umbar" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:247:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_umbar_6_desc}Your family moved in the shadows, smuggling goods and information vital to the survival of the Corsairs." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:273:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_text}Retainers of the Marshal" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:275:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc}Your family served the marshals of the Riddermark, riding with them in defense of Rohan's borders. Your father was a skilled horseman and warrior." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:277:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_text}Merchants of Edoras" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:279:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc}Your family were traders in the great hall-city of Edoras, bringing goods from across the Riddermark and beyond to the people of Rohan." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:281:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_3_text}Freeholders of the Westfold" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:283:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_3_desc}Your family were free farmers of the Westfold, raising horses and crops on the fertile plains. They served as mounted levy when the king called." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:285:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_4_text}Smiths of Aldburg" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:287:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_4_desc}Your family were renowned smiths in Aldburg, forging the blades and armor that equipped the Rohirrim for battle." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:289:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_5_text}Hunters of the Eastfold" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:291:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_5_desc}Your family were hunters and trackers in the Eastfold, skilled with the bow and knowledgeable in the ways of the wild." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:293:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_text}Wanderers of the Wold" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:295:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc}Your family drifted across the Wold, the wild grasslands between Rohan and the Brown Lands. They survived by their wits and occasional service as scouts." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:411:<string id="taom_cc_taom_childhood_convince_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_convince_desc}While others played, you lingered in the market, watching merchants haggle over prices and tally profits. You were fascinated by the craft of trade, often imagining yourself as a steward of Gondor or a dwarven craftsman counting gems." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:419:<string id="taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc}You felt a deep bond with animals, particularly horses. The stable hands marveled at how you could calm even the most spirited steed, and your skill in caring for wounds brought whispers that you might rival the horsemasters of Rohan one day." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:425:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_1_text}Trained with the Swan Knights." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:427:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_1_desc}You joined the ranks of the Swan Knights of Dol Amroth, learning the art of mounted combat and chivalric warfare under the banners of Gondor's finest." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:429:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_2_text}Stood guard in Minas Tirith." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:431:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_2_desc}You served in the garrison of Minas Tirith, defending the White City's walls and learning the art of siege defense from its veteran commanders." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:433:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_3_text}Rode with the Rangers of Ithilien." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:435:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_3_desc}You patrolled the wilds of Ithilien, striking at the enemy from the shadows and honing your skills as a ranger in the tradition of Faramir's company." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:437:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_4_text}Trained with the Tower Guard." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:439:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_4_desc}You joined the elite Tower Guard of Gondor, training in disciplined infantry warfare to protect the Citadel and the White Tree." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:441:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_5_text}Lived by your wits in the ruins of Osgiliath." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:443:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_gondor_5_desc}You scraped by in the contested ruins of Osgiliath, learning the lethal economy of street-fighting and the value of a well-thrown stone. Survival in that half-drowned maze of broken stone shaped you into someone who could improvise anything from nothing." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:445:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_1_text}Trained with the Warg Riders." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:447:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_1_desc}You were chosen to train with the elite Warg Riders of Mordor, learning to control the fearsome beasts and strike terror into the hearts of the enemy." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:449:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_2_text}Manned the towers of Mordor's fortresses." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:451:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_2_desc}You were stationed on the watchtowers and walls of Mordor's black fortresses, scanning the horizon for movement and directing fire on any who approached. The post suited those who could think as well as shoot." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:453:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_3_text}Rode with the Black Scouts." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:455:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_3_desc}You joined the Black Scouts, riding swiftly through the wastelands to gather intelligence and harry the enemy's flanks." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:457:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_4_text}Marched in the Orc legions of the Dark Lord." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:459:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_4_desc}You drilled in the relentless formations of Sauron's infantry, learning to shoulder-charge and cut with blade and axe in ranks that moved like a single armoured fist. Weakness was punished and strength rewarded in iron." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:461:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_5_text}Joined the Shadow Skirmishers." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:463:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_5_desc}You became a Shadow Skirmisher, harassing the enemy with thrown weapons and quick strikes before melting back into the darkness." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:465:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_6_text}Lived on the fringes of Sauron's war host." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:467:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_mordor_6_desc}You were neither soldier nor slave, moving on the shadowed margins of Mordor's great army — stealing what you could, trading information, and learning which officers were bribeable and which were better avoided. Cunning was the only currency you trusted." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:601:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_text}Served the Necromancer's riders." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:603:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_1_desc}You rode in the service of Dol Guldur, commanding dark steeds and spreading terror across the southern reaches of Mirkwood." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:605:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_text}Guarded the halls of shadow." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:607:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_2_desc}You defended the dark halls of Dol Guldur, standing watch over the Necromancer's domain with bow and blade." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:609:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_text}Trained in the dark arts of war." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:611:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_3_desc}You honed your skills in the dark arts of warfare, learning to fight with cunning and deception in the shadowed corridors of Dol Guldur." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:613:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_text}Hunted trespassers in the corrupted Greenwood." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:615:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_4_desc}You were sent into the twisted undergrowth of southern Mirkwood to track and eliminate those who strayed near the Necromancer's domain, learning to stalk quarry through corrupted forest without making a sound or leaving a print." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:617:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_text}Marched in the shadow legions of Dol Guldur." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:619:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_5_desc}You drilled in the iron-disciplined ranks of Dol Guldur's dark legions, learning to wield heavy weapons in formation as the corruption of the Necromancer's fortress settled into your stride and your silence." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:621:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_text}Moved through darkness as a courier of the Necromancer." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:623:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_dolguldur_6_desc}You carried messages through the corrupted wood that no one would write down, delivering them by hand to agents who never showed their faces. The work demanded silence, patience, and the ability to strike without warning when the shadow required it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:625:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_1_text}Served in the Corsair Fleet." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:627:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_1_desc}You joined the Corsair Fleet of Umbar, learning to fight aboard ships and lead boarding parties against Gondor's coastal defenses." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:629:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_2_text}Guarded the harbors of Umbar." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:631:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_2_desc}You served in the harbor garrisons of Umbar, defending the docks and learning the art of coastal defense." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:633:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_3_text}Raided the shores of Gondor with the Corsairs." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:635:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_3_desc}You led the charge onto enemy docks, hurling javelins and cutting your way through defenders before retreating to the Black ships with what you had taken. Raids were fast and brutal, and you learned that hesitation cost lives." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:637:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_4_text}Navigated the Bay of Belfalas as a Corsair scout." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:639:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_4_desc}You served in the masthead and scout-boats of the Corsair fleet, reading tides and spotting prey across open water while learning to loose a bow from a pitching deck. What you saw decided whether a raid went ahead or was abandoned." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:641:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_5_text}Stood in the spear line of the Black Numenoreans." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:643:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_5_desc}You drilled in the disciplined ground formations of Umbar's infantry, learning to hold a coastal beachhead with spear and shield while the ships unloaded behind you. The Black Numenorean officers expected precision, and they got it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:645:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_6_text}Ran with the outlaws of the Umbar waterfront." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:647:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_umbar_6_desc}You survived on the rough margins of the harbor city, moving goods that could not be declared and acquiring skills that could not be taught in any school. The Corsair world had a place for those clever enough to see opportunities no one else had noticed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:673:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_1_text}Trained with the Riders of the Mark." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:675:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_1_desc}You proved your skill as a rider among the Rohirrim, learning to charge with lance and fight from horseback in the traditions of Eorl the Young." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:677:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_2_text}Served in the city watch of Edoras." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:679:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_2_desc}You stood guard over the gates and walls of Edoras, learning tactics and discipline in service of the Golden Hall." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:681:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_3_text}Joined the skirmishers of the Westfold." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:683:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_3_desc}You joined the Westfold skirmishers, learning to fight with thrown weapons and sword on the open plains." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:685:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_4_text}Rode with the scouts of the Wold." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:687:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_4_desc}You rode with the scouts of the Wold, ranging far across the plains to watch for threats from the East." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:689:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_5_text}Stood among the spearmen of the Eastfold." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:691:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_5_desc}As a spearman of the Eastfold, you learned to hold the shieldwall against the enemy's charge." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:693:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text}Traveled with the camp followers of Rohan." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:695:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_desc}Rather than taking up arms directly, you traveled with the camp followers, learning to survive on the march and profit from the chaos of war." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:797:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_1_text}Drilled with the sons of noble houses." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:799:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_1_desc}You grew up training alongside the children of Gondor's noble families in the yards of Minas Tirith. You learned to fight with sword and lance under knights sworn to the Steward, and spent long hours practicing horsemanship on the Pelennor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:801:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_2_text}Apprenticed in the markets of Minas Tirith." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:803:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_2_desc}You spent your adolescence running errands and learning accounts in the tiered market halls of the White City. You quickly learned the art of the deal, flattering merchants and counting coin in the shadow of the White Tower." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:805:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_3_text}Labored in the fields of the Pelennor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:807:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_3_desc}You toiled from dawn to dusk in the rich farmland outside the city walls, hauling sheaves and driving oxen across the Pelennor. When the levy was called you were handed a spear and drilled in formation by a gruff veteran of the border wars." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:809:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_4_text}Apprenticed to an armourer of the White City." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:811:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_4_desc}You learned your craft in the smithing quarter of Minas Tirith, blowing bellows and grinding edges under a master armorer's stern eye. By the time you were grown your hands were calloused from hammer work and you could judge a blade's temper by its ring." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:813:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_5_text}Ranged the wilds of Ithilien." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:815:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_5_desc}You shadowed the Rangers of Ithilien as a youngster, learning to move without sound through the overgrown gardens east of the Anduin. You strung your first bow before you were tall enough to draw it properly and learned to read boot-prints in the mud." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:817:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_6_text}Scrounged among the ruins of Osgiliath." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:819:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_gondor_6_desc}You grew up picking through the shattered stones of Osgiliath, selling salvage to soldiers and running messages between outposts for coin. The ruined city taught you quickness and cunning — a thrown rock could drive off a man twice your size." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:821:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_1_text}Fought in the training pits of Barad-dur." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:823:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_1_desc}You were thrown into the pit-fighting yards of the Dark Tower as soon as you could hold a weapon. The older warriors showed no mercy, and you learned quickly that hesitation meant pain. Pain taught you to strike first and strike hard." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:825:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_2_text}Hauled supply trains along the Black Road." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:827:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_2_desc}You moved goods along the shadowed roads of Mordor, learning to barter and bluff your way past toll-keepers and corrupt overseers. The danger sharpened your wits, and you discovered that information was worth more than iron in the Dark Land." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:829:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_3_text}Labored in the forges of the Dark Land." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:831:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_3_desc}You hauled stone and worked bellows in the smoking forges that ringed Barad-dur, enduring heat and ash from before first light until long after dark. The work broke weaker youths, but you found a grim endurance that no taskmaster could extinguish." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:833:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_4_text}Kept order among the Orc work gangs." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:835:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_4_desc}You were given a club and a corner of the yard and told to keep the work gangs in line. You learned fast how to read a crowd and where to hit to get compliance without killing. Strategy and brutality became second nature." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:837:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_5_text}Hunted across the plains of Gorgoroth." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:839:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_5_desc}You tracked prey across the blasted volcanic flats of Gorgoroth, learning to read ash-trails and navigate by the glow of distant fires. There was little to hunt, and what little there was fought back. You came home lean and sharp-eyed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:841:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_6_text}Ran with the outcasts beyond the Black Gate." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:843:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_mordor_6_desc}You survived on the margins of the Dark Lord's realm, running with the quick-fingered bands who slipped past patrols and lived by theft and misdirection. You learned every shadow and every bribe-price in the shadow of the Morannon." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:957:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text}Scouted the plains of Rohan for Saruman's eyes." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:989:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_text}Drilled in the shadow-yards of Dol Guldur." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:991:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_1_desc}You trained in the lightless courtyards of the Necromancer's fortress, learning to fight with halberd and great blade under the eye of hooded overseers. The shadow that lay across the place seeped into your bones and sharpened your instincts for violence." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:993:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_text}Forged shadow-steel in the dark workshops." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:995:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_2_desc}You worked the black-iron forges of Dol Guldur, learning to shape weapons under conditions that would break a lesser youth. The materials were dark and the methods darker, and you left with knowledge that few would admit to having." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:997:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_text}Hauled stone in the caverns of the fortress." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:999:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_3_desc}You labored in the underground excavations of Dol Guldur, dragging blocks and shoring tunnels in the permanent darkness beneath the corrupted hill. The work was relentless, and endurance was the only currency that bought any relief." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1001:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_text}Fought in the shadow-patrols of the Enchanted Wood." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1003:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_4_desc}You ran with the dark patrols that pushed the corruption of Dol Guldur further into southern Mirkwood, cutting down resistance with axe and spear. Each foray took you deeper into the twisted forest and left less of your former self behind." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1005:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_text}Hunted the dark forest's edges." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1007:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_5_desc}You tracked through the corrupted undergrowth of southern Mirkwood, killing any creature that came too close to the fortress and learning to move without making a sound in a forest that twisted every trail. Your eyes adjusted to a world without sunlight." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1009:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_text}Moved through shadows as a spy of the Necromancer." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1011:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_dolguldur_6_desc}You were used as a courier and agent in the Necromancer's network, carrying messages through the dark wood and delivering them to contacts who never showed their faces. You learned that shadows were your armor and silence your best weapon." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1013:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_1_text}Learned seamanship and swordsmanship aboard the Black ships." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1015:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_1_desc}You were taken to sea young, learning to hand a sail and fight with the cutlass and boarding axe of the Corsair tradition. The deck of a warship was your training ground, and the Anduin Delta was your proving ground." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1017:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_2_text}Ran the quays and counting-houses of the harbor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1019:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_2_desc}You grew up quick-tongued and quick-fingered in the busy dockyards of Umbar, learning to charm buyers, spot inflated bills, and move goods past customs without asking awkward questions. The harbor was a school in commerce and deception alike." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1021:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_3_text}Worked the shipyards of Umbar." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1023:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_3_desc}You learned to shape timber and caulk planking in the great ship-sheds of Umbar, studying the engineering of vessels that carried war across the sea. When you were not building ships you were thinking about how they might be broken." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1025:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_4_text}Raided Gondor's coastal villages with the Corsairs." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1027:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_4_desc}You made your first raids on the coasts of Gondor as little more than a youth, fighting at the front of a boarding party with sword and throwing knife. The raids were brutal and swift, and they taught you exactly what violence was worth." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1029:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_5_text}Navigated the Corsair lanes from the crow's nest." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1031:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_5_desc}You served as lookout and scout-sailor, learning to read the sea and chart a course through the dangerous waters of the Bay of Belfalas. What you spotted from the masthead determined whether a raid succeeded or became a catastrophe." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1033:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_6_text}Moved contraband through Umbar's back alleys." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1035:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_umbar_6_desc}You ran in the shadow economy of the harbor city, carrying goods that could not be declared and messages that could not be written down. The work paid in secrets and small coins, and you learned every fence, bribe, and bolt-hole in Umbar." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1061:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_text}Rode in training with the Marshal's household." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1063:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc}You spent your youth learning the art of mounted war in service to one of the marshals of the Riddermark, drilling with lance and sword in the wide grasslands of Rohan. Horsemanship was not taught in the Riddermark — it was breathed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1065:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_text}Traded goods through the Riddermark markets." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1067:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_desc}You carried wares and prices between the holds of Edoras and the smaller towns of Rohan, learning to read people and close a deal before the day's light faded. The plains were long and empty and the conversation at market stalls made the world go round." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1069:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_text}Raised horses and stood levy in the Westfold." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1071:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_desc}You worked your family's pastures in the Westfold, learning to handle horses almost before you could walk, and were pressed into levy service as soon as you were tall enough for the spear. The rolling plains of western Rohan were your school." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1073:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_text}Apprenticed to the smiths of Aldburg." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1075:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_desc}You learned to shape the bright steel of Rohan in the forge-houses of Aldburg, making blades and fittings for the Rohirrim. You went home each night with arms aching and a pride in craft that no battlefield could diminish." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1077:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_5_text}Hunted in the Eastfold and watched the horizon." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1079:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_5_desc}You ranged widely across the Eastfold with your bow, hunting game and keeping a sharp eye on the eastern horizon for signs of Orc movement. The wide plains taught you to see far and move quietly, and both skills served you well." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1081:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_6_text}Drifted across the Wold with no fixed allegiance." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1083:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_6_desc}You wandered the wild grasslands of the Wold without clan or hold to call your own, learning to survive on what the plains offered and occasionally on what other people had not hidden well enough. Cunning kept you fed when luck would not." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1159:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_khuzait_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_khuzait_1_desc}You trained as a war-rider of Rhun, learning mounted combat in the wide steppe tradition from elders whose fathers had ridden against Gondor under the red dawn banner. The great eastern plains were your practice ground and the horse your most trusted weapon." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1185:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_1_text}You distinguished yourself at the defence of Osgiliath." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1187:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_1_desc}When Mordor pressed hard across the river, you held your section of the bridge until the order to fall back was given. The captain commended your name to the Steward's herald, and the men of your company remembered what you did that day." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1189:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_2_text}You negotiated a vital grain supply contract for Minas Tirith." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1191:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_2_desc}When drought threatened the outer farms, you arranged terms with merchant houses from as far as Pelargir to keep the city's granaries full through a hard winter. The Steward's chamberlain noted your name for future service." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1193:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_3_text}You organized the Pelennor harvest under threat of Orc raids." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1195:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_3_desc}When raiding parties came out of the Ephel Duath, you coordinated the local levies to protect the harvesters and brought in the crop before the season broke. The village heads still talk about the year someone actually got it done." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1197:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_4_text}You forged a blade that was presented to a Tower Guard captain." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1199:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_4_desc}The captain had heard of your work and commissioned a sword for the ceremony of his promotion. When he drew it before the assembled guard and it rang true, you knew the craft had repaid every sore morning in the smithing quarter." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1201:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_5_text}You guided a Ranger company through an Orc encirclement in Ithilien." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1203:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_5_desc}When the patrol was cut off east of the Anduin, you led them through a track no Orc scout had mapped, losing not a single man. Faramir's lieutenant clasped your arm when you came in and said nothing more needed to be said." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1205:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_6_text}You uncovered a smuggling ring operating out of the lower city." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1207:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_gondor_6_desc}For months contraband had moved through Osgiliath's ruins into Minas Tirith without anyone knowing how. You mapped the routes, identified the ringleader, and handed the whole operation to the city watch. The reward paid for your first real sword." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1209:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_1_text}You survived the trial of the Black Pits and were named to the Eye's legion." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1211:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_1_desc}Few who entered the pits were named worthy. You did not merely survive — you broke three challengers in succession before the overseers called it done. The legionary brand was pressed into your arm before the crowd dispersed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1213:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_2_text}You turned a losing supply route into the most profitable road in the Dark Land." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1215:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_2_desc}The previous courier had been bleeding supply convoys for months through bad routing and worse deals. You cut the dead weight, renegotiated the toll agreements, and doubled throughput inside a season. The overseers rewarded you with a better cut and a worse conscience." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1217:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_3_text}You completed the construction of a forge-tower ahead of schedule." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1219:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_3_desc}The overseer had promised punishment if the forge-tower was not ready before the Dark Lord's inspection. You drove the work gangs harder than anyone thought possible and the tower stood complete with two days to spare. The overseer took the credit; you took the survival." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1221:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_4_text}You quelled a work-gang revolt without losing the day's output." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1223:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_4_desc}When the exhausted laborers put down their tools and refused to move, you stepped in alone, identified the three instigators, and handled the situation before the overseers noticed the delay. The gang went back to work. The instigators did not cause further trouble." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1225:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_5_text}You tracked and killed a deserter that three patrols had failed to find." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1227:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_5_desc}The deserter had killed two overseers and vanished into Gorgoroth's wastes. You went alone, followed the trail for four days across the ash flats, and came back with proof of what you found. No one asked for details." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1229:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_6_text}You exposed a corrupt gatekeeper and took his post." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1231:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_mordor_6_desc}The gatekeeper at the Morannon had been taxing every band that passed and pocketing half the take. You documented the scheme, presented it to his superior at exactly the right moment, and watched the post change hands. You made sure it changed to yours." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1351:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_desc}You identified the spy through behavioral inconsistency, confronted him privately, and gave him a choice that made the decision simple. He fed false information back to Edoras for two seasons before anyone in Rohan suspected. You received nothing in writing for the achievement." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1377:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_1_text}You commanded the patrol that first broke through Mirkwood's northern defences." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1379:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_1_desc}The Elven border wardens had held the approach for two seasons. You identified the gap in their rotation, timed your crossing to the minute, and brought your patrol through and back without a casualty. The shadow-masters noted your report and gave you a permanent command." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1381:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_2_text}You forged shadow-steel weapons that passed Sauron's quality inspection." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1383:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_2_desc}The Necromancer's inspectors had rejected two previous batches from the fortress's smiths.
