You reworked the smelting process, accepted no compromise on the quench, and delivered a batch that the inspector examined in silence before marking as approved. It was the first such approval in three years." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1385:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_3_text}You completed the expansion of the fortress's lowest dungeon level." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1387:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_3_desc}The work had stalled for a season due to seeping groundwater and failing supports. You redesigned the drainage, replaced the compromised timbers, and completed the level on the revised schedule. The Necromancer's overseers moved prisoners in the same week." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1389:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_4_text}You broke through the Elven outer watch and took a prisoner for questioning." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1391:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_4_desc}The intelligence taken from the Elven warden described the full rotation of Thranduil's eastern border patrol. It was the most useful strategic information Dol Guldur had received in a year. No one asked how you got the prisoner out. You did not explain." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1393:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_5_text}You mapped the Elven patrol routes in southern Mirkwood over six months." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1395:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_5_desc}Working alone and over multiple seasons, you built a complete picture of Thranduil's southern border dispositions. The map that resulted gave Dol Guldur's planners something they had never had before: certainty. The Necromancer's agents used it for two years." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1397:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_6_text}You infiltrated the Elvenking's court as a trader and reported what you heard." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1399:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_dolguldur_6_desc}Three months in Thranduil's halls under a false identity gave you access to conversations that no agent of Dol Guldur had ever overheard. You came back with names, plans, and relationships that the shadow-masters used to shape the next season's strategy. You found the experience unexpectedly informative about Elves." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1401:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_1_text}You captained the fastest raid up the Anduin in a decade." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1403:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_1_desc}Your ship made it past the Gondorian river chain, struck the supply depot at Pelargir, and was back at sea before the garrison's signal fires had burned down. The Corsair fleet captains raised a cup in your name when you came in, which was the only kind of ceremony they knew." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1405:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_2_text}You established a new trade route through the Bay that doubled harbor revenue." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1407:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_2_desc}The existing routes had been taxed to the point where merchants were looking for alternatives. You identified an underused passage through the bay islands, arranged the fees, and brought three new merchant houses into the harbor within a season. The harbormasters were irritated but richer." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1409:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_3_text}You designed the new drydock that solved Umbar's fleet maintenance bottleneck." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1411:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_3_desc}The old drydock could only handle one hull at a time and the fleet was backing up. Your redesign allowed parallel work on two vessels simultaneously. The ship-masters were skeptical until the first simultaneous completion came in ahead of schedule. They were not skeptical after that." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1413:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_4_text}You led the boarding party that took the Gondorian warship off Belfalas." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1415:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_4_desc}The warship was twice the size of your vessel and her crew outnumbered yours. You closed in a fog, went over the side first, took the helm, and had the crew disarmed before they fully understood what was happening. The ship was in Umbar's harbor within two days." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1417:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_5_text}You spotted a Gondorian naval trap before your fleet sailed into it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1419:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_5_desc}The supply fleet was three hours out when you noticed the way the coastal birds were behaving around a particular headland. You called for a halt, went ahead in a small craft, and found a Gondorian squadron waiting in the calm water behind it. The fleet turned back. The admiral gave you the next command." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1421:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_6_text}You ran the most successful black market in Umbar's lower harbor for two years." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1423:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_umbar_6_desc}The operation moved goods that could not be declared through channels that did not officially exist, to buyers who paid in coin that was never counted. You ran it cleanly enough that no watch captain was ever able to make a case. When you closed it, you did so because you chose to." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1449:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_1_text}You rode in the charge at the Fords of Isen and held the line." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1451:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_1_desc}When Saruman's forces pushed across the Isen, the Rohirrim line buckled at the center. You were among those who held the ford long enough for the retreat to become a withdrawal rather than a rout. The Marshal mentioned you in his account of the battle." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1453:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_2_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_2_text}You negotiated the best horse-fair prices Edoras had seen in five years." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1455:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_2_desc}The buyers from the south had come expecting to set the price as they always did. You organized the Rohirrim sellers before the fair, agreed on a floor, and held it. The buyers paid what the horses were worth. The sellers remembered who had made it happen." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1457:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_3_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_3_text}You broke a Dunlending raid that struck the Westfold in early autumn." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1459:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_3_desc}The raiders had timed their strike for the harvest period when the farmsteads were exposed. You had anticipated the possibility, organized the local levies in advance, and met them at the valley entrance. The raid broke on the spear-line before it reached a single farmstead." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1461:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_4_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_4_text}You forged a sword that the King of the Mark chose for his personal guard." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1463:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_4_desc}The commission came from the stables — a request for a blade that could be carried on horseback without awkwardness. You studied the problem, adjusted the balance, and presented the result. Theoden's captain tested it in the yard and had it sent to the king's armory the same afternoon." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1465:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_5_text}You tracked the Isengard scouts that were mapping Helm's Deep approaches." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1467:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_5_desc}You noticed the signs of careful observation — broken grass pressed back upright, stones replaced — and realized someone had been reading the approaches to the Deep for weeks. You tracked back along their routes, identified the camp, and reported it to the garrison captain. Helm's Deep prepared accordingly." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1469:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_6_text}You exposed a Dunlending spy operating inside Edoras." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1471:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_vlandia_6_desc}The spy had been in the city for two years, passing information to the clans about Rohirrim garrison strengths. You noticed the pattern in what went wrong on raids where only a few people had been told the details. Three conversations later you had the name and the method of transfer." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1499:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_aserai_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_aserai_1_desc}The Haradrim host moved toward Gondor and you rode at the front of the war-column, fighting the skirmishes that cleared the way. When the great battle came you were among those whose name the Black Serpent knew when it was over — for those who survived to tell him." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1545:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_khuzait_1_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_khuzait_1_text}You led the flanking charge that broke the Gondorian infantry square." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1547:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_khuzait_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_khuzait_1_desc}The Gondorian square had held through three direct assaults and the battle-lord was considering withdrawal. You identified the timing of their shield rotation, requested the flanking cavalry, and committed the charge at exactly the right moment. The square broke. The battle was won." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1565:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_khuzait_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_khuzait_6_text}You scouted the Gondorian fortress at Cair Andros and mapped its weaknesses." />

C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:178:<string id="str_neutral_term_for_culture.mordor" text="{=taom_str_neutral_term_for_culture.mordor}Mordor" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:228:<string id="str_culture_description.vlandia" text="{=taom_str_culture_description.vlandia}The Rohirrim, known as the Horse-lords, are the proud and noble people of Rohan, a realm of wide open plains and rolling hills. They are renowned for their skill as riders and their unmatched cavalry, which forms the backbone of their military strength. Living in a tightly-knit feudal society, the Rohirrim are led by a king and a loyal nobility who are bound by honor and tradition to protect their land and people. They are fiercely independent, valuing freedom above all, and their warriors are trained to fight with spears, swords, and bows, all while astride their powerful steeds." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:230:<string id="str_culture_description.khuzait" text="{=taom_str_culture_description.khuzait}The Easterlings are a proud and disciplined people, hailing from the vast eastern lands beyond Mordor. Renowned for their resilience and mastery of warfare, they are both farmers and warriors, blending agrarian traditions with a fierce martial culture. Their armies are known for their fearsome cavalry, adorned in ornate armor and carrying deadly spears and bows. With a rich heritage of craftsmanship and loyalty to their kin, the Easterlings march to war under vibrant banners of gold and crimson, striking fear into the hearts of their enemies. Their allegiance to Sauron has made them a formidable force, uniting under his shadow to expand their dominion across Middle-earth." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:241:<string id="str_culture_description.umbar" text="{=taom_str_culture_description.umbar}The Corsairs of Umbar, seafaring raiders and master sailors, are a ruthless and cunning people allied with Sauron. Known for their swift ships and relentless naval warfare, they strike fear into the coastlines of Middle-earth. Proud of their maritime heritage, they bring the chaos of the seas to the land, raiding and pillaging in the name of their dark alliances." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:242:<string id="str_culture_description.dolguldur" text="{=taom_str_culture_description.dolguldur}The minions of Dol Guldur, under the command of the Necromancer, are a dark and sinister force. Hidden within the corrupted forest of Mirkwood, they employ treachery and shadow to weaken their enemies. Orcs, wargs, and other foul creatures march forth to spread fear and decay across Middle-earth." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:243:<string id="str_culture_description.gondor" text="{=taom_str_culture_description.gondor}The Gondorians, descendants of the Númenórean exiles, are the proud stewards of the greatest kingdom of Men in Middle-earth. Known for their towering stone fortresses and unwavering courage, Gondor is a bastion of hope against the looming shadow of Mordor. Its disciplined armies, comprised of valiant infantry, skilled archers, and mounted knights, stand as a shield for all free peoples. Guided by noble stewards and captains, the Gondorians hold fast to their traditions, unyielding in their duty to protect the realm and its legacy." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:244:<string id="str_culture_description.mordor" text="{=taom_str_culture_description.mordor}The armies of Mordor, forged in the shadow of Mount Doom, are a relentless force of darkness commanded by Sauron, the Dark Lord. Comprised of orcs, trolls, and wicked men, they march to war under the burning Eye, sowing fear and destruction. These legions are driven by cruelty and servitude, wielding jagged blades and crude armor. Bound by Sauron's iron will, the forces of Mordor are a deadly tide seeking to engulf all of Middle-earth in shadow." />

C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:708:<string id="aom_abanissa_name" text="{=aom_abanissa_name}Âbanissa" />

C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:731:<!-- NPC notable names (npcs_abanissa.xml) -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:764:<string id="TAOM_ghilman_text" text="{=TAOM_ghilman_text}The Serpent Guard are mounted soldiers in the service of the Serpentlord of Near Harad. Bred in the saddle on the rolling plains south of the Ephel Dúath, they are unmatched as horse-archers in all of Middle-earth's southern lands. In times of peace between Harad and Mordor, the Guard hires its services to Haradrim lords and to any other power rich enough to afford their golden fee." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:773:<string id="TAOM_company_text" text="{=TAOM_company_text}The Corsair Blades are veteran sea-fighters from the harbours of Umbar who have taken to selling their skills on land. They fight as crossbowmen — the preferred arm of shipboard warfare — and are as comfortable in a siege as they are on a rolling deck. Their captain, a scarred Númenórean exile, keeps them to their contracts with iron discipline, knowing that their reputation is their most valuable cargo." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:781:<string id="TAOM_wolfskins_text" text="{=TAOM_wolfskins_text}The Variag Ravagers are war-bands of young Variag warriors from the steppes of Khand who spend their early manhood in a state of ritual warfare: they may own no cooked food, sleep under no permanent roof, and take no mercy. While most eventually return to the settled life of their clans, some never do, and these form the Ravagers — outlaws who prey on the roads of Khand and raid across its borders into Harad and Gondor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:787:<string id="TAOM_hidden_hand_text" text="{=TAOM_hidden_hand_text}The Mouth's Servants are the Eyes of Barad-dûr operating beyond the Black Gate — informants, enforcers, and spies embedded among the peoples bordering Mordor. Where Sauron's armies cannot yet reach, these agents collect tribute and silence dissent. They work through bribery, blackmail, and quiet murder, ensuring that no conspiracy against the Dark Lord takes root before it is uprooted and crushed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:803:<string id="TAOM_karakhuzaits_text" text="{=TAOM_karakhuzaits_text}The Wild Easterlings are the unconquered steppe clans of the Sea of Rhûn, who have resisted the authority of every lord who has tried to bring them to heel — Rhûn chieftain, Mordor lieutenant, and King of Dale alike. They range across the grasslands east of the Celduin, rounding up horses, raiding flocks, and collecting road tribute from any caravan foolish enough to cross their steppe without an armed escort." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:855:<string id="taom_cq_capt_osg_t2_desc" text="{=taom_cq_capt_osg_t2_desc}Osgiliath's ruins must hold against the Shadow. Prove yourself worthy of the rank of Captain — win Gondor's battles, master the blade, and let your renown spread along the Anduin." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:856:<string id="taom_cq_capt_osg_t2_obj_battles" text="{=taom_cq_capt_osg_t2_obj_battles}Win battles for Gondor" />

Founded by the Númenórean exiles Isildur and Anárion, Gondor stands as a bastion of strength and hope against the encroaching darkness of Mordor. C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:4:<!-- GONDOR wanderer backstories -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:5:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_0" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}The archives of Minas Tirith hold many secrets, yet some truths must be sought beyond stone walls..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:6:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_0" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}I served as a scribe in the Citadel, recording the annals of Gondor's glory. My father was a captain of the Tower Guard, my mother a healer in the Houses of Healing. I studied both sword and scroll, believing knowledge and steel together preserve our realm." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:7:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_0" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}But I discovered discrepancies in our records - battles that never happened, heroes who never lived. When I brought this to the archivists, they silenced me, saying some truths serve the realm better than facts. They offered me gold to forget what I'd found." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:8:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_0" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}I refused their bribes and left the White City. Now I seek the true history of our people, traveling from Ithilien to Anórien, gathering tales from those who remember. The Shadow grows in the East, and we cannot face it with lies as our foundation." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:9:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_0" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}Truth is indeed a powerful weapon against darkness." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:10:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_0" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}Sometimes myths serve better than facts in dark times." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:11:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_0" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_0_text}If you seek one who values both wisdom and valor, I would join your company." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:12:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_1" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}Twenty years I held the White Tower's gates, until honor demanded I leave..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:13:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_1" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}I was among the elite who guard the Citadel itself. We stood watch as the Steward pondered, as captains planned, as the realm slowly forgot its king. I witnessed the nobility's petty squabbles while orcs gathered in Mordor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:14:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_1" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}One night, a lord's son committed murder in the Citadel - killed a rival over a woman. The Steward ordered us to blame it on a Southron spy. I refused to bear false witness, though my captain commanded it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:15:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}They stripped me of rank but couldn't take my skills. Now I wander, offering my spear to those who still believe in justice. The realm decays from within while we watch for enemies without." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:16:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_1" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}You chose honor over comfort - a rare thing these days." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:17:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_1" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}Perhaps you should have been more practical." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:18:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_1" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_1_text}I seek honest work for honest pay. Will you have me?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:19:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_2" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}The gardens of Ithilien still bloom, though shadow creeps ever closer..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:20:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_2" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}I served with the Rangers of Ithilien under Captain Faramir. We were the eyes of Gondor in the wild, harrying orcs and watching the Black Gate. My bow sang death to many servants of the Enemy." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:21:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}During a raid near Osgiliath, we captured Southron scouts. They weren't spies but refugees - families fleeing the Shadow's growing influence. My unit was ordered to execute them. I helped them escape instead." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:22:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_2" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}Now I'm branded a traitor by some, though Captain Faramir himself said nothing when I left. I range alone, protecting those who cannot protect themselves, whether they're of Gondor or not." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:23:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_2" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}Mercy in war takes true courage." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:24:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_2" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}The Enemy uses such weakness against us." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:25:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_2" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_2_text}I offer my bow and woodland skills, if you'll have them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:26:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_3" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}Noble blood means nothing when honor is lost..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:27:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}I was born to a lesser house of Minas Tirith, raised in marble halls with servants and tutors. My family held lands in Lossarnach, rich with orchards and vineyards. I was groomed for court life and military command." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:28:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_3" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}My younger brother coveted our inheritance. He forged documents suggesting I conspired with Southron merchants against Gondor's interests. The court believed his lies, or perhaps they were simply paid to. My lands were seized, my name struck from the rolls." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:29:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_3" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}Now I wander without title or home, using skills meant for governing estates to survive as a sellsword. The corruption in Minas Tirith runs deeper than the Enemy's shadow - at least orcs are honest about their nature." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:30:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_3" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}False accusation is a bitter draught to swallow." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:31:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_3" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}Perhaps there was some truth to the charges?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:32:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_3" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_3_text}I offer refined skills and hard-won cynicism, if you need them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:33:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_4" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}The swan ships sail less often now, and corsairs grow bold..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:34:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_4" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}I served Prince Imrahil as a marine, defending Belfalas from corsair raids. We fought from ship decks and harbor walls, repelling those who would plunder our coasts. The sea salt and combat forged me into a warrior." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:35:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_4" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}During a patrol, we encountered a merchant vessel under corsair colors. But when we boarded, we found Gondorian soldiers disguised as pirates, smuggling weapons to unknown buyers. My commander ordered us to sink the ship and never speak of it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:36:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_4" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}I couldn't serve knowing such treachery existed in our own ranks. I left Dol Amroth's service and now seek honest employment. If Gondor trades with its own enemies, how can we claim moral authority?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:37:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_4" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}Corruption in the fleet bodes ill for Gondor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:38:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_4" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}War makes strange necessities." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:39:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_4" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_4_text}My spear knows both land and sea combat, if you have need." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:40:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_5" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}Leadership means nothing when those above you are blind..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:41:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_5" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}I commanded a company in Osgiliath, holding the ruined city against constant probes from Mordor. My men trusted me, and I never spent their lives cheaply. We were a sword pointed at the Enemy's throat." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:42:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_5" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}Orders came to abandon the eastern shore entirely, ceding half the city without a fight. I protested - we could hold with reinforcement. But the Steward's advisors deemed it 'strategically unnecessary.' We retreated, and orcs now mass where we once stood guard." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:43:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}I resigned my commission rather than watch our defenses crumble through cowardice disguised as strategy. Now I seek those who still have the will to fight, not merely to retreat and call it wisdom." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:44:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_5" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}A tactical withdrawal can be wise." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:45:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_5" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}You're right - Gondor retreats too easily." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:46:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_5" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_5_text}I bring years of command experience, if you'll use it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:47:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_6" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}The Houses of Healing grow crowded, yet fewer healers remain..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:48:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}I trained in the Houses of Healing while learning swordplay from my father, a guard captain. I believed a healer who could defend herself could serve in the field, saving lives where they're lost - in battle itself." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:49:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}The Warden forbade me from joining field units, saying a woman's place was in the Houses, not the battlefield. When I continued practicing combat medicine with willing soldiers, they threatened to revoke my healer's seal." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:50:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}I left before they could chain me to tradition. Now I wander, healing those who need it and fighting when I must. The Enemy doesn't care about our conventions - why should we limit ourselves?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:51:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_6" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}Battlefield healers save many lives." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:52:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_6" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}Perhaps tradition has wisdom." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:53:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_6_text}I offer blade and healing herbs alike, if you need them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:54:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_7" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}The Anduin flows dark, and strange ships sail at night..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:55:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_7" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}I captained a patrol ship from Pelargir, keeping the great river clear of enemies. We knew every bend and shoal from the Mouths to Cair Andros. My crew could fight on water as well as any could on land." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:56:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_7" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}We discovered barges moving upriver by night, bearing no banners. When we investigated, they carried weapons and supplies - but fled when challenged. My admiral ordered me to ignore such vessels, saying they were 'approved traffic.'" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:57:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_7" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}I couldn't patrol waters where unknown forces moved freely. Either we control the Anduin or we don't. I resigned and now seek employment where orders make sense and enemies are clearly marked." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:58:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_7" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}The river's control is vital to Gondor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:59:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_7" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}Some battles require secrecy." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:60:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_7" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_7_text}I know warfare by water and land, if you need such skills." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:61:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_8" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}The northern borders grow wild, and few watch them now..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:62:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_8" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}I served at Cair Andros, the island fortress that guards the northern road. We were rangers and scouts, watching for threats from the Dead Marshes and the Black Gate. My bow and stealth kept many orcs from ever reaching Gondor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:63:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_8" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}Strange men began passing through - not orcs, but Easterlings and others who served the Enemy. When I reported this, I was told certain passages were permitted by 'treaty.' What treaty does Gondor make with Mordor's servants?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:64:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_8" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}I couldn't guard a border that wasn't truly guarded. Now I range freely, hunting threats wherever I find them. If Gondor won't defend its boundaries, someone must." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:65:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_8" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}A ranger's vigilance is always needed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:66:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_8" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}Perhaps diplomacy serves better than arrows." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:67:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_8" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_8_text}My bow and woodcraft are yours, if you'll have them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:68:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_9" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}Ancient blood carries ancient burdens..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:69:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}My lineage traces to Anárion himself, though our house fell to lesser standing long ago. Still, we maintained our pride, our traditions, and our skill at arms. I was raised believing nobility meant service." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:70:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}At court, I witnessed the great lords squabbling over precedence while ignoring the realm's decay. They debate bloodlines and ancient claims while orcs mass at our borders. When I spoke against this folly, they mocked me as an idealistic fool." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:71:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}I left the court's poisoned air to seek real service. Let them play their games - I'll defend Gondor with steel, not genealogies. True nobility is earned, not inherited." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:72:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_9" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}Action speaks louder than ancestry." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:73:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_9" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}Perhaps the court needs voices like yours." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:74:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_9_text}I offer noble training and common sense, if you value them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:75:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_10" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}Shadows can serve the light, if properly directed..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:76:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_10" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}I trained with Ithilien's rangers but specialized in infiltration and intelligence. While others fought openly, I slipped behind enemy lines, gathering information and eliminating key targets. The Enemy never knew I existed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:77:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_10" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}I uncovered evidence that someone in Minas Tirith was selling patrol routes to Southron spies. When I reported this, my own commanders accused me of fabrication, saying I'd grown paranoid from too much time alone in the shadows." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:78:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_10" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}They wanted me silenced, so I vanished. Now I use my skills independently, hunting threats that others refuse to see. Gondor's greatest enemies may not be orcs, but those who profit from our slow defeat." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:79:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_10" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}Hidden enemies are the most dangerous." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:80:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_10" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}Paranoia can cloud judgment." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:81:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_10" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_10_text}I offer skills best not spoken of openly, if you need them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:82:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_11" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}Thirty years of service, ended by one moment of conscience..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:83:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_11" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}I served in Minas Tirith's guard since boyhood, rising through discipline and skill to guard the Citadel itself. I've seen three captains come and go, watched the Steward age, witnessed the realm's slow decline." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:84:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_11" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}A group of nobles conspired to hoard grain while common folk starved, claiming future shortage. When I reported this to my captain, he revealed he was part of the scheme. He offered me a share to forget what I knew." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:85:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_11" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}I refused and was discharged for 'declining vision due to age.' My eyes see clearly enough - it's Gondor's leadership that's blind. Now I seek employment where honor still means something." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:86:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_11" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}Integrity is worth more than gold." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:87:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_11" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}You threw away much for principle." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:88:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_11" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_11_text}I offer decades of experience, if you'll trust gray hair." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:89:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_12" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}Words can prevent wars, but sometimes steel speaks clearer..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:90:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_12" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}I served as an envoy for Gondor, negotiating with the Rohirrim, treating with merchant princes, even parlaying with Dunlendings. My father taught me diplomacy, my mother swordplay - both served me well." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:91:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_12" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}I was sent to negotiate a treaty with certain Southron chiefs who claimed neutrality. I discovered they were already allied with Mordor, and our delegation was meant to be killed as a provocation for war. We fought our way free, barely." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:92:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_12" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}When I returned, certain counselors suggested I misunderstood the situation. They wanted the war but needed someone to blame. I resigned before they could make me their scapegoat. Now I seek honest dealings, rare as they are." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:93:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_12" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}Truth is diplomacy's first casualty." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:94:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_12" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}Perhaps you misjudged the situation." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:95:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_12" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_gondor_12_text}I offer words and sword in equal measure, if you need them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:97:<!-- MORDOR wanderer backstories -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:98:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_0" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}Even in the Dark Tower's shadow, some see opportunity in chaos..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:99:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_0" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}I served as an interrogator in the dungeons of Barad-dûr, extracting secrets from prisoners and rebels. The work required precision, patience, and a strong stomach. I learned to read fear, to understand what breaks each creature. The Dark Lord values information, and I provided it reliably." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:100:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_0" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}A high-ranking prisoner died before revealing critical intelligence, a miscalculation on my part. The lieutenant blamed me for the loss, though he'd demanded haste over care. Rather than face the consequences of his failure becoming mine, I departed during the confusion of a slave revolt." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:101:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_0" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}Mordor's reach extends far, but so do the shadows where one can hide. My skills translate well beyond dungeon walls, interrogation, intimidation, extracting truth from the unwilling. There are many who would pay for such expertise, and I'm no longer bound by the Tower's restrictions." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:102:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_0" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}Skills honed in darkness, terrible but useful." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:103:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_0" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}One who understands the language of fear." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:104:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_0" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}I extract information others cannot, through methods they dare not employ." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:105:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_0" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_0_text}Former interrogator from Barad-dûr. I fled after a prisoner's death brought unwanted attention." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:106:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_1" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}Not all who leave Mordor do so by choice, but some find freedom in exile..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:107:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_1" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}I fought in the vanguard of Morgul raids, descended from those who served the Witch-king himself. Twenty battles, never once turned back. My blade has tasted elf-blood, dwarf-blood, the blood of men. The battle-fury runs strong in my veins, I am what orcs were made to be." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:108:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_1" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}During a raid on a Gondorian outpost, our captain ordered retreat when victory was within grasp. Coward wanted to preserve his warband for another day. I ignored the order, rallied those with courage, and we took the fort. The captain accused me of insubordination, sentenced me to the slave pits." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:109:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}I escaped before they could chain me. The strong deserve to fight freely, not rot in darkness for showing initiative. There's war everywhere now, the Age of Men crumbles, and those who can fight will carve out their destiny. I need no master, only worthy enemies." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:110:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_1" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}Courage punished, common in hierarchies built on fear." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:111:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_1" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}A warrior who refuses to be wasted." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:112:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_1" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}I bring Morgul-trained fury and decades of battle experience, no target too dangerous." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:113:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_1" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_1_text}Morgul warrior who defied a coward's order. Fled rather than face punishment for victory." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:114:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_2" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}The young and ambitious rise quickly in Mordor, or fall just as fast..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:115:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_2" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Bred in the pits of Isengard before its fall, I came to Mordor seeking greater purpose. Joined the Black Guard, earned my place through combat prowess. Younger than most but faster, stronger. I've killed veteran warriors in the fighting pits, proven myself worthy of command." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:116:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}I challenged my superior for his position, ritual combat, perfectly legal. I won. His allies couldn't accept an outsider, an Isengard-spawn, taking their comrade's place. They manufactured charges of theft, claimed I'd stolen from the war-stores. Before I could defend myself properly, I was forced to flee." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:117:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_2" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Mordor's loss is my gain. Out here, strength matters more than politics. I'll build my own warband eventually, lead them to victories no committee of frightened veterans would dare attempt. The world is ripe for taking, I just need the opportunity and warriors willing to follow strength." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:118:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_2" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Ambition that couldn't be contained." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:119:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_2" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Young but proven, dangerous combination." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:120:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_2" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}I offer pure combat skill and the ambition to see things through, no half-measures." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:121:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_2" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_2_text}Young Uruk from Isengard, driven from the Black Guard by jealous rivals. Seeks glory untainted by politics." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:122:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_3" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}In Mordor, those who control supplies control power..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:123:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}I managed supply lines for the northern armies, weapons, armor, food for the warbands. Not glorious work, but essential. More importantly, it taught me the value of things, the flow of resources, and how easily inventory records can be... adjusted. The Dark Lord has many servants; he doesn't notice a few missing crates." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:124:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_3" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}A rival quartermaster grew suspicious of my side ventures. Before he could investigate thoroughly, I arranged for certain records to be destroyed in a warehouse fire. Convenient, but too convenient. Questions were asked. I took what I could carry and disappeared into the wastes." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:125:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_3" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}I understand the real war, the one fought with coin and supply, not just blades. Every army needs equipment, and I know how to acquire it, how to move it, how to profit from it. My connections in Mordor still exist, and I know which officials can be bought. That knowledge is worth more than any sword-arm." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:126:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_3" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}Corruption has its uses, if carefully managed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:127:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_3" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}One who understands that wars are won with logistics." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:128:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_3" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}I provide access to Mordor's supply networks and the knowledge to exploit them profitably." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:129:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_3" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_3_text}Corrupt quartermaster who fled after nearly being exposed. Profits from both sides of every conflict." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:130:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_4" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}Some serve the Dark Lord, others serve only themselves..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:131:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_4" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}I worked as an enforcer for a slave-master in the mines of Gorgoroth, keeping the workers in line. The pay was steady, the work easy, break a few bones, make examples of troublemakers. But I saw opportunities the master missed. Slaves died regularly; no one counted too carefully if a few more vanished." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:132:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_4" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}I sold strong slaves to traders heading east, split the profit with a corrupt overseer. Would've continued indefinitely, but I got greedy, took too many, too quickly. An audit revealed the discrepancy. Rather than face the Dark Lord's justice, I killed the overseer and fled with what wealth I'd accumulated." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:133:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_4" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}The world is full of opportunities for someone willing to do what others won't. Slavery, theft, murder, just business. I have no illusions about honor or glory. I work for coin, and I'm very good at work others find distasteful. Mordor's reach is long, but there are always dark corners to hide in." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:134:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_4" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}Absolute pragmatism, admirable or horrifying, depending on perspective." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:135:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_4" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}One who embraces what he is without pretense." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:136:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_4" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}I handle problems others lack the stomach for, permanently and quietly." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:137:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_4" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_4_text}Slave trader and murderer who fled Mordor after killing his partner. Works for coin, nothing more." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:138:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_5" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}The fiercest warriors are often too fierce for their own armies..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:139:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_5" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}I led shock troops in the eastern campaigns, the ones sent first into fortified positions. My warband specialized in pure brutality, no prisoners, no quarter, nothing left standing. We broke strongholds that had stood for centuries. The captains praised our effectiveness while keeping their distance from our methods." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:140:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_5" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}After one battle, we found the enemy commander hiding among civilian refugees. I executed them all to be sure. The high command called it 'excessive,' claimed it damaged our reputation in the region. Reputation? We're orcs of Mordor! When did we start caring about reputation? They stripped my command, relegated me to basic infantry." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:141:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}Let them fight their clean wars with their careful strategies. I know only one way to fight, total, absolute, without mercy or hesitation. There are those who understand that war isn't about reputation, it's about making your enemies extinct. I'll find them, and we'll finish what Mordor was too squeamish to complete." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:142:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_5" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}Violence beyond even Mordor's tolerance, fearsome." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:143:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_5" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}A weapon too sharp for its wielder to hold safely." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:144:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_5" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}I bring absolute warfare, no survivors, no witnesses, no mercy. Only results." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:145:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_5" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_5_text}Shock troop leader demoted for excessive brutality. Seeks those who appreciate absolute methods." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:146:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Sometimes the simplest warriors are the most dangerous..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:147:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}I'm a simple creature, I fight, I kill, I take what I want. Served in the raiding parties that strike fast into Gondor, Rohan, wherever the captains point us. I don't ask questions, don't play politics. Point me at the enemy, I break them. My record speaks for itself, twenty successful raids, never failed an objective." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:148:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Problem was, I also took what I wanted from fellow soldiers. Weaker ones. Their rations, their loot, their lives if they objected too strongly. Officers said I was 'disrupting unit cohesion.' Cohesion? We're orcs! We take what we can take. When they tried to discipline me, I took the sergeant's head. Then I left." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:149:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Don't need Mordor's structure, their rules, their weakness. Out here, strength is law. I'll fight for anyone who points me at good targets and doesn't waste my time with discipline and cooperation. Pay me, feed me, get out of my way. Simple." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:150:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Direct and deadly, no pretense of civilization." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:151:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}A pure predator, unfettered by rules." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:152:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}I fight, I kill, I win. What more do you need?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:153:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}Brutal raider who killed his sergeant over discipline. Seeks freedom to fight without rules." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:154:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_7" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}The Black Númenóreans remember when they ruled, and some still hunger for power..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:155:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_7" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}My bloodline traces to old Númenor, the true Númenor that embraced greatness, not the weak remnants in Gondor. I served in the Morgul host as a lieutenant, commanding units of orcs and men. The blood of kings flows in my veins, yet I take orders from creatures that crawl in darkness. The irony isn't lost on me." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:156:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_7" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}I saw a chance to advance, a rival officer whose failure could become my opportunity. I ensured that failure, then ensured he couldn't explain it. Unfortunately, his allies were more numerous than I calculated. They couldn't prove my involvement, but suspicion was enough. I left before suspicion became certainty." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:157:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_7" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}Mordor is one path to power, not the only path. The Dark Lord's empire will expand, and when it does, those positioned correctly will rise with it. I have the blood, the training, and the ambition. I just need the right opportunity, the right alliance. Power doesn't care where you find it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:158:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_7" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}Ancient pride in service of darkness, dangerous combination." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:159:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_7" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}Ambition wrapped in nobility's decay." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:160:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_7" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}I bring noble blood, military training, and the willingness to do what advancement requires." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:161:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_7" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_7_text}Black Númenórean officer fled after political maneuvering went wrong. Seeks power through any means." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:162:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_8" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}Some are drawn to darkness by circumstance, others are born to it..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:163:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_8" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}Born in the shadow of the Black Gate, I've known nothing but Mordor's rule. Trained as an assassin, I served the Mouth of Sauron directly, eliminating traitors, silencing dissent, removing obstacles. I was good at it. Very good. Fear is an excellent teacher, and I've perfected its lessons." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:164:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_8" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}My last assignment was eliminating a suspected traitor, a high-ranking sorcerer. I succeeded, but discovered too late he'd been innocent, framed by another who wanted his position. That other now holds power, and I'm evidence of his crime. He sent hunters. I killed the hunters, but more will come." />
