C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:165:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_8" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}I'm not fleeing, I'm relocating. My skills are universal, killing transcends borders and loyalties. Someone will pay well for an assassin trained in Barad-dûr's shadow. And someday, I'll return to Mordor with enough power or allies to settle accounts with the one who made me a liability." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:166:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_8" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}A weapon seeking a new hand to wield it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:167:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_8" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}Death personified, looking for employment." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:168:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_8" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}I eliminate problems permanently and precisely, no target beyond reach." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:169:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_8" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_8_text}Assassin fleeing Mordor's politics after being used and discarded. Kills with expert precision." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:170:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_9" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}Information is the true currency of power in any realm..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:171:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}I worked in the intelligence networks, gathering information from spies, prisoners, informants throughout Middle-earth. My specialty was collating data, finding patterns, identifying threats before they materialized. Knowledge is power, and I accumulated both." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:172:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}The mistake was selling some of that information to private buyers, wealthy lords who wanted intelligence on their rivals, merchants seeking trade secrets. The profit was substantial until someone noticed classified information appearing in unexpected places. I destroyed evidence and fled before the investigation reached me." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:173:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}I retain copies of valuable intelligence, troop movements, supply routes, lists of agents and informants. This information has value to many parties. I also know how to gather more, how to build networks, how to turn secrets into coin. In the coming war, information will be worth more than steel." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:174:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_9" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}A spy selling to all sides, trustworthy as a snake." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:175:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_9" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}Knowledge without loyalty, useful if handled carefully." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:176:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}I provide intelligence on Mordor's operations and the means to gather more, for the right price." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:177:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_9" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_9_text}Intelligence operative who sold secrets for profit. Fled with valuable information and no allegiance." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:178:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_10" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}Even among orcs, some hunger for glory beyond their station..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:179:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_10" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}I commanded a century in the siege battalions, trained to break fortifications and crush defenders. Led from the front, always first through the breach. Earned commendations, battlefield promotions, respect from my soldiers. But advancement in Mordor requires more than battlefield success, it requires political maneuvering I found distasteful." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:180:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_10" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}A superior officer took credit for my victories while assigning me blame for his failures. I confronted him privately, made my position clear. He responded with fabricated charges of cowardice and insubordination. Rather than participate in a rigged tribunal, I demonstrated neither cowardice nor subordination, I left with my best warriors." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:181:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_10" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}Loyalty means nothing when your commanders are parasites. My soldiers followed me because I earned their respect, not because of rank or fear. Out here, merit matters more than politics. I'll build something worth fighting for, away from the corruption festering in Mordor's hierarchy." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:182:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_10" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}A leader betrayed by those he served, bitter lesson." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:183:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_10" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}Courage without the patience for politics." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:184:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_10" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}I bring battlefield command experience and warriors who followed me from Mordor itself." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:185:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_10" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_10_text}Siege commander who abandoned Mordor rather than face corrupt superiors. Leads through earned respect." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:186:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_11" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}War creates opportunities for those clever enough to exploit them..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:187:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_11" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}I served as a battlefield scavenger, officially recovering equipment from fallen soldiers for reuse. Unofficially, I took the best items for personal profit, weapons, armor, jewelry from the dead. Both sides' dead, mind you. War is wasteful; I merely reclaimed what would otherwise rot." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:188:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_11" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}My operation expanded too successfully. Started employing others, moving significant quantities of material. Eventually caught selling Mordor military equipment to enemy traders. The profit margins were too good to resist. When they came to arrest me, I'd already prepared my exit with enough wealth to start fresh elsewhere." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:189:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_11" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}War will intensify, and I know how to profit from it. Battlefields produce valuable salvage, desperate people buy at inflated prices, and chaos provides cover for enterprising individuals. I have connections on multiple sides and no particular loyalty to any. That's good business." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:190:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_11" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}Profiting from death, honest work for a scavenger." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:191:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_11" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}One who sees coin where others see corpses." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:192:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_11" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}I provide hard-to-find equipment and black market connections, no questions asked or answered." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:193:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_11" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_11_text}Battlefield scavenger turned black marketeer. Fled Mordor after selling military equipment to enemies." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:194:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_12" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}The strongest warriors sometimes outgrow their masters..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:195:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_12" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}Bred for war, trained for slaughter, perfected in battle, that's my existence. Elite guard for a Nazgûl's fortress, I fought anything that threatened my master's domain. Trolls, men, elves, rival orc clans. Never defeated. My reputation spread; enemies feared encountering Skarnûl the Unbroken." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:196:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_12" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}During an attack on the fortress, I defended my post perfectly while my master fled to safety. When he returned and saw the carnage, dozens of attackers dead by my hand, he grew suspicious. Too strong, too independent, too dangerous. He planned to have me eliminated quietly. I eliminated his assassins loudly and left." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:197:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_12" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}No one should fear their strongest defender. I've proven my worth in single combat and mass battle. Somewhere there's a leader wise enough to value absolute loyalty backed by absolute skill. Until then, my blade is for hire to those who appreciate warriors, not servants." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:198:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_12" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}Power that intimidated even its beneficiary." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:199:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_12" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}Unbroken by battle, unchained by betrayal." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:200:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_12" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}I am Skarnûl the Unbroken, elite warrior seeking worthy battles and wiser masters." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:201:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_12" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_12_text}Elite guard who became too powerful for his master's comfort. Seeks worthy employment." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:202:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_13" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}Poison is an elegant weapon in patient hands..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:203:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_13" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}I studied the alchemical arts in service to Mordor's apothecaries, poisons, antidotes, potions to enhance warriors or weaken enemies. My specialty became subtle toxins, the kind that kill slowly, invisibly, leaving no trace. The Dark Lord's servants appreciate such tools for removing obstacles without drawing attention." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:204:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_13" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}My talents drew private commissions, wealthy individuals wanting rivals eliminated discreetly. Profitable work, until one client proved unable to keep secrets. Interrogators learned of my side business. Rather than face trial, I poisoned the interrogation team and everyone who'd heard their reports. Then I left before anyone realized they were dead." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:205:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_13" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}The coming war will create demand for my expertise. Poisons can eliminate key leaders, contaminate supplies, create chaos without attributable cause. I carry my knowledge and recipes. Those who appreciate surgical precision over blunt force will find my services invaluable, for appropriate compensation." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:206:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_13" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}Death by chemistry, cold and efficient." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:207:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_13" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}One who kills with patience and precision." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:208:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_13" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}I provide untraceable death through alchemy, problems solved with no evidence." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:209:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_13" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_13_text}Poisoner who eliminated too many people, including those investigating him. Expert in subtle murder." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:210:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_14" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}Some men serve darkness for profit rather than belief..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:211:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_14" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}I come from Gondor originally, though don't hold that against me. Captured during a border skirmish, I had a choice, die with my unit or serve my captors. I chose pragmatism over pointless heroism. Proved useful translating, negotiating, handling diplomatic matters with human settlements. The pay was better than Gondor offered anyway." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:212:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_14" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}I brokered deals for Mordor, trade agreements with corrupt officials, bribes to key figures, establishing spy networks in enemy territory. My mistake was keeping too much profit for myself. When an audit revealed discrepancies, I had advance warning from a contact and used it to vanish with considerable wealth before they could seize my assets." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:213:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_14" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}I speak multiple languages, understand various cultures, know which officials in several kingdoms can be bought. I can negotiate, spy, establish networks, or simply advise on human psychology. Neither side trusts me completely, which means both will use me when necessary. That's profitable positioning." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:214:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_14" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}A turncoat who'd turn again for the right price." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:215:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_14" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}Mercenary loyalties can be useful if properly managed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:216:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_14" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}I provide diplomatic access, cultural knowledge, and flexible morality, all for reasonable compensation." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:217:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_14" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_mordor_14_text}Gondorian turncoat and embezzler. Fled Mordor with stolen wealth after serving as a diplomatic fixer." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:343:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}I led warbands against the Rohirrim, raiding their villages, burning their fields. No mercy, no hesitation, absolute results. My units left nothing alive, not warriors, not elderly, not children. Saruman wanted fear spread through Rohan, and I delivered it in rivers of blood." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:351:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}Simple existence, fight, kill, win. Led assault teams against Rohan's outlying fortresses. First through the breach every time, blade red with enemy blood. My warriors followed because I never asked them to do what I wouldn't do. Earned my position through strength, not breeding or favor." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:359:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}I commanded scouting parties into Rohan, gathering intelligence, eliminating patrols. Good at my work, effective, ruthless, reliable. But I saw how Saruman's favorites advanced while competent warriors like me stagnated. Merit alone doesn't bring promotion when the White Wizard plays favorites." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:375:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}Worked in Orthanc itself, carrying messages between Saruman and his agents. Trusted position, I saw correspondence with Mordor, with the Dunlendings, with corrupt officials throughout Rohan. Learned valuable secrets about troop movements, alliances, planned operations. Knowledge is power, and I accumulated plenty." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:395:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_1_text}The mountain has its warriors, but the world needs them more. Darkness spreads from Mordor, Dol Guldur threatens the north. I'll find real fights, real purpose. When Erebor calls its sons to war, and it will, I'll be ready, battle-hardened from the outside world." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:419:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_4" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_erebor_4_text}I know every trade route, every bandit camp, every corrupt official from here to Gondor. That knowledge has value to those who operate outside the law. I've already lost my honor, might as well profit from its absence." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:457:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text}I managed armed caravans to the far kingdoms, Gondor, Rohan, sometimes even the Woodland Realm. Negotiated with my tongue, fought with my axe when words failed. Profitable work, until I noticed patterns. Dark folk asking questions, movements of suspicious groups." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:481:<!-- ROHAN wanderer backstories -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:482:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_0" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text}The horses grow restless, and strange wolves prowl our borders..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:483:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text}I was a Marshal of the Westfold, commanding a éored of riders. We patrolled from Helm's Deep to the Gap of Rohan, watching for threats from Dunland and beyond. But dark rumors came from Isengard." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:484:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_0" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text}My scouts reported strange activity - trees being felled, fires burning day and night, and wolves unlike any we'd seen before. When I brought word to Edoras, Gríma Wormtongue dismissed my concerns, saying Saruman was our ally." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:485:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_0" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text}I pressed the matter, and was relieved of command for 'spreading panic.' Now I ride alone, gathering proof of the threat. The King grows weak under Wormtongue's counsel while danger gathers at our doorstep." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:486:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_0" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text}A watchful eye may save the Mark yet." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:487:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_0" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text}Perhaps you see threats where none exist." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:488:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_0" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text}I offer my lance and knowledge of these lands, if you need them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:489:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_1" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_1_text}The blood of Eorl runs hot in my veins, demanding action..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:490:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_1" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_1_text}I rode with the cavalry of Aldburg, defending the Eastemnet from orc raids. My spear drank deep of enemy blood, and my horse Thunderfoot was known across the Riddermark for his speed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:491:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_1" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_1_text}During a skirmish, we pursued orcs too far and discovered they wore gear from Isengard - supposedly our ally. When I reported this to my captain, he ordered me to forget what I'd seen. He said the King's counselor had forbidden such talk." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:492:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_1_text}I couldn't stay silent while treachery festered. I left my éored and now ride as a masterless warrior, seeking those who still have the courage to face hard truths." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:493:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_1" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_1_text}The Mark needs warriors who won't be silenced." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:494:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_1" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_1_text}Disobedience weakens the realm." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:495:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_1" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_1_text}My spear and steed are yours, if you'll have them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:496:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_2" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text}Young blood seeks glory, but finds only shadow..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:497:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_2" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text}I earned my first horse at twelve, my first kill at sixteen. I rode with the younger riders of Edoras, eager to prove ourselves worthy of our fathers' legacies. We dreamed of great charges and heroic songs." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:498:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text}On patrol near the Gap of Rohan, we found burnt villages - not raided by orcs, but destroyed by men. The tracks led toward Isengard. When we reported this, we were told we were mistaken, that Dunlendings were to blame." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:499:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_2" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text}But I know horse tracks from wolf tracks, boot prints from orc spoor. Someone wanted those villages gone, and it wasn't wild men. I left my éored to seek the truth. The Mark is threatened from within and without." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:500:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_2" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text}Youth often sees clearly what age ignores." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:501:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_2" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text}Young eyes can mistake shadows for substance." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:502:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_2" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text}I offer eager strength and sharp eyes, if you'll have them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:503:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_3" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_3_text}Honor lost is harder to bear than any wound..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:504:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_3_text}I was thane of a small hall near the Westfold, sworn to Erkenbrand. My people looked to me for protection and justice. I had good riders, strong walls, and fertile lands. It should have been enough." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:505:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_3" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_3_text}Gríma Wormtongue came with tax collectors, demanding twice our usual tribute. When I protested, he accused me of hoarding wealth while the King suffered. He had documents - forged, but convincing - showing I'd traded with Dunland." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:506:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_3" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_3_text}The King, in his befuddled state, stripped me of lands and title. My own people were told I was a traitor. Now I wander, a thane without a hall, seeking to restore my name through deeds since words failed me." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:507:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_3" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_3_text}Wormtongue has destroyed many good men." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:508:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_3" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_3_text}Perhaps there was cause for suspicion." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:509:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_3" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_3_text}I offer a warrior's skill and bitter experience, if you'll take them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:510:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_4" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_4_text}The shield-maidens of old knew no fear, neither should I..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:511:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_4" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_4_text}My grandmother rode with the éoreds in her youth, before marriage tamed her. She taught me spear and horse in secret, despite my father's wishes. When raiders struck our village while the men were away, I led the defense." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:512:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_4" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_4_text}We held, but I was seen fighting. The village elders said I brought shame, that women who took up arms invited chaos. They demanded I marry immediately or leave. My father, fearing scandal, sided with them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:513:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_4" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_4_text}I chose exile over chains. Now I ride as my grandmother once did, free and fierce. The Mark needs every spear, regardless of who wields it. Let them whisper - I'll be too busy fighting to hear." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:514:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_4" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_4_text}The Mark wastes half its strength ignoring women warriors." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:515:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_4" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_4_text}Tradition exists for good reasons." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:516:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_4" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_4_text}I offer a shield-maiden's courage, if you'll accept it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:517:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_5" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_5_text}The weak die so the strong might live - such is war..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:518:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_5" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_5_text}I rode with the most aggressive éored in the Eastfold. We gave no quarter to orcs, pursuing them to extinction. My commander said mercy to enemies was cruelty to our own people. I believed him." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:519:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_5" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_5_text}We caught a band of Dunlendings rustling cattle. My captain ordered them all killed - men, women, children. I obeyed, but one boy reminded me of my own son. After that night, I couldn't stop seeing his face." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:520:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_5_text}I left before I lost what humanity remained. Now I fight only those who can fight back. The line between warrior and butcher is thinner than most admit. I've been both, and prefer the former." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:521:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_5" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_5_text}Recognition of evil is the first step to redemption." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:522:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_5" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_5_text}War demands terrible choices." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:523:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_5" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_5_text}I offer hard skills and harder lessons, if you need them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:524:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_6" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_6_text}The bow sings truest from horseback..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:525:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_6_text}My father bred horses, my mother was from the Wold where archery is prized. I combined both traditions, becoming one of the few horse archers in the Mark. I could put an arrow through a ring at full gallop." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:526:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_6" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_6_text}Scouting near Isengard, I saw things that shouldn't exist - vast pits, strange fires, and twisted creatures. When I tried to get closer, wolves pursued me - but wolves that ran upright and spoke in dark tongues." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:527:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_6" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_6_text}My captain didn't believe me, said I'd been drinking. Wormtongue heard my tale and declared me mad, suggesting I be confined. I fled that night. What I saw was real, and the Mark must be warned." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:528:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_6" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_6_text}Dark times bring forth dark creatures." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:529:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_6" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_6_text}Fear can make men see monsters." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:530:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_6" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_6_text}My bow and knowledge are yours, if you'll trust them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:531:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_7" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text}The horses whisper of storms approaching..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:532:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_7" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text}I was born in the saddle, or near enough. My family supplied horses to the King's own stables. I could ride before I could properly walk, and understood horses better than people." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:533:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text}The horses began refusing to go near the Gap of Rohan - even the bravest stallions would rear and flee. Animals sense evil before men do. When I reported this to the horse masters, they blamed bad training." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:534:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_7" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text}But I know horses. They weren't spooked - they were terrified. Something unnatural grows in Isengard. I left the royal stables to investigate on my own. If the horses fear it, we should too." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:535:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_7" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text}Animals often sense what men miss." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:536:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_7" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text}Horses spook at many things." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:537:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_7" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text}I offer a rider's skill and a horse's wisdom, if you'll have them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:538:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_8" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_8_text}The finest riders serve truth, not corrupted kings..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:539:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_8" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_8_text}I was chosen for the King's own guard, the elite who ride beside royalty. It was the highest honor a rider could achieve. I served with pride, until I saw how far our King had fallen under Wormtongue's influence." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:540:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_8" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_8_text}Théoden King, once mighty, now sits pale and confused while Wormtongue whispers poison. I heard orders given that made no sense - troops withdrawn from threatened borders, supplies sent to uncertain destinations." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:541:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_8" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_8_text}When I questioned these orders, Wormtongue marked me as 'unreliable.' I was reassigned to distant patrols, then dismissed entirely. I won't serve a puppet king while the real threats gather strength." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:542:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_8" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_8_text}Loyalty to the realm surpasses loyalty to its ruler." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:543:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_8" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_8_text}Abandoning your king seems like treachery." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:544:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_8" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_8_text}I offer elite training and unwavering purpose, if you need them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:546:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_9" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_rohan_9_text}The plains taught me more than any hall of warriors ever could..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:547:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_9_text}I grew up in the Eastfold, where the wild horses still run free and the Easterlings probe our borders. My father was a herder, not a soldier, but he taught me to read the land and the wind." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:548:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_9" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_9_text}When raiders came, our village had no éored to protect it. I rallied the young riders and we drove them off ourselves. Word spread, and the Marshal offered me a place in the muster." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:549:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_9" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_rohan_9_text}But the marshals quarrel among themselves while the real enemy gathers. I left the muster to find a leader worth following — someone who sees beyond petty border disputes to the true darkness rising in the East." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:550:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_9" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_rohan_9_text}A rider who knows the land is worth ten who only know the charge." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:551:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_9" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_rohan_9_text}Leaving your people undefended seems reckless." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:552:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_9" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_rohan_9_text}I know every trail and ford in the Riddermark, and my horse has never failed me. That is what I bring." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:801:<!-- DOLGULDUR wanderer backstories -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:802:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}Knowledge is the truest weapon, and I have spent a lifetime gathering it..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:803:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}I studied the ancient arts of Dol Guldur, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from the Necromancer's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:804:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}But when a rival accused me of weakening our fortifications for the enemy, I was cast out despite my innocence. The walls I built still stand, though my name has been struck from the builders' rolls." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:805:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}Now I wander, offering my knowledge to those who value skill over politics. The Shadow grows, and the uruks of the fortress need fortifications more than ever." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:806:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}A builder's skills are worth more than a warrior's in these dark times." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:807:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}Stone walls won't stop what's coming." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:808:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}If you need one who can build as well as fight, I am at your service." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:809:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_0_text}A pit-boss from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:810:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}My blade has tasted the blood of many foes, yet I fight on..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:811:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}I was a champion of Dol Guldur, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the uruks of the fortress, and I served the Necromancer with unwavering loyalty." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:812:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}But honor demanded I challenge a corrupt commander who sent soldiers to die for personal glory. I won the duel but lost my position - the commander had powerful allies who saw me banished." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:813:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the elves and men of the West grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:814:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}A warrior who fights for honor deserves respect." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:815:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}Perhaps you should have been more careful about choosing your battles." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:816:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}My blade is yours, if you'll have it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:817:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_1_text}A skull-crusher from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:818:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}The wild places hold secrets that town-folk never dream of..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:819:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}I served as a scout in Dol Guldur, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the dark pits and can track a fox through running water." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:820:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the elves and men of the West. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:821:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}I refused to look away and paid the price. Now I range alone, using my skills to survive and help those who cross my path. The wilds are dangerous, but at least they're honest." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:822:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}The truth is worth any price." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:823:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}Sometimes survival requires compromise." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:824:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}I offer my eyes, my bow, and my knowledge of the wild." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:825:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_2_text}A shadow-scout from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:826:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}I have seen too many die from wounds that could have been healed..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:827:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}I trained as a healer in Dol Guldur, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the uruks of the fortress. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the elves and men of the West, saving countless lives." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:828:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}But when a noble's son died despite my best efforts - the wound was beyond any healer's skill - his father blamed me and demanded my execution. I fled rather than face a rigged tribunal." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:829:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}Now I practice my art wherever I can, helping the sick and wounded regardless of their allegiance. Death does not discriminate, and neither should healing." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:830:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}A healer's compassion is a rare gift." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:831:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}Healing enemies only makes more work for warriors." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:832:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}If you value the lives of your people, let me tend to them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:833:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_3_text}A poison-mixer from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:834:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}Gold opens doors that swords cannot..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:835:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}I built a trading network across Dol Guldur, connecting the uruks of the fortress with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that the Necromancer valued highly." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:836:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}But a jealous merchant house conspired to frame me for smuggling contraband. They seized my warehouses, scattered my contacts, and left me with nothing but the clothes on my back and the knowledge in my head." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:837:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}Now I seek to rebuild, one deal at a time. The coming war will need supplies and logistics, and I know every trade route from the Hill of Sorcery to the far reaches." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:838:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}Commerce is the lifeblood of any campaign." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:839:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}Pretty words from someone who lost everything." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:840:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}I can make your gold stretch further than you'd believe. Hire me." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:841:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_4_text}A loot-keeper from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:842:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}In the shadows, one learns the true nature of power..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:843:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}I grew up in the back alleys of Dol Guldur, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by the Necromancer's intelligence network, using my skills for the uruks of the fortress's benefit." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:844:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}But when I uncovered a conspiracy reaching into the highest circles of power, I became a liability. Those I served decided I knew too much and sent assassins. I killed two of them and fled." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:845:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}Now I trust no one but myself, though I'd rather use my skills openly than skulk in shadows forever. the elves and men of the West has spies everywhere, and someone needs to counter them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:846:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}A shadow-worker who serves the light is valuable indeed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:847:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}How can anyone trust a self-admitted spy?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:848:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}I work best when no one sees me coming. Will you have me?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:849:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_5_text}A throat-cutter from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:850:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}Battles are won in the mind before a single blade is drawn..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:851:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}I commanded forces in Dol Guldur, studying the art of war under the Necromancer's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the elves and men of the West when we were outnumbered." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:852:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}But a jealous superior took credit for my victories and blamed me for a retreat that saved our army from annihilation. The council sided with him - he had connections I lacked." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:853:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}Stripped of rank, I now offer my mind and experience to those who judge by merit, not birth. The coming war will need commanders who can think, not just those who can swing a sword." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:854:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}A thinking warrior is the most dangerous kind." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:855:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}Plans rarely survive contact with the enemy." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:856:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}Let me plan your campaigns, and I'll show you what strategy can achieve." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:857:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_6_text}A war-chief from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:858:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}The ring of hammer on steel is the music I was born to play..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:859:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}I was a master smith in Dol Guldur, crafting weapons and armor that the uruks of the fortress prized above all others. My forge produced blades that could cleave through enemy armor like parchment." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:860:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}But I refused to craft weapons for a corrupt lord who planned to use them against innocent people. He burned my forge and had me beaten. I survived, but my workshop was destroyed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:861:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}Now I carry my skills wherever I go, maintaining and improving the arms of those I travel with. A good blade in trained hands can change the course of a battle." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:862:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}A craftsman of principle is rare and precious." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:863:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}Principles don't keep you warm in winter." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:864:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}Keep me fed and give me a forge, and I'll keep your steel sharp." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:865:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_7_text}A iron-bender from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:866:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}There is no freedom like the wind in your face atop a swift horse..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:867:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}I served in the mounted forces of Dol Guldur, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the elves and men of the West's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the uruks of the fortress." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:868:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}During a raid, my commander ordered us to trample fleeing civilians - they might be enemy sympathizers, he said. I refused and was court-martialed for disobedience." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:869:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}Now I ride alone, my lance for hire to those who fight with honor. The open road suits me better than garrison duty ever did." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:870:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}A rider who values life over orders has true courage." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:871:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}Disobedience in battle can cost more lives than it saves." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:872:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}Give me a mount and a cause worth riding for." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:873:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_8_text}A warg-rider from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:874:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}An arrow loosed at the right moment can change history..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:875:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}I was the finest marksman in Dol Guldur, able to split an arrow at two hundred paces. I served as the Necromancer's personal guard archer, watching over the uruks of the fortress from the highest vantage points." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:876:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}But I witnessed my captain murder a prisoner in cold blood and reported it. The captain was connected to powerful families, and suddenly I was the one accused of crimes I didn't commit." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:877:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}I escaped before they could silence me permanently. Now I offer my bow to those who still believe in justice. Every arrow I loose carries the memory of that murdered prisoner." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:878:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}Justice is worth fighting for, even at great cost." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:879:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}The dead don't care about justice." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:880:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}My bow is steady and my aim is true. Will you have me?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:881:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_dolguldur_9_text}A eye-poker from Dol Guldur, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:895:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1_text}Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the Horse-lords of Rohan grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:901:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text}I served as a scout in the hills of Dunland, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the Gap of Rohan and can track a fox through running water." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:902:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text}During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the Horse-lords of Rohan. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:909:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3_text}I trained as a healer in the hills of Dunland, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Dunlendings. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the Horse-lords of Rohan, saving countless lives." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:927:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5_text}Now I trust no one but myself, though I'd rather use my skills openly than skulk in shadows forever. the Horse-lords of Rohan has spies everywhere, and someone needs to counter them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:933:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6_text}I commanded forces in the hills of Dunland, studying the art of war under the clan chiefs's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the Horse-lords of Rohan when we were outnumbered." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:949:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8_text}I served in the mounted forces of the hills of Dunland, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the Horse-lords of Rohan's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Dunlendings." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:977:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_harad_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_harad_1_text}Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the men of Gondor grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:984:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_harad_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_harad_2_text}During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the men of Gondor. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:991:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_harad_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_harad_3_text}I trained as a healer in the lands of Harad, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Haradrim. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the men of Gondor, saving countless lives." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1009:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_harad_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_harad_5_text}Now I trust no one but myself, though I'd rather use my skills openly than skulk in shadows forever. the men of Gondor has spies everywhere, and someone needs to counter them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1015:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_harad_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_harad_6_text}I commanded forces in the lands of Harad, studying the art of war under the Serpent Lords's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the men of Gondor when we were outnumbered." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1031:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_harad_8" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_harad_8_text}I served in the mounted forces of the lands of Harad, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the men of Gondor's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Haradrim." />
