C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1129:<!-- UMBAR wanderer backstories -->
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1130:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_0" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_0_text}Knowledge is the truest weapon, and I have spent a lifetime gathering it..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1131:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_0" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_0_text}I studied the ancient arts of the Haven of Umbar, learning the secrets of construction and siege-craft from the Corsair Lords's own engineers. My family served as builders for generations, raising walls and forging defenses." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1132:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_0" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_0_text}But when a rival accused me of weakening our fortifications for the enemy, I was cast out despite my innocence. The walls I built still stand, though my name has been struck from the builders' rolls." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1133:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_0" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_0_text}Now I wander, offering my knowledge to those who value skill over politics. The Shadow grows, and the Corsairs of Umbar need fortifications more than ever." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1134:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_0" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_0_text}A builder's skills are worth more than a warrior's in these dark times." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1135:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_0" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_0_text}Stone walls won't stop what's coming." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1136:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_0" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_0_text}If you need one who can build as well as fight, I am at your service." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1137:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_0" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_0_text}A navigator from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1138:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_1" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_1_text}My blade has tasted the blood of many foes, yet I fight on..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1139:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_1" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_1_text}I was a champion of the Haven of Umbar, trained since youth in the arts of war. My skill with blade and shield earned me renown among the Corsairs of Umbar, and I served the Corsair Lords with unwavering loyalty." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1140:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_1" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_1_text}But honor demanded I challenge a corrupt commander who sent soldiers to die for personal glory. I won the duel but lost my position - the commander had powerful allies who saw me banished." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1141:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_1_text}Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the navy of Gondor grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1142:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_1" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_1_text}A warrior who fights for honor deserves respect." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1143:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_1" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_1_text}Perhaps you should have been more careful about choosing your battles." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1144:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_1" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_1_text}My blade is yours, if you'll have it." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1145:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_1" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_1_text}A blade captain from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1146:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_2" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_2_text}The wild places hold secrets that town-folk never dream of..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1147:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_2" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_2_text}I served as a scout in the Haven of Umbar, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the sea fortress and can track a fox through running water." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1148:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_2_text}During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the navy of Gondor. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1149:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_2" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_2_text}I refused to look away and paid the price. Now I range alone, using my skills to survive and help those who cross my path. The wilds are dangerous, but at least they're honest." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1150:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_2" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_2_text}The truth is worth any price." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1151:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_2" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_2_text}Sometimes survival requires compromise." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1152:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_2" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_2_text}I offer my eyes, my bow, and my knowledge of the wild." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1153:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_2" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_2_text}A sea scout from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1154:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_3" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_3_text}I have seen too many die from wounds that could have been healed..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1155:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_3_text}I trained as a healer in the Haven of Umbar, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Corsairs of Umbar. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the navy of Gondor, saving countless lives." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1156:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_3" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_3_text}But when a noble's son died despite my best efforts - the wound was beyond any healer's skill - his father blamed me and demanded my execution. I fled rather than face a rigged tribunal." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1157:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_3" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_3_text}Now I practice my art wherever I can, helping the sick and wounded regardless of their allegiance. Death does not discriminate, and neither should healing." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1158:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_3" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_3_text}A healer's compassion is a rare gift." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1159:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_3" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_3_text}Healing enemies only makes more work for warriors." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1160:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_3" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_3_text}If you value the lives of your people, let me tend to them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1161:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_3" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_3_text}A ship surgeon from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1162:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_4" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_4_text}Gold opens doors that swords cannot..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1163:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_4" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_4_text}I built a trading network across the Haven of Umbar, connecting the Corsairs of Umbar with goods from distant lands. My caravans brought prosperity and rare supplies that the Corsair Lords valued highly." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1164:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_4" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_4_text}But a jealous merchant house conspired to frame me for smuggling contraband. They seized my warehouses, scattered my contacts, and left me with nothing but the clothes on my back and the knowledge in my head." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1165:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_4" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_4_text}Now I seek to rebuild, one deal at a time. The coming war will need supplies and logistics, and I know every trade route from the corsair docks to the far reaches." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1166:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_4" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_4_text}Commerce is the lifeblood of any campaign." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1167:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_4" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_4_text}Pretty words from someone who lost everything." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1168:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_4" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_4_text}I can make your gold stretch further than you'd believe. Hire me." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1169:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_4" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_4_text}A prize merchant from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1170:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_5" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_5_text}In the shadows, one learns the true nature of power..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1171:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_5" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_5_text}I grew up in the back alleys of the Haven of Umbar, learning to survive by wit and quick hands. Eventually, I was recruited by the Corsair Lords's intelligence network, using my skills for the Corsairs of Umbar's benefit." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1172:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_5" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_5_text}But when I uncovered a conspiracy reaching into the highest circles of power, I became a liability. Those I served decided I knew too much and sent assassins. I killed two of them and fled." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1173:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_5_text}Now I trust no one but myself, though I'd rather use my skills openly than skulk in shadows forever. the navy of Gondor has spies everywhere, and someone needs to counter them." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1174:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_5" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_5_text}A shadow-worker who serves the light is valuable indeed." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1175:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_5" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_5_text}How can anyone trust a self-admitted spy?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1176:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_5" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_5_text}I work best when no one sees me coming. Will you have me?" />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1177:<string id="generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_5" text="{=aom_generic_backstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_5_text}A cutthroat from the Haven of Umbar, seeking purpose and adventure." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1178:<string id="prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_6" text="{=aom_prebackstory.spc_wanderer_umbar_6_text}Battles are won in the mind before a single blade is drawn..." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1179:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_umbar_6_text}I commanded forces in the Haven of Umbar, studying the art of war under the Corsair Lords's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the navy of Gondor when we were outnumbered." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1180:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_6" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_umbar_6_text}But a jealous superior took credit for my victories and blamed me for a retreat that saved our army from annihilation. The council sided with him - he had connections I lacked." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1181:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_6" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_umbar_6_text}Stripped of rank, I now offer my mind and experience to those who judge by merit, not birth. The coming war will need commanders who can think, not just those who can swing a sword." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1182:<string id="response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_6" text="{=aom_response_1.spc_wanderer_umbar_6_text}A thinking warrior is the most dangerous kind." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1183:<string id="response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_6" text="{=aom_response_2.spc_wanderer_umbar_6_text}Plans rarely survive contact with the enemy." />
C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:1184:<string id="backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umbar_6" text="{=aom_backstory_d.spc_wanderer_umb

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:24:<string id="taom_career_watchman_of_stangard_desc" text="{=taom_career_watchman_of_stangard_desc}A grizzled river-warden of Stangard who patrols the Anduin crossings by flatboat and on foot, guarding Rohan's eastern flank through endurance, local knowledge, and a boatswain's tenacious grip on contested ground." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:566:<string id="taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc" text="{=taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc}You read the plains of Rohan as a book. +5% party spotting range." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:594:<string id="taom_moa_t3_a_p2_desc" text="{=taom_moa_t3_a_p2_desc}You are the finest shot in all of Rohan. +75 health." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:608:<string id="taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc" text="{=taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc}The finest bowmen of Rohan rally to your banner. +5 party size." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:624:<string id="taom_ew_t1_b_p2" text="{=taom_ew_t1_b_p2}Rohan Warband" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:637:<string id="taom_ew_t2_a_p3_desc" text="{=taom_ew_t2_a_p3_desc}The cry of Rohan heartens all who hear it. +8% troop morale." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:658:<string id="taom_ew_t3_a_p4" text="{=taom_ew_t3_a_p4}Rohan's Glory" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:171:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc}Your family were scouts and trackers, ensuring Saruman's forces moved unseen across the plains of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:275:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc}Your family served the marshals of the Riddermark, riding with them in defense of Rohan's borders. Your father was a skilled horseman and warrior." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:279:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc}Your family were traders in the great hall-city of Edoras, bringing goods from across the Riddermark and beyond to the people of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:295:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc}Your family drifted across the Wold, the wild grasslands between Rohan and the Brown Lands. They survived by their wits and occasional service as scouts." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:419:<string id="taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc}You felt a deep bond with animals, particularly horses. The stable hands marveled at how you could calm even the most spirited steed, and your skill in caring for wounds brought whispers that you might rival the horsemasters of Rohan one day." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:693:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text}Traveled with the camp followers of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:957:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text}Scouted the plains of Rohan for Saruman's eyes." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1063:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc}You spent your youth learning the art of mounted war in service to one of the marshals of the Riddermark, drilling with lance and sword in the wide grasslands of Rohan. Horsemanship was not taught in the Riddermark — it was breathed." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1067:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_desc}You carried wares and prices between the holds of Edoras and the smaller towns of Rohan, learning to read people and close a deal before the day's light faded. The plains were long and empty and the conversation at market stalls made the world go round." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1071:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_desc}You worked your family's pastures in the Westfold, learning to handle horses almost before you could walk, and were pressed into levy service as soon as you were tall enough for the spear. The rolling plains of western Rohan were your school." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1075:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_desc}You learned to shape the bright steel of Rohan in the forge-houses of Aldburg, making blades and fittings for the Rohirrim. You went home each night with arms aching and a pride in craft that no battlefield could diminish." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1351:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_desc}You identified the spy through behavioral inconsistency, confronted him privately, and gave him a choice that made the decision simple. He fed false information back to Edoras for two seasons before anyone in Rohan suspected. You received nothing in writing for the achievement." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:23:<string id="str_faction_official.vlandia" text="{=taom_str_faction_official.vlandia}a noble of Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:24:<string id="str_faction_official.vlandia_f" text="{=taom_str_faction_official.vlandia_f}a lady of Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:33:<string id="str_faction_informal_name_for_culture.vlandia" text="{=taom_str_faction_informal_name_for_culture.vlandia}Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:228:<string id="str_culture_description.vlandia" text="{=taom_str_culture_description.vlandia}The Rohirrim, known as the Horse-lords, are the proud and noble people of Rohan, a realm of wide open plains and rolling hills. They are renowned for their skill as riders and their unmatched cavalry, which forms the backbone of their military strength. Living in a tightly-knit feudal society, the Rohirrim are led by a king and a loyal nobility who are bound by honor and tradition to protect their land and people. They are fiercely independent, valuing freedom above all, and their warriors are trained to fight with spears, swords, and bows, all while astride their powerful steeds." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:1522:<string id="taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_trait_0" text="{=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_trait_0}Grudge against Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:1528:<string id="taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_weakness_2" text="{=taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_weakness_2}Wedged between Rohan and Isengard" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:1543:<string id="taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_desc" text="{=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_desc}Saruman's industrial fortress at Orthanc. The Ring of Isengard runs day and night — Uruk-hai legions, forge-line crossbows, war wargs. Isengard's one town swells to twenty notables: a recruitment hub equal to many cities of Rohan. Saruman's Grip alienates every neighbor." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:1567:<string id="taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_weakness_2" text="{=taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_weakness_2}Surrounded by Rohan and Fangorn" />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_partyTemplates.xml:869:<!-- ===================== ROHAN ===================== -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_skill_sets.xml:1214:<!-- ROHAN wanderer skills -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:147:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}I'm a simple creature, I fight, I kill, I take what I want. Served in the raiding parties that strike fast into Gondor, Rohan, wherever the captains point us. I don't ask questions, don't play politics. Point me at the enemy, I break them. My record speaks for itself, twenty successful raids, never failed an objective." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:343:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}I led warbands against the Rohirrim, raiding their villages, burning their fields. No mercy, no hesitation, absolute results. My units left nothing alive, not warriors, not elderly, not children. Saruman wanted fear spread through Rohan, and I delivered it in rivers of blood." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:351:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}Simple existence, fight, kill, win. Led assault teams against Rohan's outlying fortresses. First through the breach every time, blade red with enemy blood. My warriors followed because I never asked them to do what I wouldn't do. Earned my position through strength, not breeding or favor." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:359:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}I commanded scouting parties into Rohan, gathering intelligence, eliminating patrols. Good at my work, effective, ruthless, reliable. But I saw how Saruman's favorites advanced while competent warriors like me stagnated. Merit alone doesn't bring promotion when the White Wizard plays favorites." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:375:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}Worked in Orthanc itself, carrying messages between Saruman and his agents. Trusted position, I saw correspondence with Mordor, with the Dunlendings, with corrupt officials throughout Rohan. Learned valuable secrets about troop movements, alliances, planned operations. Knowledge is power, and I accumulated plenty." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:457:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text}I managed armed caravans to the far kingdoms, Gondor, Rohan, sometimes even the Woodland Realm. Negotiated with my tongue, fought with my axe when words failed. Profitable work, until I noticed patterns. Dark folk asking questions, movements of suspicious groups." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:481:<!-- ROHAN wanderer backstories -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:483:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text}I was a Marshal of the Westfold, commanding a éored of riders. We patrolled from Helm's Deep to the Gap of Rohan, watching for threats from Dunland and beyond. But dark rumors came from Isengard." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:498:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text}On patrol near the Gap of Rohan, we found burnt villages - not raided by orcs, but destroyed by men. The tracks led toward Isengard. When we reported this, we were told we were mistaken, that Dunlendings were to blame." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:533:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text}The horses began refusing to go near the Gap of Rohan - even the bravest stallions would rear and flee. Animals sense evil before men do. When I reported this to the horse masters, they blamed bad training." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:895:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1_text}Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the Horse-lords of Rohan grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:901:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text}I served as a scout in the hills of Dunland, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the Gap of Rohan and can track a fox through running water." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:902:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text}During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the Horse-lords of Rohan. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:909:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3_text}I trained as a healer in the hills of Dunland, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Dunlendings. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the Horse-lords of Rohan, saving countless lives." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:927:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5_text}Now I trust no one but myself, though I'd rather use my skills openly than skulk in shadows forever. the Horse-lords of Rohan has spies everywhere, and someone needs to counter them." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:933:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6_text}I commanded forces in the hills of Dunland, studying the art of war under the clan chiefs's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the Horse-lords of Rohan when we were outnumbered." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:949:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8_text}I served in the mounted forces of the hills of Dunland, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the Horse-lords of Rohan's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Dunlendings." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderers.xml:1486:<!-- ==================== ROHAN WANDERERS ==================== -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:65:<string id="TAOM_rohan" text="{=TAOM_rohan}Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:67:<string id="TAOM_rohan_short" text="{=TAOM_rohan_short}Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:69:<string id="TAOM_rohan_title" text="{=TAOM_rohan_title}Kingdom of Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:73:<string id="TAOM_rohan_desc" text="{=TAOM_rohan_desc}Known as the Riddermark, Rohan is a vast and sweeping kingdom of open plains and rolling hills, where the mighty Rohirrim—skilled horsemen and fierce warriors—dwell. Founded by Eorl the Young after his legendary ride to Gondor's aid, Rohan has long stood as a steadfast ally of Gondor against the darkness of Mordor. From the golden halls of Meduseld in Edoras, its kings rule over a proud and resilient people who live by the bond of horse and rider. The Rohirrim are famed for their cavalry charges, their songs of valor, and their unwavering courage. Though the shadow of Saruman has threatened their borders, the sons and daughters of Rohan remain ever ready to answer the call to arms, defending their homeland and the free peoples of Middle-earth." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:1045:<string id="aom_empire_desc" text="{=aom_empire_desc}The Dunlendings are a rugged and fierce people, dwelling in the wild hills and untamed lands west of Rohan. Long resentful of the Rohirrim, whom they see as invaders of their ancestral homes, the Dunlendings are united by their shared heritage and fierce independence. Skilled in guerrilla warfare and survival, they rely on cunning and ferocity to overcome their enemies. Though often dismissed as simple hill folk, the Dunlendings are a proud and enduring people, fiercely protective of their lands and ways of life. Driven by a deep-seated grudge against Rohan, they have allied themselves with the forces of darkness, seeking revenge and the restoration of their lost lands." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:1053:<string id="aom_vlandia_desc" text="{=aom_vlandia_desc}The Rohirrim, or Horse-lords of Rohan, are renowned for their unmatched cavalry and deep bond with their steeds. Proud and free-spirited, they dwell in the rolling plains of the Riddermark, living in villages and strongholds like Edoras. Guided by their King and loyal to their people, the Rohirrim prize honor, loyalty, and courage. Their warriors ride fearlessly into battle, forming the backbone of Middle-earth’s resistance against the shadow. Though steadfast in their traditions, the Rohirrim are ever ready to defend their land and allies, wielding spears, swords, and shields with precision." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:2133:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_1" text="{=TAOM_hero_1_1}Brenin Wulf rules the wild clans of Dunland with an iron fist. Known as the Ironhand, he united the scattered hill tribes through conquest and cunning. He dreams of reclaiming the lands taken by the Horse-lords of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:2139:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_411" text="{=TAOM_hero_1_411}Grimwulf Ironfang carries on his father's legacy of raiding and warfare against Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:2625:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_1" text="{=TAOM_hero_4_1}Theoden, King of Rohan, rules from Meduseld in Edoras. Once bewitched by Saruman's servant Grima, he was freed by Gandalf and led his people to glory at Helm's Deep and the Pelennor Fields." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:2627:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_2" text="{=TAOM_hero_4_2}Elfhild was queen of Rohan, mother of Theodred. She died in childbirth, a grief that shadowed Theoden's reign." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:2629:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_7" text="{=TAOM_hero_4_7}Theodred was the only son of King Theoden, Prince of Rohan. He fell defending the Fords of Isen against Saruman's Uruk-hai." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:2699:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_24_1" text="{=TAOM_hero_4_24_1}Eowyn, Lady of Rohan, is sister to Eomer and niece to Theoden. She slew the Witch-King at the Pelennor, striking down the terror of the ages." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:2705:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_24_4" text="{=TAOM_hero_4_24_4}Siegeberht patrols the borders of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_xslt_strings.xml:2707:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_26" text="{=TAOM_hero_4_26}Peric commands riders along the Gap of Rohan." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\career_system\taom_career_choices.xml:1822:description="{=taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc}You read the plains of Rohan as a book. +5% party spotting range."
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\career_system\taom_career_choices.xml:1952:description="{=taom_moa_t3_a_p2_desc}You are the finest shot in all of Rohan. +75 health."
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\career_system\taom_career_choices.xml:2014:description="{=taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc}The finest bowmen of Rohan rally to your banner. +5 party size."
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\career_system\taom_career_choices.xml:2023:<!-- ║ ROHAN — Eotheod Windrider (Cavalry / Shock)                     ║ -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\career_system\taom_career_choices.xml:2101:display_name="{=taom_ew_t1_b_p2}Rohan Warband"
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\career_system\taom_career_choices.xml:2156:description="{=taom_ew_t2_a_p3_desc}The cry of Rohan heartens all who hear it. +8% troop morale."
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\career_system\taom_career_choices.xml:2255:display_name="{=taom_ew_t3_a_p4}Rohan's Glory"
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\career_system\taom_career_choices.xml:2311:<!-- ║ ROHAN — Watchman of Stangard (Melee / Guardian)                 ║ -->

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\career_system\taom_careers.xml:205:description="{=taom_career_watchman_of_stangard_desc}A grizzled river-warden of Stangard who patrols the Anduin crossings by flatboat and on foot, guarding Rohan's eastern flank through endurance, local knowledge, and a boatswain's tenacious grip on contested ground."
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\adulthood_menu.json:580:"description": "You identified the spy through behavioral inconsistency, confronted him privately, and gave him a choice that made the decision simple. He fed false information back to Edoras for two seasons before anyone in Rohan suspected. You received nothing in writing for the achievement.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\cc_body_properties.xml:24:vlandia    → Rohan        (XSLT-modified vanilla Vlandia)
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\cc_body_properties.xml:39:<!-- Rohan (XSLT culture id: vlandia) -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\childhood_menu.json:55:"description": "You felt a deep bond with animals, particularly horses. The stable hands marveled at how you could calm even the most spirited steed, and your skill in caring for wounds brought whispers that you might rival the horsemasters of Rohan one day.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\education_menu.json:606:"text": "Scouted the plains of Rohan for Saruman's eyes.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\education_menu.json:997:"description": "You spent your youth learning the art of mounted war in service to one of the marshals of the Riddermark, drilling with lance and sword in the wide grasslands of Rohan. Horsemanship was not taught in the Riddermark — it was breathed.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\education_menu.json:1012:"description": "You carried wares and prices between the holds of Edoras and the smaller towns of Rohan, learning to read people and close a deal before the day's light faded. The plains were long and empty and the conversation at market stalls made the world go round.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\education_menu.json:1027:"description": "You worked your family's pastures in the Westfold, learning to handle horses almost before you could walk, and were pressed into levy service as soon as you were tall enough for the spear. The rolling plains of western Rohan were your school.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\education_menu.json:1042:"description": "You learned to shape the bright steel of Rohan in the forge-houses of Aldburg, making blades and fittings for the Rohirrim. You went home each night with arms aching and a pride in craft that no battlefield could diminish.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\parents_menu.json:492:"description": "Your family were scouts and trackers, ensuring Saruman's forces moved unseen across the plains of Rohan.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\parents_menu.json:809:"description": "Your family served the marshals of the Riddermark, riding with them in defense of Rohan's borders. Your father was a skilled horseman and warrior.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\parents_menu.json:821:"description": "Your family were traders in the great hall-city of Edoras, bringing goods from across the Riddermark and beyond to the people of Rohan.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\parents_menu.json:869:"description": "Your family drifted across the Wold, the wild grasslands between Rohan and the Brown Lands. They survived by their wits and occasional service as scouts.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\charactercreation\youth_menu.json:810:"text": "Traveled with the camp followers of Rohan.",

His knowledge of Rohan's borderlands makes him invaluable for lightning strikes against enemy supply lines." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_career_strings_por-BR.xml:55:<string id="taom_career_watchman_of_stangard_desc" text="Um experiente guardião do rio de Stangard que patrulha as travessias do Anduin em barcos e a pé, protegendo o flanco oriental de Rohan através de resistência, conhecimento local e uma tenacidade de marinheiro em terreno contestado." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_career_strings_por-BR.xml:1127:<string id="taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc" text="Você lê as planícies de Rohan como um livro. +5% alcance de detecção do grupo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_career_strings_por-BR.xml:1183:<string id="taom_moa_t3_a_p2_desc" text="Você é o melhor atirador de todo Rohan. +75 de saúde." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_career_strings_por-BR.xml:1211:<string id="taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc" text="Os melhores arqueiros de Rohan se reúnem à sua bandeira. +5 tamanho do grupo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_career_strings_por-BR.xml:1243:<string id="taom_ew_t1_b_p2" text="Bando de Guerra de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_career_strings_por-BR.xml:1269:<string id="taom_ew_t2_a_p3_desc" text="O grito de Rohan anima todos que o ouvem. +8% moral das tropas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_career_strings_por-BR.xml:1311:<string id="taom_ew_t3_a_p4" text="Glória de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:179:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc" text="Sua família era composta por batedores e rastreadores, garantindo que as forças de Saruman se movessem despercebidas pelas planícies de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:283:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc" text="Sua família servia aos marechais do Riddermark, cavalgando com eles na defesa das fronteiras de Rohan. Seu pai era um cavaleiro e guerreiro habilidoso." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:287:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc" text="Sua família era composta por comerciantes na grande cidade-salão de Edoras, trazendo mercadorias de todo o Riddermark e além para o povo de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:303:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc" text="Sua família vagou pela Charneca, as selvagens pradarias entre Rohan e as Terras Pardas. Eles sobreviveram pela astúcia e serviços ocasionais como batedores." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:423:<string id="taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc" text="Você sentia um vínculo profundo com animais, particularmente cavalos. Os tratadores das estrebarias maravilhavam-se de como você podia acalmar até o corcel mais fogoso, e sua habilidade em tratar feridas trazia sussurros de que você poderia rivalizar com os mestres de cavalos de Rohan um dia." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:693:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text" text="Viajou com os seguidores de acampamento de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:953:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text" text="Explorou as planícies de Rohan para os olhos de Saruman." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1059:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc" text="Você passou sua juventude aprendendo a arte da guerra montada a serviço de um dos marechais da Marca dos Cavaleiros, treinando com lança e espada nas amplas planícies de Rohan. Equitação não era ensinada na Marca dos Cavaleiros — era respirada." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1063:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_desc" text="Você transportou mercadorias e preços entre os redutos de Edoras e as cidades menores de Rohan, aprendendo a ler pessoas e fechar um negócio antes que a luz do dia se apagasse. As planícies eram longas e vazias e a conversa nas bancas do mercado fazia o mundo girar." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1067:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_desc" text="Você trabalhou nas pastagens da sua família no Folde Oeste, aprendendo a lidar com cavalos quase antes de poder andar, e foi recrutado para a milícia assim que ficou alto o suficiente para a lança. As planícies ondulantes do oeste de Rohan foram sua escola." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1071:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_desc" text="Você aprendeu a moldar o aço brilhante de Rohan nas casas de forja de Aldburg, fazendo lâminas e acessórios para os Rohirrim. Você voltava para casa todas as noites com os braços doendo e um orgulho no ofício que nenhum campo de batalha poderia diminuir." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1341:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_text" text="Você converteu um espião de Rohan em um agente duplo trabalhando para Isengard." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_cc_strings_por-BR.xml:1343:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_desc" text="Você identificou o espião através de inconsistências comportamentais, o confrontou em particular, e lhe deu uma escolha que tornou a decisão simples. Ele alimentou informações falsas de volta para Edoras por duas estações antes que alguém em Rohan suspeitasse. Você não recebeu nada por escrito pela conquista." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_module_strings_por-BR.xml:41:<string id="taom_str_faction_official.vlandia" text="um nobre de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_module_strings_por-BR.xml:43:<string id="taom_str_faction_official.vlandia_f" text="uma dama de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_module_strings_por-BR.xml:61:<string id="taom_str_faction_informal_name_for_culture.vlandia" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_module_strings_por-BR.xml:379:<string id="taom_str_culture_description.vlandia" text="Os Rohirrim, conhecidos como os Senhores dos Cavalos, são o povo orgulhoso e nobre de Rohan, um reino de vastas planícies abertas e colinas ondulantes. São renomados por sua habilidade como cavaleiros e sua inigualável cavalaria, que forma a espinha dorsal de sua força militar. Vivendo em uma sociedade feudal unida, os Rohirrim são liderados por um rei e uma nobreza leal que estão ligados pela honra e tradição para proteger sua terra e seu povo. São ferozmente independentes, valorizando a liberdade acima de tudo, e seus guerreiros são treinados para lutar com lanças, espadas e arcos, sempre montados em seus poderosos corcéis." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_module_strings_por-BR.xml:2641:<string id="taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_trait_0" text="Rancor contra Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_module_strings_por-BR.xml:2653:<string id="taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_weakness_2" text="Espremidos entre Rohan e Isengard" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_module_strings_por-BR.xml:2683:<string id="taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_desc" text="A fortaleza industrial de Saruman em Orthanc. O Círculo de Isengard funciona dia e noite — legiões Uruk-hai, bestas de linha de forja, wargs de guerra. A única cidade de Isengard incha para vinte notáveis: um centro de recrutamento equivalente a muitas cidades de Rohan. O Controle de Saruman aliena todos os vizinhos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_module_strings_por-BR.xml:2731:<string id="taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_weakness_2" text="Cercado por Rohan e Fangorn" />

Hordas Vorazes comem tanto quanto matam." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_module_strings_por-BR.xml:3787:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_weakness_2" text="Cercado por florestas hostis" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:297:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text" text="Sou uma criatura simples, luto, mato, tomo o que quero. Servi nos grupos de ataque que atacam rapidamente Gondor, Rohan, onde quer que os capitães nos apontem. Não faço perguntas, não jogo política. Aponte-me o inimigo, eu os quebro. Meu registro fala por si, vinte ataques bem-sucedidos, nunca falhei um objetivo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:681:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text" text="Liderei bandos de guerra contra os Rohirrim, saqueando suas vilas, queimando seus campos. Sem piedade, sem hesitação, resultados absolutos. Minhas unidades não deixavam nada vivo, nem guerreiros, nem idosos, nem crianças. Saruman queria espalhar medo por Rohan, e eu entreguei isso em rios de sangue." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:697:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text" text="Existência simples, lutar, matar, vencer. Liderei equipes de assalto contra as fortalezas periféricas de Rohan. Primeiro pela brecha toda vez, lâmina vermelha com sangue inimigo. Meus guerreiros me seguiam porque nunca pedi que fizessem o que eu não faria. Conquistei minha posição através da força, não por linhagem ou favor." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:713:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text" text="Comandei patrulhas de reconhecimento em Rohan, coletando inteligência, eliminando patrulhas. Bom no meu trabalho, eficaz, implacável, confiável. Mas vi como os favoritos de Saruman avançavam enquanto guerreiros competentes como eu estagnavam. Mérito sozinho não traz promoção quando o Mago Branco favorece seus escolhidos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:745:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text" text="Trabalhei em Orthanc propriamente dita, levando mensagens entre Saruman e seus agentes. Posição de confiança, vi correspondência com Mordor, com os Dunlandeses, com oficiais corruptos por toda Rohan. Aprendi segredos valiosos sobre movimentos de tropas, alianças, operações planejadas. Conhecimento é poder, e acumulei bastante." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:905:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text" text="Gerenciei caravanas armadas para os reinos distantes, Gondor, Rohan, às vezes até o Reino da Floresta. Negociava com minha língua, lutava com meu machado quando as palavras falhavam. Trabalho lucrativo, até que notei padrões. Povo sombrio fazendo perguntas, movimentos de grupos suspeitos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:953:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text" text="Eu era um Marechal da Fronteiriça Oeste, comandando um éored de cavaleiros. Patrulhávamos do Abismo de Helm até a Passagem de Rohan, vigiando ameaças de Dunlândia e além. Mas rumores sombrios vieram de Isengard." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:983:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text" text="Em patrulha perto da Passagem de Rohan, encontramos vilas queimadas - não saqueadas por orcs, mas destruídas por homens. Os rastros levavam em direção a Isengard. Quando relatamos isso, disseram-nos que estávamos enganados, que Dunlendinos eram os culpados." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1053:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text" text="Os cavalos começaram a recusar-se a ir perto da Brecha de Rohan - até os garanhões mais corajosos empinavam e fugiam. Animais sentem o mal antes dos homens. Quando relatei isso aos mestres de cavalos, culparam treinamento ruim." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1753:<string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1_text" text="Agora vendo minha espada para causas dignas. Os Senhores dos Cavalos de Rohan ficam mais ousados a cada dia, e não faltam batalhas para lutar para aqueles com coragem de enfrentá-las." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1765:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text" text="Servi como batedor nas colinas de Dunlândia, percorrendo muito além de nossas fronteiras para vigiar ameaças. Conheço cada caminho através da Fenda de Rohan e posso rastrear uma raposa através de água corrente." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1767:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text" text="Durante uma patrulha, descobri uma conspiração entre nosso próprio povo - contrabandistas trabalhando com os Senhores dos Cavalos de Rohan. Quando relatei, descobri que os contrabandistas haviam comprado proteção de alguém poderoso. Disseram-me para esquecer o que tinha visto." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1781:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3_text" text="Treinei como curandeiro nas colinas de Dunlândia, aprendendo as propriedades de cada erva e remédio conhecido pelos Dunlendinos. Cuidei dos feridos após cada escaramuça com os Senhores dos Cavalos de Rohan, salvando inúmeras vidas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1817:<string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5_text" text="Agora não confio em ninguém além de mim mesmo, embora prefira usar minhas habilidades abertamente do que me esgueirar nas sombras para sempre. Os Senhores dos Cavalos de Rohan têm espiões em toda parte, e alguém precisa detê-los." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1829:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6_text" text="Comandei forças nas colinas de Dunlândia, estudando a arte da guerra sob os capitães mais experientes dos chefes de clã. Minhas inovações táticas venceram vários confrontos contra os Senhores dos Cavalos de Rohan quando estávamos em desvantagem numérica." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_por-BR.xml:1861:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8_text" text="Servi nas forças montadas das colinas de Dunlândia, patrulhando as fronteiras e atacando rapidamente os grupos de invasores dos Senhores dos Cavalos de Rohan. Minha equitação era inigualável entre os Dunlendinos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:67:<string id="TAOM_rohan" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:69:<string id="TAOM_rohan_short" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:71:<string id="TAOM_rohan_title" text="Reino de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:75:<string id="TAOM_rohan_desc" text="Conhecida como a Marca dos Cavaleiros, Rohan é um vasto e extenso reino de planícies abertas e colinas ondulantes, onde habitam os poderosos Rohirrim — cavaleiros habilidosos e guerreiros ferozes. Fundada por Eorl, o Jovem, após sua lendária cavalgada em auxílio a Gondor, Rohan há muito permanece como um aliado firme de Gondor contra a escuridão de Mordor. Dos salões dourados de Meduseld em Edoras, seus reis governam sobre um povo orgulhoso e resiliente que vive pelo vínculo entre cavalo e cavaleiro. Os Rohirrim são famosos por suas cargas de cavalaria, suas canções de valor e sua coragem inabalável. Embora a sombra de Saruman tenha ameaçado suas fronteiras, os filhos e filhas de Rohan permanecem sempre prontos para atender o chamado às armas, defendendo sua terra natal e os povos livres da Terra-média." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:1037:<string id="aom_empire_desc" text="Os Dunlandinos são um povo rude e feroz, que habita as colinas selvagens e terras indomadas a oeste de Rohan. Há muito ressentidos com os Rohirrim, a quem veem como invasores de suas terras ancestrais, os Dunlandinos são unidos por sua herança compartilhada e feroz independência. Hábeis em guerrilha e sobrevivência, confiam na astúcia e ferocidade para superar seus inimigos. Embora frequentemente desprezados como simples montanheses, os Dunlandinos são um povo orgulhoso e resistente, que protege ferozmente suas terras e modo de vida. Movidos por um rancor profundo contra Rohan, aliaram-se às forças das trevas, buscando vingança e a restauração de suas terras perdidas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:1045:<string id="aom_vlandia_desc" text="Os Rohirrim, ou Senhores dos Cavalos de Rohan, são renomados por sua cavalaria incomparável e profundo vínculo com seus corcéis. Orgulhosos e de espírito livre, habitam as planícies ondulantes de Riddermark, vivendo em aldeias e fortalezas como Edoras. Guiados por seu Rei e leais ao seu povo, os Rohirrim prezam a honra, lealdade e coragem. Seus guerreiros cavalgam destemidamente para a batalha, formando a espinha dorsal da resistência da Terra-média contra a sombra. Embora firmes em suas tradições, os Rohirrim estão sempre prontos para defender suas terras e aliados, empunhando lanças, espadas e escudos com precisão." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:2095:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_1" text="Brenin Wulf governa os clãs selvagens de Dunlândia com punho de ferro. Conhecido como o Mão-de-Ferro, ele uniu as tribos dispersas das colinas através de conquista e astúcia. Ele sonha em reconquistar as terras tomadas pelos Senhores-dos-Cavalos de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:2101:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_411" text="Grimwulf Presaferro perpetua o legado de seu pai de saques e guerras contra Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:2587:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_1" text="Théoden, Rei de Rohan, governa de Meduseld em Edoras. Outrora enfeitiçado pelo servo de Saruman, Gríma, foi libertado por Gandalf e conduziu seu povo à glória em Forte da Trombeta e nos Campos do Pelennor." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:2589:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_2" text="Elfhild foi rainha de Rohan, mãe de Théodred. Ela morreu no parto, uma dor que ensombrou o reinado de Théoden." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:2591:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_7" text="Théodred era o único filho do Rei Théoden, Príncipe de Rohan. Ele caiu defendendo os Vaus do Isen contra os Uruk-hai de Saruman." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:2661:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_24_1" text="Eowyn, Senhora de Rohan, é irmã de Eomer e sobrinha de Theoden. Ela matou o Rei-Bruxo no Pelennor, derrubando o terror das eras." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:2667:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_24_4" text="Siegeberht patrulha as fronteiras de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\BR\std_taom_xslt_strings_por-BR.xml:2669:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_26" text="Peric comanda cavaleiros ao longo da Passagem de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:3723:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_0" text="-50%军队影响力消耗(暗影指挥)" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:3725:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_1" text="+20%队伍规模上限(黑暗军团)" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:3727:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_2" text="+20%村庄志愿兵刷新速率(黑暗征召)" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:3729:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_3" text="+20%民兵老兵几率(黑暗征兵)" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:3731:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_4" text="多尔哥多城镇+1商人+1工匠+13帮派首领名士(共20名)" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\CNs\std_taom_module_strings_zho-CN.xml:3733:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_5" text="+10%村庄名士数量(隐秘陋屋)" />

Gefräßige Horden verschlingen so viel, wie sie erschlagen." />
