C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_module_strings_pol-PL.xml:3787:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_weakness_2" text="Surrounded by hostile forests" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:297:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text" text="I'm a simple creature, I fight, I kill, I take what I want. Served in the raiding parties that strike fast into Gondor, Rohan, wherever the captains point us. I don't ask questions, don't play politics. Point me at the enemy, I break them. My record speaks for itself, twenty successful raids, never failed an objective." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:681:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text" text="I led warbands against the Rohirrim, raiding their villages, burning their fields. No mercy, no hesitation, absolute results. My units left nothing alive, not warriors, not elderly, not children. Saruman wanted fear spread through Rohan, and I delivered it in rivers of blood." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:697:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text" text="Simple existence, fight, kill, win. Led assault teams against Rohan's outlying fortresses. First through the breach every time, blade red with enemy blood. My warriors followed because I never asked them to do what I wouldn't do. Earned my position through strength, not breeding or favor." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:713:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text" text="I commanded scouting parties into Rohan, gathering intelligence, eliminating patrols. Good at my work, effective, ruthless, reliable. But I saw how Saruman's favorites advanced while competent warriors like me stagnated. Merit alone doesn't bring promotion when the White Wizard plays favorites." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:745:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text" text="Worked in Orthanc itself, carrying messages between Saruman and his agents. Trusted position, I saw correspondence with Mordor, with the Dunlendings, with corrupt officials throughout Rohan. Learned valuable secrets about troop movements, alliances, planned operations. Knowledge is power, and I accumulated plenty." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:905:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text" text="I managed armed caravans to the far kingdoms, Gondor, Rohan, sometimes even the Woodland Realm. Negotiated with my tongue, fought with my axe when words failed. Profitable work, until I noticed patterns. Dark folk asking questions, movements of suspicious groups." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:953:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text" text="I was a Marshal of the Westfold, commanding a éored of riders. We patrolled from Helm's Deep to the Gap of Rohan, watching for threats from Dunland and beyond. But dark rumors came from Isengard." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:983:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text" text="On patrol near the Gap of Rohan, we found burnt villages - not raided by orcs, but destroyed by men. The tracks led toward Isengard. When we reported this, we were told we were mistaken, that Dunlendings were to blame." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:1053:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text" text="The horses began refusing to go near the Gap of Rohan - even the bravest stallions would rear and flee. Animals sense evil before men do. When I reported this to the horse masters, they blamed bad training." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:1753:<string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1_text" text="Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the Horse-lords of Rohan grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:1765:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text" text="I served as a scout in the hills of Dunland, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the Gap of Rohan and can track a fox through running water." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:1767:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text" text="During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the Horse-lords of Rohan. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:1781:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3_text" text="I trained as a healer in the hills of Dunland, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Dunlendings. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the Horse-lords of Rohan, saving countless lives." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:1817:<string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5_text" text="Now I trust no one but myself, though I'd rather use my skills openly than skulk in shadows forever. the Horse-lords of Rohan has spies everywhere, and someone needs to counter them." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:1829:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6_text" text="I commanded forces in the hills of Dunland, studying the art of war under the clan chiefs's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the Horse-lords of Rohan when we were outnumbered." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_wanderer_strings_pol-PL.xml:1861:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8_text" text="I served in the mounted forces of the hills of Dunland, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the Horse-lords of Rohan's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Dunlendings." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:67:<string id="TAOM_rohan" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:69:<string id="TAOM_rohan_short" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:71:<string id="TAOM_rohan_title" text="Kingdom of Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:75:<string id="TAOM_rohan_desc" text="Known as the Riddermark, Rohan is a vast and sweeping kingdom of open plains and rolling hills, where the mighty Rohirrim—skilled horsemen and fierce warriors—dwell. Founded by Eorl the Young after his legendary ride to Gondor's aid, Rohan has long stood as a steadfast ally of Gondor against the darkness of Mordor. From the golden halls of Meduseld in Edoras, its kings rule over a proud and resilient people who live by the bond of horse and rider. The Rohirrim are famed for their cavalry charges, their songs of valor, and their unwavering courage. Though the shadow of Saruman has threatened their borders, the sons and daughters of Rohan remain ever ready to answer the call to arms, defending their homeland and the free peoples of Middle-earth." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:1037:<string id="aom_empire_desc" text="The Dunlendings are a rugged and fierce people, dwelling in the wild hills and untamed lands west of Rohan. Long resentful of the Rohirrim, whom they see as invaders of their ancestral homes, the Dunlendings are united by their shared heritage and fierce independence. Skilled in guerrilla warfare and survival, they rely on cunning and ferocity to overcome their enemies. Though often dismissed as simple hill folk, the Dunlendings are a proud and enduring people, fiercely protective of their lands and ways of life. Driven by a deep-seated grudge against Rohan, they have allied themselves with the forces of darkness, seeking revenge and the restoration of their lost lands." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:1045:<string id="aom_vlandia_desc" text="The Rohirrim, or Horse-lords of Rohan, are renowned for their unmatched cavalry and deep bond with their steeds. Proud and free-spirited, they dwell in the rolling plains of the Riddermark, living in villages and strongholds like Edoras. Guided by their King and loyal to their people, the Rohirrim prize honor, loyalty, and courage. Their warriors ride fearlessly into battle, forming the backbone of Middle-earth’s resistance against the shadow. Though steadfast in their traditions, the Rohirrim are ever ready to defend their land and allies, wielding spears, swords, and shields with precision." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:2095:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_1" text="Brenin Wulf rules the wild clans of Dunland with an iron fist. Known as the Ironhand, he united the scattered hill tribes through conquest and cunning. He dreams of reclaiming the lands taken by the Horse-lords of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:2101:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_411" text="Grimwulf Ironfang carries on his father's legacy of raiding and warfare against Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:2587:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_1" text="Theoden, King of Rohan, rules from Meduseld in Edoras. Once bewitched by Saruman's servant Grima, he was freed by Gandalf and led his people to glory at Helm's Deep and the Pelennor Fields." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:2589:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_2" text="Elfhild was queen of Rohan, mother of Theodred. She died in childbirth, a grief that shadowed Theoden's reign." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:2591:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_7" text="Theodred was the only son of King Theoden, Prince of Rohan. He fell defending the Fords of Isen against Saruman's Uruk-hai." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:2661:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_24_1" text="Eowyn, Lady of Rohan, is sister to Eomer and niece to Theoden. She slew the Witch-King at the Pelennor, striking down the terror of the ages." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:2667:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_24_4" text="Siegeberht patrols the borders of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\PL\std_taom_xslt_strings_pol-PL.xml:2669:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_26" text="Peric commands riders along the Gap of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3723:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_0" text="-50% к стоимости армии во влиянии (Командование Тени)" />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3727:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_2" text="+20% к скорости появления добровольцев в деревнях (Тёмные Призывники)" />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3731:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_4" text="+1 Торговец + 1 Ремесленник + 13 Главарей банд в городе Дол Гулдур (всего 20)" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3733:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_5" text="+10% к количеству знати в деревнях (Скрытые Лачуги)" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3735:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_6" text="+10% к потреблению пищи отрядом (Прожорливые Орды)" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3737:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_bonus_7" text="-20% к скорости строительства зданий (Губительные Работы)" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3739:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_desc" text="Южная твердыня Некроманта в Лихолесье. Теневое Командование собирает орды почти без влияния; Темная Повинность обучает ветеранов ополчения; Теневые Капитаны расширяют единственный город до двадцати знатных. Ненасытные Орды пожирают столько же, сколько убивают." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3741:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_name" text="Владычество Дол Гулдура" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3743:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_perk_0_desc" text="Стоимость влияния для армии снижена на 50% — страх принуждает к повиновению." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\RU\std_taom_module_strings_rus-RU.xml:3745:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_perk_0_name" text="Теневое Командование" />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_career_strings_spa-LA.xml:55:<string id="taom_career_watchman_of_stangard_desc" text="Un curtido guardián fluvial de Stangard que patrulla los cruces del Anduin en barcaza y a pie, protegiendo el flanco oriental de Rohan mediante resistencia, conocimiento local y el agarre tenaz de un contramaestre en territorio disputado." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_career_strings_spa-LA.xml:1127:<string id="taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc" text="Lees las llanuras de Rohan como un libro. +5% de alcance de exploración de grupo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_career_strings_spa-LA.xml:1183:<string id="taom_moa_t3_a_p2_desc" text="Eres el mejor tirador de todo Rohan. +75 de salud." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_career_strings_spa-LA.xml:1211:<string id="taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc" text="Los mejores arqueros de Rohan se unen a tu estandarte. +5 al tamaño del grupo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_career_strings_spa-LA.xml:1243:<string id="taom_ew_t1_b_p2" text="Banda de Guerra de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_career_strings_spa-LA.xml:1269:<string id="taom_ew_t2_a_p3_desc" text="El grito de Rohan alienta a todos los que lo escuchan. +8% moral de tropa." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_career_strings_spa-LA.xml:1311:<string id="taom_ew_t3_a_p4" text="Gloria de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:179:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc" text="Tu familia eran exploradores y rastreadores, asegurando que las fuerzas de Saruman se movieran sin ser vistas a través de las llanuras de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:283:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc" text="Tu familia servía a los mariscales de la Marca de los Jinetes, cabalgando con ellos en defensa de las fronteras de Rohan. Tu padre era un jinete y guerrero habilidoso." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:287:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc" text="Tu familia eran comerciantes en la gran ciudad-salón de Edoras, trayendo mercancías de toda la Marca de los Jinetes y más allá al pueblo de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:303:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc" text="Tu familia vagó por el Páramo, las tierras salvajes de hierba entre Rohan y las Tierras Pardas. Sobrevivieron gracias a su ingenio y el servicio ocasional como exploradores." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:423:<string id="taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc" text="Sentías un vínculo profundo con los animales, particularmente con los caballos. Los mozos de cuadra se maravillaban de cómo podías calmar incluso al corcel más brioso, y tu habilidad para curar heridas trajo rumores de que podrías rivalizar con los señores de caballos de Rohan algún día." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:693:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text" text="Viajó con los seguidores del campamento de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:953:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text" text="Exploraste las llanuras de Rohan para los ojos de Saruman." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:1059:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc" text="Pasaste tu juventud aprendiendo el arte de la guerra montada al servicio de uno de los mariscales de la Marca de los Jinetes, entrenando con lanza y espada en las amplias praderas de Rohan. La equitación no se enseñaba en la Marca de los Jinetes, se respiraba." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:1063:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_desc" text="Transportaste mercancías y precios entre los baluartes de Edoras y las ciudades más pequeñas de Rohan, aprendiendo a leer a la gente y cerrar un trato antes de que se desvaneciera la luz del día. Las llanuras eran largas y vacías y la conversación en los puestos del mercado hacía girar el mundo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:1067:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_desc" text="Trabajaste los pastos de tu familia en el Folde Oeste, aprendiendo a manejar caballos casi antes de poder caminar, y fuiste incorporado al servicio de leva tan pronto como fuiste lo suficientemente alto para la lanza. Las ondulantes llanuras del oeste de Rohan fueron tu escuela." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:1071:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_desc" text="Aprendiste a dar forma al acero brillante de Rohan en las casas de forja de Aldburg, fabricando hojas y herrajes para los Rohirrim. Volvías a casa cada noche con los brazos doloridos y un orgullo por el oficio que ningún campo de batalla podía disminuir." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_cc_strings_spa-LA.xml:1343:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_desc" text="Identificaste al espía mediante inconsistencias en su comportamiento, lo confrontaste en privado y le diste una opción que hizo simple la decisión. Alimentó con información falsa a Edoras durante dos temporadas antes de que alguien en Rohan sospechara. No recibiste nada por escrito por el logro." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:41:<string id="taom_str_faction_official.vlandia" text="un noble de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:43:<string id="taom_str_faction_official.vlandia_f" text="una dama de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:61:<string id="taom_str_faction_informal_name_for_culture.vlandia" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:379:<string id="taom_str_culture_description.vlandia" text="Los Rohirrim, conocidos como los Señores de los Caballos, son el pueblo orgulloso y noble de Rohan, un reino de amplias llanuras abiertas y colinas ondulantes. Son reconocidos por su habilidad como jinetes y su inigualable caballería, que forma la columna vertebral de su fuerza militar. Viviendo en una sociedad feudal muy unida, los Rohirrim son liderados por un rey y una nobleza leal que están vinculados por el honor y la tradición para proteger su tierra y su gente. Son ferozmente independientes, valorando la libertad por sobre todo, y sus guerreros están entrenados para luchar con lanzas, espadas y arcos, todo mientras montan sus poderosos corceles." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:2641:<string id="taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_trait_0" text="Rencor contra Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:2653:<string id="taom_faction_clans_of_dunland_weakness_2" text="Encajados entre Rohan e Isengard" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:2683:<string id="taom_faction_dominion_of_isengard_desc" text="La fortaleza industrial de Saruman en Orthanc. El Anillo de Isengard funciona día y noche — legiones Uruk-hai, ballestas de línea de forja, huargos de guerra. La única ciudad de Isengard se expande a veinte notables: un centro de reclutamiento igual a muchas ciudades de Rohan. El Dominio de Saruman aliena a todos sus vecinos." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:3781:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_trait_3" text="Comando de las Sombras" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:3783:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_weakness_0" text="Hordas hambrientas agotan provisiones" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:3785:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_weakness_1" text="Decadencia industrial ralentiza murallas" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_module_strings_spa-LA.xml:3787:<string id="taom_faction_overlordship_of_dol_guldur_weakness_2" text="Rodeado por bosques hostiles" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:297:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text" text="Soy una criatura simple, lucho, mato, tomo lo que quiero. Serví en las partidas de asalto que atacan rápidamente Gondor, Rohan, donde sea que los capitanes nos dirijan. No hago preguntas, no juego a la política. Apúntenme al enemigo, los rompo. Mi historial habla por sí mismo, veinte asaltos exitosos, nunca fallé un objetivo." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:681:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text" text="Lideré bandas de guerra contra los Rohirrim, saqueando sus aldeas, quemando sus campos. Sin piedad, sin vacilación, resultados absolutos. Mis unidades no dejaban nada vivo, ni guerreros, ni ancianos, ni niños. Saruman quería que el miedo se esparciera por Rohan, y yo lo entregué en ríos de sangre." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:697:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text" text="Existencia simple, luchar, matar, ganar. Lideré equipos de asalto contra las fortalezas exteriores de Rohan. Siempre el primero en la brecha, espada roja con sangre enemiga. Mis guerreros me seguían porque nunca les pedí hacer lo que yo no haría. Gané mi posición a través de la fuerza, no por linaje o favores." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:713:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text" text="Comandé partidas de exploración hacia Rohan, reuniendo inteligencia, eliminando patrullas. Bueno en mi trabajo, efectivo, despiadado, confiable. Pero vi cómo los favoritos de Saruman ascendían mientras guerreros competentes como yo nos estancábamos. El mérito solo no trae promoción cuando el Mago Blanco hace favoritismos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:745:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text" text="Trabajé en Orthanc mismo, llevando mensajes entre Saruman y sus agentes. Posición de confianza, vi correspondencia con Mordor, con los Dunledinos, con oficiales corruptos por todo Rohan. Aprendí secretos valiosos sobre movimientos de tropas, alianzas, operaciones planeadas. El conocimiento es poder, y acumulé bastante." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:905:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text" text="Administraba caravanas armadas hacia los reinos lejanos, Gondor, Rohan, a veces incluso el Reino del Bosque. Negociaba con mi lengua, luchaba con mi hacha cuando las palabras fallaban. Trabajo rentable, hasta que noté patrones. Gente oscura haciendo preguntas, movimientos de grupos sospechosos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:953:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text" text="Fui Mariscal del Folde Oeste, comandando un éored de jinetes. Patrullábamos desde el Abismo de Helm hasta la Brecha de Rohan, vigilando amenazas desde Dunland y más allá. Pero llegaron rumores oscuros desde Isengard." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:983:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text" text="En patrulla cerca de la Brecha de Rohan, encontramos aldeas quemadas - no asaltadas por orcos, sino destruidas por hombres. Las huellas conducían hacia Isengard. Cuando reportamos esto, nos dijeron que estábamos equivocados, que los Dunlendinos eran los culpables." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:1053:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text" text="Los caballos comenzaron a negarse a acercarse a la Brecha de Rohan - incluso los sementales más valientes se encabritaban y huían. Los animales perciben el mal antes que los hombres. Cuando reporté esto a los maestros de caballos, culparon al mal entrenamiento." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:1753:<string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1_text" text="Ahora vendo mi espada a causas dignas. Los Señores de los Caballos de Rohan se vuelven más audaces cada día, y no faltan batallas que librar para aquellos con el coraje de enfrentarlas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:1765:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text" text="Serví como explorador en las colinas de Dunland, recorriendo territorios más allá de nuestras fronteras para vigilar amenazas. Conozco cada sendero a través de la Brecha de Rohan y puedo rastrear un zorro en agua corriente." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:1767:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text" text="Durante una patrulla, descubrí una conspiración entre nuestra propia gente: contrabandistas trabajando con los Señores de los Caballos de Rohan. Cuando lo denuncié, descubrí que los contrabandistas habían comprado protección de alguien poderoso. Me dijeron que olvidara lo que había visto." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:1781:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3_text" text="Me entrené como curandero en las colinas de Dunland, aprendiendo las propiedades de cada hierba y remedio conocido por los Dunlendinos. Atendí a los heridos después de cada escaramuza con los Señores de los Caballos de Rohan, salvando incontables vidas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:1817:<string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5_text" text="Ahora no confío en nadie más que en mí mismo, aunque preferiría usar mis habilidades abiertamente que esconderme en las sombras para siempre. Los Señores de los Caballos de Rohan tienen espías por todas partes, y alguien necesita contrarrestarlos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:1829:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6_text" text="Comandé fuerzas en las colinas de Dunland, estudiando el arte de la guerra bajo los capitanes más experimentados de los jefes de clan. Mis innovaciones tácticas ganaron varios enfrentamientos contra los Señores de los Caballos de Rohan cuando estábamos en inferioridad numérica." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_wanderer_strings_spa-LA.xml:1861:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8_text" text="Serví en las fuerzas montadas de las colinas de Dunland, patrullando las fronteras y atacando rápidamente a las partidas de asalto de los Señores de los Caballos de Rohan. Mi habilidad ecuestre era insuperable entre los Dunlendinos." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:67:<string id="TAOM_rohan" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:69:<string id="TAOM_rohan_short" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:71:<string id="TAOM_rohan_title" text="Reino de Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:75:<string id="TAOM_rohan_desc" text="Conocido como la Marca de los Jinetes, Rohan es un vasto y extenso reino de llanuras abiertas y colinas ondulantes, donde habitan los poderosos rohirrim—jinetes expertos y guerreros fieros. Fundado por Eorl el Joven tras su legendaria cabalgata en auxilio de Gondor, Rohan ha sido durante mucho tiempo un aliado firme de Gondor contra la oscuridad de Mordor. Desde los dorados salones de Meduseld en Edoras, sus reyes gobiernan sobre un pueblo orgulloso y resistente que vive por el vínculo entre caballo y jinete. Los rohirrim son famosos por sus cargas de caballería, sus cantos de valor y su inquebrantable coraje. Aunque la sombra de Saruman ha amenazado sus fronteras, los hijos e hijas de Rohan permanecen siempre listos para responder al llamado a las armas, defendiendo su tierra natal y los pueblos libres de la Tierra Media." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:1037:<string id="aom_empire_desc" text="Los Dunlendinos son un pueblo rudo y feroz, que habita en las colinas salvajes y tierras indómitas al oeste de Rohan. Resentidos desde hace mucho tiempo con los Rohirrim, a quienes consideran invasores de sus hogares ancestrales, los Dunlendinos están unidos por su herencia compartida y su feroz independencia. Hábiles en la guerra de guerrillas y la supervivencia, confían en la astucia y la ferocidad para vencer a sus enemigos. Aunque a menudo son desestimados como simples montañeses, los Dunlendinos son un pueblo orgulloso y duradero, ferozmente protectores de sus tierras y formas de vida. Impulsados por un profundo rencor contra Rohan, se han aliado con las fuerzas de la oscuridad, buscando venganza y la restauración de sus tierras perdidas." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:1045:<string id="aom_vlandia_desc" text="Los Rohirrim, o Señores de los Caballos de Rohan, son reconocidos por su caballería sin igual y su profundo vínculo con sus corceles. Orgullosos y de espíritu libre, habitan en las llanuras ondulantes de la Marca de los Jinetes, viviendo en aldeas y fortalezas como Edoras. Guiados por su Rey y leales a su pueblo, los Rohirrim valoran el honor, la lealtad y el coraje. Sus guerreros cabalgan sin temor hacia la batalla, formando la columna vertebral de la resistencia de la Tierra Media contra la sombra. Aunque firmes en sus tradiciones, los Rohirrim están siempre listos para defender su tierra y aliados, empuñando lanzas, espadas y escudos con precisión." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:2095:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_1" text="Brenin Wulf gobierna los clanes salvajes de Dunland con puño de hierro. Conocido como el Manodehierro, unió a las tribus dispersas de las colinas mediante conquista y astucia. Sueña con reclamar las tierras tomadas por los Señores de los Caballos de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:2101:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_411" text="Grimwulf Colmillo de Hierro continúa el legado de su padre de saqueos y guerras contra Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:2587:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_1" text="Théoden, Rey de Rohan, gobierna desde Meduseld en Edoras. Una vez hechizado por el sirviente de Saruman, Grima, fue liberado por Gandalf y condujo a su pueblo a la gloria en el Abismo de Helm y los Campos del Pelennor." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:2589:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_2" text="Elfhild fue reina de Rohan, madre de Théodred. Murió en el parto, una pena que ensombreció el reinado de Théoden." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:2591:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_7" text="Théodred fue el único hijo del Rey Théoden, Príncipe de Rohan. Cayó defendiendo los Vados del Isen contra los Uruk-hai de Saruman." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:2661:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_24_1" text="Eowyn, Dama de Rohan, es hermana de Eomer y sobrina de Theoden. Dio muerte al Rey Brujo en el Pelennor, abatiendo el terror de las eras." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:2667:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_24_4" text="Siegeberht patrulla las fronteras de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\SP\std_taom_xslt_strings_spa-LA.xml:2669:<string id="TAOM_hero_4_26" text="Peric comanda jinetes a lo largo de la Brecha de Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_career_strings_tur-TR.xml:55:<string id="taom_career_watchman_of_stangard_desc" text="Anduin geçitlerini sal ve yaya devriye gezen, Rohan'ın doğu kanadını dayanıklılık, yerel bilgi ve tartışmalı arazide bir tayfa reisinin inatçı tutuşuyla koruyan kır saçlı bir Stangard nehir bekçisi." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_career_strings_tur-TR.xml:1127:<string id="taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc" text="Rohan ovalarını bir kitap gibi okursun. +5% grup keşif menzili." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_career_strings_tur-TR.xml:1183:<string id="taom_moa_t3_a_p2_desc" text="Tüm Rohan'ın en iyi atıcısısın. +75 sağlık." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_career_strings_tur-TR.xml:1211:<string id="taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc" text="Rohan'ın en seçkin okçuları sancağına toplanıyor. +5 grup büyüklüğü." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_career_strings_tur-TR.xml:1243:<string id="taom_ew_t1_b_p2" text="Rohan Savaş Grubu" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_career_strings_tur-TR.xml:1269:<string id="taom_ew_t2_a_p3_desc" text="Rohan'ın çığlığı onu duyan herkese cesaret veriyor. +8% birlik morali." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_career_strings_tur-TR.xml:1311:<string id="taom_ew_t3_a_p4" text="Rohan'ın Şanı" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:179:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc" text="Aileniz kâşif ve iz sürücüydü, Saruman'ın güçlerinin Rohan ovalarında görünmeden hareket etmesini sağladı." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:283:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc" text="Aileniz Riddermark'ın marşallarına hizmet ediyor, Rohan'ın sınırlarının savunmasında onlarla birlikte sürüyordu. Babanız yetenekli bir süvari ve savaşçıydı." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:287:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc" text="Aileniz Edoras'ın büyük salon şehrinde tüccardı, Riddermark'ın her yerinden ve ötesinden Rohan halkına mallar getiriyordu." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:303:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc" text="Ailen Rohan ile Kahverengi Topraklar arasındaki vahşi otlaklardan Wold'da dolaştı. Zekalarıyla ve zaman zaman keşif görevleriyle hayatta kaldılar." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:423:<string id="taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc" text="Hayvanlarla, özellikle atlarla derin bir bağ hissederdiniz. Ahır görevlileri en huysuz atı bile nasıl sakinleştirebildiğinize hayret ederdi ve yaraları iyileştirme beceriniz bir gün Rohan'ın at ustalarıyla yarışabileceğiniz fısıltılarına sebep olurdu." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:693:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text" text="Rohan'ın ordu hizmetçileriyle seyahat etti." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:953:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text" text="Saruman'ın gözleri için Rohan ovalarını keşfetti." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:1059:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc" text="Gençliğini Riddermark mareşallerinden birine hizmet ederek atlı savaş sanatını öğrenerek geçirdin, Rohan'ın geniş otlaklarında mızrak ve kılıçla talim yaptın. Riddermark'ta binicilik öğretilmezdi — nefes alınırdı." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:1063:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_desc" text="Edoras'ın kaleleri ile Rohan'ın küçük kasabaları arasında mal ve fiyat taşıdın, insanları okumayı ve günün ışığı solmadan önce anlaşmayı kapatmayı öğrendin. Ovalar uzun ve boştu ve pazar tezgahlarındaki sohbet dünyayı döndürüyordu." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:1067:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_desc" text="Westfold'daki ailenin meralarında çalıştın, yürümeyi öğrenmeden önce neredeyse atları idare etmeyi öğrendin ve mızrak için yeterince uzun olur olmaz levanta alındın. Batı Rohan'ın dalgalı ovaları senin okulundu." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:1071:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_desc" text="Aldburg'un demirhanelerinde Rohan'ın parlak çeliğini şekillendirmeyi öğrendin, Rohirrim için kılıç ve donanım yaptın. Her gece kolların ağrıyarak ve hiçbir savaş alanının azaltamayacağı bir zanaat gururu ile eve gittin." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_cc_strings_tur-TR.xml:1343:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_desc" text="Casusu davranış tutarsızlığıyla tespit ettin, özel olarak yüzleştirdin ve ona kararı basit kılan bir seçenek sundun. Rohan'da herhangi birinin şüphelenmesinden önce iki sezon boyunca Edoras'a yanlış bilgiler besledi. Bu başarı için yazılı hiçbir şey almadın." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_module_strings_tur-TR.xml:41:<string id="taom_str_faction_official.vlandia" text="Rohan'ın bir asilzadesi" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_module_strings_tur-TR.xml:43:<string id="taom_str_faction_official.vlandia_f" text="Rohan'ın bir leydisi" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_module_strings_tur-TR.xml:61:<string id="taom_str_faction_informal_name_for_culture.vlandia" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_module_strings_tur-TR.xml:379:<string id="taom_str_culture_description.vlandia" text="At Lordları olarak bilinen Rohirrim, geniş ova ve yuvarlak tepelerle kaplı Rohan diyarının gururlu ve asil halkıdır. Binici yetenekleri ve askeri güçlerinin temelini oluşturan eşsiz süvarileriyle ünlüdürler. Sıkı bağlarla örülmüş feodal bir toplumda yaşayan Rohirrim'e, onur ve gelenekle topraklarını ve halkını korumakla yükümlü olan bir kral ve sadık bir soylular sınıfı liderlik eder. Şiddetle bağımsız olan bu halk, özgürlüğe her şeyden çok değer verir ve savaşçıları, güçlü atlarının sırtında mızrak, kılıç ve yay kullanmak üzere eğitilmiştir." />

Isengard'ın tek kasabası yirmi ileri gelene ulaşır: Rohan'ın birçok şehrine denk bir asker toplama merkezi. Saruman'ın Tutuşu her komşuyu yabancılaştırır." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:297:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text" text="Basit bir yaratığım, savaşıyorum, öldürüyorum, istediğimi alıyorum. Gondor'a, Rohan'a, kaptanların bizi nereye yönlendirirse hızlı saldıran akın birliklerinde hizmet ettim. Sorular sormam, politika oynamam. Beni düşmana yönlendir, onları kırarım. Sicilim kendini belli ediyor, yirmi başarılı akın, hiç hedefi başaramama olmadı." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:681:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text" text="Rohirrim'e karşı savaş gruplarına komuta ettim, köylerini bastım, tarlalarını yaktım. Merhamet yok, tereddüt yok, mutlak sonuçlar. Birliklerim hiçbir şeyi sağ bırakmadı, ne savaşçıları, ne yaşlıları, ne de çocukları. Saruman Rohan'a korku saçılmasını istiyordu ve ben bunu kan nehirleriyle sağladım." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:697:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text" text="Basit bir varoluş, savaş, öldür, kazan. Rohan'ın dış kalelerine karşı saldırı timlerine komuta ettim. Her seferinde gedikten ilk geçen bendim, kılıcım düşman kanıyla kırmızıydı. Savaşçılarım beni takip etti çünkü onlardan kendim yapmayacağım bir şey yapmalarını hiç istemedim. Pozisyonumu soy ya da iltimas yoluyla değil, güç yoluyla kazandım." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:713:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text" text="Rohan'a keşif gruplarına komuta ettim, istihbarat topladım, devriye birliklerini temizledim. İşimde iyiydim, etkili, acımasız, güvenilir. Ama Saruman'ın gözdelerinin nasıl ilerlediğini görürken benim gibi yetkin savaşçılar durgunlaşıyordu. Beyaz Büyücü adam kayırdığında sadece liyakat terfi getirmez." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:745:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text" text="Orthanc'ın kendisinde çalıştım, Saruman ile ajanları arasında mesajlar taşıdım. Güvenilir bir pozisyon, Mordor'la, Dunlendliler'le, Rohan'daki yozlaşmış yetkililerle yapılan yazışmaları gördüm. Birlik hareketleri, ittifaklar, planlanan operasyonlar hakkında değerli sırlar öğrendim. Bilgi güçtür ve bolca biriktirdim." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:905:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text" text="Uzak krallıklara, Gondor'a, Rohan'a, bazen Orman Diyarı'na bile silahlı kervanlar yönettim. Dilimle pazarlık yaptım, sözler yetmediğinde baltamla savaştım. Kârlı işti, kalıpları fark edene kadar. Sorular soran karanlık yaratıklar, şüpheli grupların hareketleri." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:953:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text" text="Westfold'un bir Marşalıydım, süvarilerin bir éored'ine komuta ediyordum. Helm Geçidi'nden Rohan Boğazı'na kadar devriye geziyorduk, Dunland ve ötesinden gelen tehditleri gözetliyorduk. Ama Isengard'dan karanlık söylentiler geldi." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:983:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text" text="Rohan Boğazı yakınında devriyede yanmış köyler bulduk - orklar tarafından basılmamış, insanlar tarafından yok edilmiş. İzler Isengard'a gidiyordu. Bunu bildirdiğimizde, yanıldığımız, suçlunun Dunlendingler olduğu söylendi." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:1053:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text" text="Atlar Rohan Geçidi yakınlarına gitmeyi reddetmeye başladı - en cesur aygırlar bile şahlanan ve kaçardı. Hayvanlar kötülüğü insanlardan önce hisseder. Bunu at ustalarına bildirdiğimde, kötü eğitimi suçladılar." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:1753:<string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1_text" text="Şimdi kılıcımı layık davalara satıyorum. Rohan'ın At-lordları her gün daha da cüretkar oluyor ve onlarla yüzleşme cesaretine sahip olanlar için savaş eksik değil." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:1765:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text" text="Dunland tepelerinde izci olarak görev yaptım, tehditler için sınırlarımızın çok ötesine gittim. Rohan Geçidi'ndeki her yolu biliyorum ve akan suda bile bir tilkiyi takip edebilirim." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:1767:<string id="aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text" text="Bir devriye sırasında, kendi halkımız arasında bir komplo keşfettim - Rohan'ın At-lordlarıyla çalışan kaçakçılar. Bunu rapor ettiğimde, kaçakçıların güçlü birinden koruma satın aldığını öğrendim. Gördüklerimi unutmam söylendi." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:1781:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3_text" text="Dunland tepelerinde şifacı olarak eğitim gördüm, Dunlandlılarca bilinen her şifalı ot ve ilaç özelliğini öğrendim. Rohan'ın At-lordlarıyla her çatışmadan sonra yaralılara baktım, sayısız can kurtardım." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:1817:<string id="aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5_text" text="Şimdi kendimden başka kimseye güvenmiyorum, yine de becerilerimi sonsuza dek gölgelerde gizlenmektense açıkça kullanmayı tercih ederim. Rohan'ın At-lordları her yerde casusları var ve birisinin onlara karşı koyması gerekiyor." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:1829:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6_text" text="Dunland tepelerinde kuvvetlere komuta ettim, klan reislerinin en deneyimli komutanları altında savaş sanatını öğrendim. Taktik yeniliklerim sayı olarak az olduğumuzda Rohan'ın At-lordlarına karşı birkaç çarpışma kazandırdı." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_wanderer_strings_tur-TR.xml:1861:<string id="aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8_text" text="Dunland tepelerinin atlı kuvvetlerinde hizmet ettim, sınırları devriye gezerek ve Rohan'ın At-lordlarının akın gruplarına karşı hızlı saldırılar yaparak. Dunlendingliler arasında atlı ustalığım eşsizdi." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_xslt_strings_tur-TR.xml:67:<string id="TAOM_rohan" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_xslt_strings_tur-TR.xml:69:<string id="TAOM_rohan_short" text="Rohan" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_xslt_strings_tur-TR.xml:71:<string id="TAOM_rohan_title" text="Rohan Krallığı" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_xslt_strings_tur-TR.xml:75:<string id="TAOM_rohan_desc" text="Riddermark olarak bilinen Rohan, açık ovalar ve engebeli tepelerden oluşan geniş bir krallıktır; burada yetenekli atlılar ve yılmaz savaşçılar olan güçlü Rohirrim yaşar. Gondor'a yardım için efsanevi yolculuğundan sonra Genç Eorl tarafından kurulan Rohan, Mordor'un karanlığına karşı Gondor'un sadık müttefiki olarak uzun zamandır durmaktadır. Edoras'taki Meduseld'in altın salonlarından kralları, at ve binici bağı ile yaşayan gururlu ve dayanıklı bir halk üzerinde hükmeder. Rohirrim, süvari hücumları, kahramanlık şarkıları ve sarsılmaz cesaretleriyle ünlüdür. Saruman'ın gölgesi sınırlarını tehdit etmiş olsa da, Rohan'ın oğulları ve kızları vatanlarını ve Orta Dünya'nın özgür halklarını savunmak için her zaman silaha sarılmaya hazırdırlar." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_xslt_strings_tur-TR.xml:1037:<string id="aom_empire_desc" text="Dunlendliler sert ve vahşi bir halktır, Rohan'ın batısındaki ıssız tepelerde ve ehlileştirilmemiş topraklarda yaşarlar. Atalarının yurtlarını işgal eden istilacılar olarak gördükleri Rohirrim'e karşı uzun süredir kin besleyen Dunlendliler, ortak mirasları ve güçlü bağımsızlıkları ile birleşmiştir. Gerilla savaşında ve hayatta kalmada ustalaşmış olan bu halk, düşmanlarını yenmek için kurnazlık ve vahşete güvenir. Çoğu zaman basit tepe halkı olarak görülseler de, Dunlendliler gurur duyulan ve kalıcı bir halktır, topraklarını ve yaşam biçimlerini korumada son derece korumacıdır. Rohan'a karşı derinlere yerleşmiş bir kin tarafından yönlendirilen Dunlendliler, intikam ve kaybedilmiş topraklarının geri kazanılmasını arayarak karanlık güçlerle ittifak kurmuştur." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_xslt_strings_tur-TR.xml:1045:<string id="aom_vlandia_desc" text="Rohirrim veya Rohan'ın At Lordları, eşsiz süvarileri ve atlarıyla derin bağlarıyla ünlüdür. Gururlu ve özgür ruhlu olan Rohirrim, Riddermark'ın engin ovalarında yaşar, Edoras gibi köylerde ve kalelerde ikamet eder. Kralları tarafından yönetilen ve halklarına sadık olan Rohirrim, onuru, sadakati ve cesareti yüceltir. Savaşçıları korkusuzca savaşa atılır ve Orta Dünya'nın gölgeye karşı direnişinin omurgasını oluşturur. Geleneklerine sadık kalmakla birlikte, Rohirrim her zaman topraklarını ve müttefiklerini savunmaya hazırdır, mızraklarını, kılıçlarını ve kalkanlarını ustalıkla kullanır." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_xslt_strings_tur-TR.xml:2095:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_1" text="Brenin Wulf, Dunland'ın vahşi klanlarını demir yumrukla yönetiyor. Demir El olarak bilinen Wulf, dağınık tepe kabilelerini fetih ve kurnazlıkla birleştirdi. Rohan'ın At Lordları tarafından alınan toprakları geri almayı hayal ediyor." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\Main\_Module\ModuleData\Languages\TR\std_taom_xslt_strings_tur-TR.xml:2099:<string id="TAOM_hero_1_41" text="Beregund Kurtdoğan, Rohan yerleşimlerine yaptığı baskınlardaki becerisiyle tanınan güvenilir bir Dunland kaptanıdır." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\audits\triage-input-batch-A2.json:17:"body": "## Source\nTAOM feature audit Phase 2 \u00e2\u20ac\u201d GameModel cluster review.\n\n## Problem (P1)\n`TaomPartySpeedModel.CalculateFinalSpeed` accesses `Campaign.Current.MapSceneWrapper.GetFaceTerrainType(...)` without any null guards on the chain. `Campaign.Current` is null before campaign load; `MapSceneWrapper` can be null during scene transitions and on early loading-screen ticks. `CalculateFinalSpeed` is called every tick per party \u00e2\u20ac\u201d high-frequency hot path.\n\n- File: `Main/Features/CulturalFeats/Models/TaomPartySpeedModel.cs:30`\n\n## Analysis\nThe override was added to apply Rohan/forest culture speed feats based on terrain type. The chain `Campaign.Current.MapSceneWrapper.GetFaceTerrainType(...)` is two layers of unguarded computed property access. Per `adapters.md` and `csharp-architecture.md` rule \"?. for computed TaleWorlds properties\".\n\nSecondary issue at lines 47-61: a `foreach` over the full troop roster with a `mountedCount` accumulator runs on every tick per party with no early-exit when culture mismatch is known.\n\n## Solution\n1. Guard the terrain access:\n```csharp\nvar terrain = Campaign.Current?.MapSceneWrapper?.GetFaceTerrainType(mobileParty.CurrentNavigationFace)\n            ?? TerrainType.Plain;\n```\n2. Add an early-exit before the roster walk when the party's culture is not Rohan (the only culture that consumes the mounted-ratio):\n```csharp\nif (mobileParty.Party?.Culture?.StringId != \"rohan_culture_id\") return finalSpeed;\n```\n3. As part of Pattern A service-extraction, move the `foreach` into `ICulturalFeatsService.ApplyPartySpeedFeats(...)`.\n\n## Files\n- `Main/Features/CulturalFeats/Models/TaomPartySpeedModel.cs`\n- `TAOM.Tests/Features/CulturalFeats/` (add `TaomPartySpeedModelTests.cs` once extracted to service)\n\n## Testing\nUnit test the extracted service with: (a) `Campaign.Current == null`, (b) `MapSceneWrapper == null`, (c) Rohan culture + mounted roster, (d) non-Rohan culture (skip roster walk).\n\n## Phase reference\nPhase 2 cluster review \u00e2\u20ac\u201d `docs/audits/cluster-gamemodels.md` master findings row 1b + CulturalFeats per-feature section.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\audits\triage-input-batch-A2.json:199:"body": "## Source\nTAOM feature audit Phase 2 \u00e2\u20ac\u201d GameModel cluster review.\n\n## Findings (4 \u00c3\u2014 P2)\nConstruction integrity: \u00e2\u0153\u2026 all 3 ctors match SubModule.cs:244\u00e2\u20ac\u201c246.\n\n**Manifest correction:** feature has 3 models on disk (`TaomCharacterStatsModel`, `TaomPartyWageModel`, `TaomVolunteerModel`), manifest says 2. `TaomCharacterStatsModel` is genuinely thin (`MaxCharacterTier => 10`); `TaomVolunteerModel` is genuinely thin delegation. Findings concentrate on `TaomPartyWageModel`.\n\n### P2 \u00e2\u20ac\u201d `TaomPartyWageModel.GetTotalWage` ~50-line inline body (rule 4)\n- File: `Main/Features/TroopProgression/Models/TaomPartyWageModel.cs:37\u00e2\u20ac\u201c86`\n- Garrison-wage feat loop + Rohan mounted-share calc + `CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor` all inline. `ITroopCostService.GetCharacterWage` is delegated to but the feat-application logic stays in the model.\n- Fix: extract `ITroopCostService.ApplyWageModifiers(mobileParty, troopRoster, ref result)` or new `IWageModifierService`. Model body reduces to base call + service call + return.\n\n### P2 \u00e2\u20ac\u201d `TaomPartyWageModel.GetTroopRecruitmentCost` inline branching (rule 4)\n- File: `TaomPartyWageModel.cs:88\u00e2\u20ac\u201c112`\n- Inline `if (!withoutItemCost && troop.IsMounted)` for horse cost + 2 mounted-feat guards. `ITroopCostService.GetTroopRecruitmentCost` only covers `level + isMercenary`; horse + feat modifiers untestable in the model.\n- Fix: extend service signature to accept `(level, isMercenary, isMounted, withoutItemCost, buyerCulture)` or add a companion method.\n\n### P2 \u00e2\u20ac\u201d Cross-feature `CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor` static call inside model\n- File: `TaomPartyWageModel.cs:83`\n- Couples TroopProgression \u00e2\u2020\u2019 CareerSystem at the model layer. Should route through `ICareerPassiveService` injected into the extracted service (not the model).\n- Pattern D \u00e2\u20ac\u201d see umbrella issue when filed.\n\n### P2 \u00e2\u20ac\u201d `IVolunteerContextAdapter` registered in global IoC instead of TroopProgressionIoC\n- File: `Main/IoC.cs:110` should be `Main/Features/TroopProgression/TroopProgressionIoC.cs`\n- Adapter is feature-owned (only consumer is `TaomVolunteerModel`) but lives in global wiring. Cohesion gap.\n- Fix: move the `Register<IVolunteerContextAdapter, VolunteerContextAdapter>` line into `TroopProgressionIoC.RegisterTroopProgressionFeature`.\n\n## P3 notes (not opening issue)\n- Manifest miscount carried forward (filing `TaomPartyWageModel` under CulturalFeats is a historical artifact).\n- `troopRoster != null` null-check at line 65 redundant given parameter type and prior guards.\n\n## Files\n- `Main/Features/TroopProgression/Models/TaomPartyWageModel.cs`\n- `Main/Features/TroopProgression/ITroopCostService.cs` + `TroopCostService.cs`\n- `Main/Features/TroopProgression/TroopProgressionIoC.cs`\n- `Main/IoC.cs` (remove `IVolunteerContextAdapter` line)\n- `TAOM.Tests/Features/TroopProgression/TroopCostServiceTests.cs` (add coverage for new wage-modifier + recruitment paths)\n\n## Testing\n- Unit: `ApplyWageModifiers_Gondor_GarrisonReduced` (per-culture feat path)\n- Unit: `ApplyWageModifiers_Rohan_MountedShareCalculated` (Rohan-specific path)\n- Unit: `GetTroopRecruitmentCost_Mounted_IncludesHorseCost`\n- Unit: feat-disabled control case\n\n## Phase reference\nPhase 2 cluster review \u00e2\u20ac\u201d `docs/audits/cluster-gamemodels.md` rows 32\u00e2\u20ac\u201c35 + TroopProgression per-feature section.",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\audits\triage-input-batch-C.json:115:"body": "Phase 6 cross-feature handshake review found 1 P1 + 3 P2 findings in the CareerPassiveHelper integration. Full report: `docs/audits/cluster-cross-feature.md` \u00c2\u00a7 Per-pair report 5.\n\n## F1: Service-locator inside a static helper \u00e2\u20ac\u201d IoC.Resolve not at a boundary (P2)\n\n- **Code:** `Main/Features/CareerSystem/CareerPassiveHelper.cs:27, 32` \u00e2\u20ac\u201d `GetService()` and `GetLogger()` call `IoC.Resolve<...>()` and cache in static fields `_cachedService` and `_cachedLogger`.\n- **Issue:** The helper is invoked from inside GameModel override bodies (10 call sites across CulturalFeats, TroopProgression, CareerSystem). Per `feedback_no_service_locator_in_services.md`, acceptable boundaries are Harmony patches, CampaignBehavior ctors, GameModel ctors, SubModule.cs, ScreenBase. A static helper called from a GameModel body is none of these. Static caches are non-volatile \u00e2\u20ac\u201d visibility across threads not guaranteed by C# memory model.\n- **Recommended fix:** Inject `ICareerPassiveService` into each of the 10 GameModel constructors. Pass the service explicitly to `CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor` as a parameter (or inline). Drop the static caches.\n\n## F2: Plain Dictionary \u00e2\u20ac\u201d data race between RefreshCache and GetPassiveMagnitude (P2)\n\n- **Code:** `Main/Features/CareerSystem/CareerPassiveService.cs:11-12, 21, 72` \u00e2\u20ac\u201d plain `Dictionary<string, Dictionary<PassiveEffectType, float>>`. `RefreshCache` calls `_cache.Clear()` then rebuilds in-place; `GetPassiveMagnitude` calls `_cache.TryGetValue` from GameModel override paths.\n- **Threading risk:** Several callers can fire from AI worker threads: `GetTotalWage` (via `DefaultPartyDesertionModel.CalculatePartyDesertionRatio`), `GetPartyMemberSizeLimit` (parallel party-size checks). Per `feedback_detect_engine_threading_via_mt_suffix.md` `_MT` pattern.\n- **Symptom under contention:** `InvalidOperationException: Collection was modified` (minimum) or silently wrong return (worst case from partially-visible internal state).\n- **Recommended fix:** Snapshot-swap pattern. `RefreshCache` builds a NEW `Dictionary`, then `Volatile.Write` (or `Interlocked.Exchange`) swaps the reference. Reads do `Volatile.Read` before `TryGetValue`. Allocation-on-refresh is acceptable (refresh is infrequent); reads are lock-free.\n\n## F3: Inline foreach + arithmetic in TaomPartyWageModel.GetTotalWage (P1)\n\n- **Code:** `Main/Features/TroopProgression/Models/TaomPartyWageModel.cs:65-79` \u00e2\u20ac\u201d Rohan mounted-wage-share block: `foreach` over `troopRoster.GetTroopRoster()`, float arithmetic (`mountedWageTotal / baseWageTotal`), conditional guard.\n- **Issue:** Per `feedback_gamemodel_inline_logic.md`, any `if`, `foreach`, or multi-step computation inline in a GameModel override body is a violation. The model has `ITroopCostService` injected but the Rohan logic was not extracted to it.\n- **Recommended fix:** Add `float GetMountedWageShareFactor(TroopRoster roster, Func<CharacterObject, int> wageFunc)` to `ITroopCostService`. Move lines 65-79 there. Model body becomes service delegate call.\n\n## F4: Integer truncation before career passive in TaomSmithingModel (P2)\n\n- **Code:** `Main/Features/CulturalFeats/Models/TaomSmithingModel.cs:46, 51` \u00e2\u20ac\u201d `ApplySmithingFeatReduction` computes `featResult = (int)(baseCost * (1f + factor))` at line 46, then `new ExplainedNumber(featResult, false)` + `CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor`.\n- **Bug:** Intermediate `(int)` truncation shifts the result by 1 vs same-line `ExplainedNumber.AddFactor` composition. Example: baseCost=7, Erebor=-0.3, career=-0.1 \u00e2\u2020\u2019 truncated path gives 3; composed path gives 4.\n- **Recommended fix:** `var result = new ExplainedNumber(baseCost, false); result.AddFactor(featFactor, ...); CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor(...); return (int)result.ResultNumber;` Single int cast at the end is unavoidable; intermediate truncation eliminated.\n\n## Related (P3 in cluster doc, not in this issue)\n\n- F5: 12 aspirational `PassiveEffectType` values with no producers + no consumers. Plus `StealthBonus` with XML producers but no C# consumer. Per `feedback_no_aspirational_enum_values.md`.\n\n## Memory references\n\n- `feedback_no_service_locator_in_services.md` (F1)\n- `feedback_detect_engine_threading_via_mt_suffix.md` (F2)\n- `feedback_gamemodel_inline_logic.md` (F3)\n- `feedback_no_aspirational_enum_values.md` (F5)",
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\audits\triage-input-batch-D.json:83:"body": "## Phase 7 Finding\n\nTaomPartyWageModel.GetTotalWage (~50 lines, multi-branch) has NO matching test in TAOM.Tests/Features/TroopProgression/. Services (VolunteerTierService, TroopCostService, VolunteerRecruitmentService) are 100% covered (42 tests, ratio 2.1).\n\n## Severity rationale \u00e2\u20ac\u201d P2\n- Largest untested method in TroopProgression's model layer (cluster-gamemodels.md row 32).\n- Phase 6 #32, #34, #148 \u00e2\u20ac\u201d inlines CareerPassiveHelper.ApplyFactor from override body. Couples TroopProgression -> CareerSystem at entry-point layer instead of via service composition.\n\n## Cross-feature references\n- Phase 6 #148 (CareerPassiveHelper architectural issue)\n- Phase 6 #32, #34 (TaomPartyWageModel coupling)\n\n## Phase 9 fix sketch\n1. Add tests for the 50-line GetTotalWage covering: tier-0..10 wages, culture wage feats, garrison wage feat, Rohan mounted feat, career TroopWages passive \u00e2\u20ac\u201d paired with no-passive baseline.\n2. Cross-reference with the CareerPassiveHelper fix track (Phase 6 #148) \u00e2\u20ac\u201d once helper is wrapped behind a service, update tests.\n\n## Phase 7 source\nSee docs/audits/test-coverage.md row 5.",

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\features\armor-balance.md:154:**`--weights-only` applicability (important):** it is correct ONLY when the slot's armor is varied AND correctly tiered, because weight follows armor. It is the right tool where the armor is already right and only the weight is frozen (harad body/head/leg). It is the WRONG tool when: (a) the armor is itself uniform — it can't ladder (no-op, e.g. rohan's combat boots, iron_hills arm), those need an armor mid-tier first; or (b) the armor is over-tiered for the culture's intended weight class — it would propagate that into heavier weights (e.g. dunland body 30-45 → 12-21kg, the opposite of the light-raider intent). Cultures in (b) need the identity decision (lower armor + material) before any weight pass.

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\features\cultural-feats.md:201:**Known characteristic — duplicate archetype selection at target = pool size.** Vanilla `DefaultHeroCreationModel.GetRandomTemplateByOccupation` samples templates from `culture.NotableTemplates` *with replacement* (it filters by occupation, then weighted-random picks without removing the selected template from the pool). For Isengard (14 GL templates, target 14) and Dol Guldur (15 GL templates, target 15), this means each town's authored GL roster will have expected `≈ N × (1 − (1 − 1/N)^N) ≈ 0.632 N` distinct archetypes — roughly 9 distinct of 14 (Isengard) and 9.5 distinct of 15 (Dol Guldur), with the remaining slots being duplicate names/portraits. This is intentional: the design goal was AI-recruitment density (Rohan-tier town hubs), not encyclopedia name diversity. Adding pool headroom (e.g., 20 templates for 14 targets) or patching vanilla to a no-replacement selector would mitigate, but each costs authoring effort or a Harmony patch on a hot path. Codex flagged this MEDIUM on 2026-05-31 (see `docs/reviews/codex-adversarial-cultural-feats-per-occupation-2026-05-31.md`).

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\features\faction-map.md:26:`SetCultureOnCharacterCreation` assigns `Hero.MainHero.Culture` **before** invoking vanilla `SetSelectedCulture`, so the auto-generated family name is drawn from the selected culture's `<clan_names>` rather than the stale default culture. (Vanilla's culture stage sets the culture on click, *before* name generation; the faction map calls `SetSelectedCulture` first, so it must assign the culture explicitly.) For the `vlandia` id — TAOM's Rohan — it then regenerates the clan name to bypass vanilla `FactionHelper.GenerateClanNameforPlayer`'s hardcoded `"dey Corvand"`, guarded on a non-empty `ClanNameList`. See issue [#264](https://github.com/haterade22/TAOM/issues/264). The override **must pass a non-null `Settlement`** to `NameGenerator.GenerateClanName`: the engine's `vlandia` special-case unconditionally dereferences `clanOriginSettlement.Name`, so a `null` argument NREs on every Rohan confirm (caught by the method's try/catch, but the override then silently fails and the clan keeps `"dey Corvand"`). It resolves a culture-appropriate settlement (`Settlement.All` first-of-culture, else first overall); the `ORIGIN_SETTLEMENT` text variable is unused by TAOM's `<clan_names>`, so the choice is cosmetic — only non-null-ness matters (issue [#301](https://github.com/haterade22/TAOM/issues/301)).

Long resentful of the Rohirrim, whom they see as invaders of their ancestral homes, the Dunlendings are united by their shared heritage and fierce independence. Skilled in guerrilla warfare and survival, they rely on cunning and ferocity to overcome their enemies. Though often dismissed as simple hill folk, the Dunlendings are a proud and enduring people, fiercely protective of their lands and ways of life. C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-cultural-feats-3pack-2026-05-31.md:4802:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=aom_vlandia_desc}The Rohirrim, or Horse-lords of Rohan, are renowned for their unmatched cavalry and deep bond with their steeds. Guided by their King and loyal to their people, the Rohirrim prize honor, loyalty, and courage. Their warriors ride fearlessly into battle, forming the backbone of Middle-earth’s resistance against the shadow. Though steadfast in their traditions, the Rohirrim are ever ready to defend their land and allies, wielding spears, swords, and shields with precision.</xsl:attribute>

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-culturemarketplace-2026-05-20.md:606:[MEDIUM] Main/Features/CultureMarketplace/CultureItemPoolService.cs:48 — Culture ID Normalization — Attribute culture wins over prefix fallback, but installed LOTRLOME root horse harnesses use invalid `culture="Culture.rohan"` (`LOTRAOM_horses.xml:235`, also lines 254, 273, 292, 311, 330). The PrefixMap row at `ItemPoolAdapter.cs:27` would correctly map `rohan_` to `vlandia`, but it is ignored whenever `item.Culture?.StringId` is non-empty. Because `ReadObjectReferenceFromXml` strips `Culture.` and looks up `rohan`, a presumed or externally supplied `rohan` culture object sends these items to a `rohan` pool that Rohan towns (`vlandia`) never request. Smallest fix: normalize known aliases (`rohan` -> `vlandia`, and any future invalid aliases) before grouping, or only trust attribute culture if it is in an allow-list of valid TAOM culture IDs.
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-culturemarketplace-2026-05-20.md:618:S3 CONFIRMED - I did not find a current fixed-order prefix over-match causing attributed items to route wrong, but the prefix audit found real fallback coverage gaps and a real invalid `Culture.rohan` alias hazard. The prompt's claim that no `rohan_` row exists is disputed; the row exists at `ItemPoolAdapter.cs:27`.
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-culturemarketplace-fixes-2026-05-20.md:13:The routing branch applies `ApplyCultureAlias` to every routed target before grouping. In the concrete `cultures="rohan,mordor"` scenario, `rohan` becomes `vlandia` and `mordor` stays `mordor`; the item lands in both pools. The `continue` at line 72 also correctly prevents later attribute/prefix processing.
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-culturemarketplace-fixes-2026-05-20.md:35:The edge-case bug is duplicate route targets. The provider stores route targets as a plain `List<string>`, and the pool service appends once per entry after alias normalization. Therefore both `cultures="mordor,mordor"` and `cultures="rohan,vlandia"` add the same item twice to a single canonical pool, doubling that item's draw weight without a warning.

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-spider-troop-2026-06-04.md:1034:Last updated: 2026-06-02 (CultureConversion review 49 — deep-review 16-agent workflow (5 dimensions × adversarial-verify + completeness critic): 10 raised → 6 confirmed (1 real code bug: `ReapplyConvertedCultures` discarded a `SetSettlementCulture` failure leaving a stale `IsConverted` record; 2 cross-feature doc gaps; 3 test gaps), 4 refuted incl. a HIGH R6 "store-cleared-while-Settlement.Culture-live" scenario proven architecturally impossible. Then Codex (gpt-5.5 xhigh): 1 HIGH + 3 LOW, and **DISPUTED 5 of 7 Known Suspects with decompiled evidence** — verified `ChangeOwnerOfSettlementAction` sets `Town.OwnerClan` BEFORE dispatching the owner-changed event (so the handler reads the new owner), the R6 original-culture capture is safe, the `_justLoadedFromSave` save/load guard mirrors Messengers correctly, and `ResolveStandardCascade` is the old cascade moved intact. **Codex's HIGH was the highest-value catch of the whole chain and NO deep-review dimension found it: the `HasCulturePool` conversion gate was implicitly defined by the EXISTING pool set (`CultureMap` keys), not the FULL set of playable fief-owning cultures — so conquests by Rohan (`vlandia`), Khand (`battania`), Harad (`aserai`), Mirkwood, and Umbar silently never converted.** Identical enumerate-from-source-of-truth gap as review 47's `alignment.json` whole-file omission. Fixed: added `CultureMap["vlandia"]` + `["aserai"]` (the two with existing recruitable troops), documented Khand/Mirkwood/Umbar as a known gap (no `is_basic_troop` set authored → conversion intentionally gated off), + an enumeration test pinning ALL playable cultures against the gate. Lesson reinforced: a gate that keys on "has a pool/row/entry" must be tested by enumerating the full domain, not by spot-checking the entries that exist. RCA: docs/reviews/rca-culture-conversion-2026-06-02.md.)

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:13725:182: 			text="{{=TAOM_rohan_desc}}Known as the Riddermark, Rohan is a vast and sweeping kingdom of open plains and rolling hills, where the mighty Rohirrim—skilled horsemen and fierce warriors—dwell. Founded by Eorl the Young after his legendary ride to Gondor's aid, Rohan has long stood as a steadfast ally of Gondor against the darkness of Mordor. From the golden halls of Meduseld in Edoras, its kings rule over a proud and resilient people who live by the bond of horse and rider. The Rohirrim are famed for their cavalry charges, their songs of valor, and their unwavering courage. Though the shadow of Saruman has threatened their borders, the sons and daughters of Rohan remain ever ready to answer the call to arms, defending their homeland and the free peoples of Middle-earth.">

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:14769:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spclans.xslt:611:<!-- ==================== ROHAN CLANS (Vlandia) ==================== -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:14812:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:21:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=aom_empire_desc}The Dunlendings are a rugged and fierce people, dwelling in the wild hills and untamed lands west of Rohan. Long resentful of the Rohirrim, whom they see as invaders of their ancestral homes, the Dunlendings are united by their shared heritage and fierce independence. Skilled in guerrilla warfare and survival, they rely on cunning and ferocity to overcome their enemies. Though often dismissed as simple hill folk, the Dunlendings are a proud and enduring people, fiercely protective of their lands and ways of life. Driven by a deep-seated grudge against Rohan, they have allied themselves with the forces of darkness, seeking revenge and the restoration of their lost lands.</xsl:attribute>
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:14820:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spcultures.xslt:591:<xsl:attribute name="text">{=aom_vlandia_desc}The Rohirrim, or Horse-lords of Rohan, are renowned for their unmatched cavalry and deep bond with their steeds. Proud and free-spirited, they dwell in the rolling plains of the Riddermark, living in villages and strongholds like Edoras. Guided by their King and loyal to their people, the Rohirrim prize honor, loyalty, and courage. Their warriors ride fearlessly into battle, forming the backbone of Middle-earth’s resistance against the shadow. Though steadfast in their traditions, the Rohirrim are ever ready to defend their land and allies, wielding spears, swords, and shields with precision.</xsl:attribute>

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15077:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:179:short_name="{{=TAOM_rohan_short}}Rohan"
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15078:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:180:title="{{=TAOM_rohan_title}}Kingdom of Rohan"
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15080:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\spkingdoms.xslt:182:text="{{=TAOM_rohan_desc}}Known as the Riddermark, Rohan is a vast and sweeping kingdom of open plains and rolling hills, where the mighty Rohirrim—skilled horsemen and fierce warriors—dwell. Founded by Eorl the Young after his legendary ride to Gondor's aid, Rohan has long stood as a steadfast ally of Gondor against the darkness of Mordor. From the golden halls of Meduseld in Edoras, its kings rule over a proud and resilient people who live by the bond of horse and rider. The Rohirrim are famed for their cavalry charges, their songs of valor, and their unwavering courage. Though the shadow of Saruman has threatened their borders, the sons and daughters of Rohan remain ever ready to answer the call to arms, defending their homeland and the free peoples of Middle-earth.">

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15112:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:566:<string id="taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc" text="{=taom_moa_t1_b_p3_desc}You read the plains of Rohan as a book. +5% party spotting range." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15114:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:608:<string id="taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc" text="{=taom_moa_t3_b_p4_desc}The finest bowmen of Rohan rally to your banner. +5 party size." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15115:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:624:<string id="taom_ew_t1_b_p2" text="{=taom_ew_t1_b_p2}Rohan Warband" />
