C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15117:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_career_strings.xml:658:<string id="taom_ew_t3_a_p4" text="{=taom_ew_t3_a_p4}Rohan's Glory" />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15142:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:171:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_isengard_5_desc}Your family were scouts and trackers, ensuring Saruman's forces moved unseen across the plains of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15168:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:275:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_1_desc}Your family served the marshals of the Riddermark, riding with them in defense of Rohan's borders. Your father was a skilled horseman and warrior." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15170:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:279:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_2_desc}Your family were traders in the great hall-city of Edoras, bringing goods from across the Riddermark and beyond to the people of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15178:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:295:<string id="taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_parent_vlandia_6_desc}Your family drifted across the Wold, the wild grasslands between Rohan and the Brown Lands. They survived by their wits and occasional service as scouts." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15180:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:419:<string id="taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_childhood_horses_desc}You felt a deep bond with animals, particularly horses. The stable hands marveled at how you could calm even the most spirited steed, and your skill in caring for wounds brought whispers that you might rival the horsemasters of Rohan one day." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15237:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:693:<string id="taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_youth_vlandia_6_text}Traveled with the camp followers of Rohan." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15263:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:957:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_isengard_5_text}Scouted the plains of Rohan for Saruman's eyes." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15289:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1063:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_1_desc}You spent your youth learning the art of mounted war in service to one of the marshals of the Riddermark, drilling with lance and sword in the wide grasslands of Rohan. Horsemanship was not taught in the Riddermark — it was breathed." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15291:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1067:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_2_desc}You carried wares and prices between the holds of Edoras and the smaller towns of Rohan, learning to read people and close a deal before the day's light faded. The plains were long and empty and the conversation at market stalls made the world go round." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15293:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1071:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_3_desc}You worked your family's pastures in the Westfold, learning to handle horses almost before you could walk, and were pressed into levy service as soon as you were tall enough for the spear. The rolling plains of western Rohan were your school." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15295:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1075:<string id="taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_education_vlandia_4_desc}You learned to shape the bright steel of Rohan in the forge-houses of Aldburg, making blades and fittings for the Rohirrim. You went home each night with arms aching and a pride in craft that no battlefield could diminish." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15325:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_cc_strings.xml:1351:<string id="taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_desc" text="{=taom_cc_taom_adulthood_isengard_6_desc}You identified the spy through behavioral inconsistency, confronted him privately, and gave him a choice that made the decision simple. He fed false information back to Edoras for two seasons before anyone in Rohan suspected. You received nothing in writing for the achievement." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:15558:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_module_strings.xml:228:<string id="str_culture_description.vlandia" text="{=taom_str_culture_description.vlandia}The Rohirrim, known as the Horse-lords, are the proud and noble people of Rohan, a realm of wide open plains and rolling hills. They are renowned for their skill as riders and their unmatched cavalry, which forms the backbone of their military strength. Living in a tightly-knit feudal society, the Rohirrim are led by a king and a loyal nobility who are bound by honor and tradition to protect their land and people. They are fiercely independent, valuing freedom above all, and their warriors are trained to fight with spears, swords, and bows, all while astride their powerful steeds." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18141:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_skill_sets.xml:1214:<!-- ROHAN wanderer skills -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18338:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:147:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_mordor_6_text}I'm a simple creature, I fight, I kill, I take what I want. Served in the raiding parties that strike fast into Gondor, Rohan, wherever the captains point us. I don't ask questions, don't play politics. Point me at the enemy, I break them. My record speaks for itself, twenty successful raids, never failed an objective." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18409:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:343:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_5_text}I led warbands against the Rohirrim, raiding their villages, burning their fields. No mercy, no hesitation, absolute results. My units left nothing alive, not warriors, not elderly, not children. Saruman wanted fear spread through Rohan, and I delivered it in rivers of blood." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18410:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:351:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_6_text}Simple existence, fight, kill, win. Led assault teams against Rohan's outlying fortresses. First through the breach every time, blade red with enemy blood. My warriors followed because I never asked them to do what I wouldn't do. Earned my position through strength, not breeding or favor." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18411:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:359:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_7_text}I commanded scouting parties into Rohan, gathering intelligence, eliminating patrols. Good at my work, effective, ruthless, reliable. But I saw how Saruman's favorites advanced while competent warriors like me stagnated. Merit alone doesn't bring promotion when the White Wizard plays favorites." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18412:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:375:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_isengard_9_text}Worked in Orthanc itself, carrying messages between Saruman and his agents. Trusted position, I saw correspondence with Mordor, with the Dunlendings, with corrupt officials throughout Rohan. Learned valuable secrets about troop movements, alliances, planned operations. Knowledge is power, and I accumulated plenty." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18415:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:457:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_erebor_9_text}I managed armed caravans to the far kingdoms, Gondor, Rohan, sometimes even the Woodland Realm. Negotiated with my tongue, fought with my axe when words failed. Profitable work, until I noticed patterns. Dark folk asking questions, movements of suspicious groups." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18416:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:481:<!-- ROHAN wanderer backstories -->
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18418:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:483:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_rohan_0_text}I was a Marshal of the Westfold, commanding a éored of riders. We patrolled from Helm's Deep to the Gap of Rohan, watching for threats from Dunland and beyond. But dark rumors came from Isengard." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18433:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:498:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_2_text}On patrol near the Gap of Rohan, we found burnt villages - not raided by orcs, but destroyed by men. The tracks led toward Isengard. When we reported this, we were told we were mistaken, that Dunlendings were to blame." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18468:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:533:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_rohan_7_text}The horses began refusing to go near the Gap of Rohan - even the bravest stallions would rear and flee. Animals sense evil before men do. When I reported this to the horse masters, they blamed bad training." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18568:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:895:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_1_text}Now I sell my sword to worthy causes. the Horse-lords of Rohan grows bolder each day, and there is no shortage of battles to fight for those with the courage to face them." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18569:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:901:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text}I served as a scout in the hills of Dunland, ranging far beyond our borders to watch for threats. I know every path through the Gap of Rohan and can track a fox through running water." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18570:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:902:<string id="backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2" text="{=aom_backstory_b.spc_wanderer_dunland_2_text}During a patrol, I discovered a plot among our own people - smugglers working with the Horse-lords of Rohan. When I reported it, I learned the smugglers had bought protection from someone powerful. I was told to forget what I'd seen." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18571:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:909:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_3_text}I trained as a healer in the hills of Dunland, learning the properties of every herb and remedy known to the Dunlendings. I tended the wounded after every skirmish with the Horse-lords of Rohan, saving countless lives." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18572:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:927:<string id="backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5" text="{=aom_backstory_c.spc_wanderer_dunland_5_text}Now I trust no one but myself, though I'd rather use my skills openly than skulk in shadows forever. the Horse-lords of Rohan has spies everywhere, and someone needs to counter them." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18573:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:933:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_6_text}I commanded forces in the hills of Dunland, studying the art of war under the clan chiefs's most experienced captains. My tactical innovations won several engagements against the Horse-lords of Rohan when we were outnumbered." />
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\codex-adversarial-wotr-momentum-2026-07-03.md:18574:C:\Users\CodexSandboxOffline\.codex\.sandbox\cwd\742debdb14bb7258\Main\_Module\ModuleData\taom_wanderer_strings.xml:949:<string id="backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8" text="{=aom_backstory_a.spc_wanderer_dunland_8_text}I served in the mounted forces of the hills of Dunland, patrolling the borders and striking fast against the Horse-lords of Rohan's raiding parties. My horsemanship was unmatched among the Dunlendings." />

C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\LESSONS-LEARNED.md:670:- **Prevent:** When authoring/revising a cultural feat: land it, add to `docs/features/cultural-feats.md`, update the faction's `factions.json` entry (perks/bonuses/weaknesses with correct `positive:` flags), ship the JSON edit in the same/back-to-back commit. For XSLT-wrapped cultures (vlandia/Rohan, empire/Dunland, sturgia/Dale, battania/Khand, aserai/Harad, khuzait/Rhûn): trace whether `spcultures.xslt` OVERRIDES or PASS-THROUGH+APPENDS `<cultural_feats>`, and for each inherited feat decompile vanilla `DefaultCulturalFeats.Initialize` for the CONCRETE text + `EffectBonus` number rather than paraphrasing (Codex caught HIGH 1/2/3 in #260 Phase 2 — `battanian_forest_speed` is "50% less speed penalty + 15% sight range in forests" not "+15% party speed"; `battanian_slower_construction` is -10% not -15%; Sturgia has no forest-speed feat). Add "which kingdom-enumerating config has no row for the new factions?" to every new-faction review.
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\LESSONS-LEARNED.md:690:- **Prevent:** when a vanilla culture is re-themed, grep ALL of tools/ for the vanilla id and re-map every hit (fixed in 12b06e47 with the full mapping table in a comment: empire=dunland, sturgia=dale, vlandia=rohan, khuzait=rhun, battania=khand). When two tools disagree on a culture mapping, the generator's `culture_id` + `taom_spcultures.xml` rename are authoritative.
C:\Users\mikew\source\repos\TAOM\docs\reviews\LESSONS-LEARNED.md:1012:- **Why missed:** Codex Review #227 (Dale culture, 2026-05-26, P1) — Dale's XSLT set 9 military attributes but missed 6 others (`militia_party_template`, `rebels_party_template`, `vassal_reward_party_template`, `settlement_patrol_template_level_1/2/3`); vanilla `spcultures.xml` declares all 6 with sturgia-prefixed values, so passthrough preserved them and Dale's new `militia_dale_template` etc. became dead code. 5 prior `/deep-review` agents missed it because they checked "what we DID is correct" not "what we DIDN'T set, was that intentional." Repeat-offender risk: Rohan (vlandia) has the same gap — `militia_rohan_template` declared but not bound.

    1: using TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem;
    2: 
    3: namespace TAOM.Features.Diplomacy;
    4: 
    5: // Single source of truth for "the kingdom the player personally RULES" — used by the two
    6: // diplomacy GameModel overrides and the alliance-proposal dialog to decide when the
    7: // player-freedom alliance rules apply. Boundary helper (touches sealed Clan/Kingdom), so it
    8: // lives alongside the entry points, not in the TaleWorlds-free service.
    9: //
   10: // CRITICAL: it requires the player to be the kingdom's RULING clan — NOT merely a member.
   11: // A vassal/mercenary player's liege kingdom is AI-ruled; granting it the player-freedom
   12: // bypass would change AI-vs-AI diplomacy (Codex review 2026-06-16, HIGH #1). The earlier
   13: // model helpers checked only Clan.PlayerClan?.Kingdom and had exactly that bug.
   14: internal static class PlayerKingdomHelper
   15: {
   16:     // The kingdom the player rules (founded / is the ruling clan of), or null when the player
   17:     // has no kingdom or is only a vassal/mercenary within someone else's realm.
   18:     public static Kingdom GetPlayerRuledKingdom()
   19:     {
   20:         var clan = Clan.PlayerClan;
   21:         var kingdom = clan?.Kingdom;
   22:         return kingdom != null && kingdom.RulingClan == clan ? kingdom : null;
   23:     }
   24: 
   25:     // True when one of the two kingdoms is the kingdom the player personally rules.
   26:     public static bool InvolvesPlayerRuledKingdom(Kingdom kingdom1, Kingdom kingdom2)
   27:     {
   28:         var playerKingdom = GetPlayerRuledKingdom();
   29:         return playerKingdom != null && (kingdom1 == playerKingdom || kingdom2 == playerKingdom);
   30:     }
   31: }

    7: public class WarOfTheRingBehavior : CampaignBehaviorBase
    8: {
    9:     private readonly IWarOfTheRingService _wotrService;
   10:     private readonly IModLogger _logger;
   11:

   13:     // every load, which means past-Phase2 saves replayed BOTH Peace→IsengardWar and IsengardWar→FullWar
   14:     // transitions on every load. Currently idempotent (AreAtWar guards), but ANY non-idempotent side
   15:     // effect added later (notifications, influence, story flags) would replay.
   16:     private int _persistedPhase = (int)WarPhase.Peace;
   17:     // WotR Momentum #327 — persisted outcome, same int-backed convention as phase.
   18:     private int _persistedOutcome = (int)WarOutcome.None;
   19: 
   20:     public WarOfTheRingBehavior(IWarOfTheRingService wotrService, IModLogger logger)
   21:     {

   23:         _logger = logger;

   25: 
   26:     public override void RegisterEvents()
   27:     {
   28:         _logger.LogInfo("[WarOfTheRing] WarOfTheRingBehavior registering events");
   29:         CampaignEvents.OnNewGameCreatedEvent.AddNonSerializedListener(this, _ =>
   30:         {
   31:             _persistedPhase = (int)WarPhase.Peace;
   32:             _persistedOutcome = (int)WarOutcome.None;
   33:         });
   34:         CampaignEvents.DailyTickEvent.AddNonSerializedListener(this, OnDailyTick);
   35:         CampaignEvents.OnSessionLaunchedEvent.AddNonSerializedListener(this, OnSessionLaunched);
   36:     }
   37: 
   38:     public override void SyncData(IDataStore dataStore)
   39:     {
   40:         // Phase 9b #129 P1 — persist phase across save-load. Stored as int (enum-backed) since
   41:         // dataStore primitives are safer than enum direct.
   42:         if (dataStore.IsSaving)
   43:         {
   44:             _persistedPhase = (int)_wotrService.CurrentPhase;
   45:             _persistedOutcome = (int)_wotrService.Outcome;
   46:         }
   47: 
   48:         dataStore.SyncData("WarOfTheRing_CurrentPhase", ref _persistedPhase);
   49:         dataStore.SyncData("WarOfTheRing_Outcome", ref _persistedOutcome);
   50: 
   51:         if (dataStore.IsLoading)
   52:         {
   53:             _wotrService.SetPhaseFromSave((WarPhase)_persistedPhase);
   54:             _wotrService.SetOutcomeFromSave((WarOutcome)_persistedOutcome);
   55:         }
   56:     }

   38:     public WarOutcome CheckAndApplyVictory(MomentumWarState state)
   39:     {
   40:         if (state == null || state.HasWarEnded || !state.HasWarStarted)
   41:             return WarOutcome.None;
   42: 
   43:         bool playerRequirementMet = !_settings.RequireParticipationForVictory
   44:                                     || _playerService.HasPlayerMetVictoryRequirement();
   45:         if (!playerRequirementMet)
   46:             return WarOutcome.None;
   47: 
   48:         float internalMomentum = state.InternalMomentum;
   49:         int threshold = _settings.VictoryThreshold;
   50: 
   51:         var outcome = WarOutcome.None;
   52:         if (internalMomentum >= threshold || state.Evil.KingdomIds.Count == 0)
   53:             outcome = WarOutcome.FreeVictory;
   54:         else if (internalMomentum <= -threshold || state.Free.KingdomIds.Count == 0)
   55:             outcome = WarOutcome.EvilVictory;
   56: 
   57:         if (outcome == WarOutcome.None)
   58:             return WarOutcome.None;
   59: 
   60:         _logger.LogInfo($"[Momentum] War of the Ring decided: {outcome} (momentum {internalMomentum:F0}, threshold {threshold})");
   61: 
   62:         // Ordering is load-bearing:
   63:         // 1. Freeze the meter — all event processing early-returns on HasWarEnded.
   64:         state.MarkWarEnded(outcome);
   65:         // 2. Phase → WarEnded lifts the three peace-block layers.
   66:         _wotrService.EndWar(outcome);
   67:         // 3. Only now can MakePeaceAction succeed.
   68:         PeaceOutCrossSidePairs(state);
   69: 
   70:         return outcome;
   71:     }
   72: 
   73:     private void PeaceOutCrossSidePairs(MomentumWarState state)
   74:     {
   75:         foreach (var freeId in state.Free.KingdomIds)
   76:         {
   77:             foreach (var evilId in state.Evil.KingdomIds)
   78:             {
   79:                 if (_allianceAdapter.AreAtWar(freeId, evilId))
   80:                 {
   81:                     _logger.LogInfo($"[Momentum] Peace: {freeId} ↔ {evilId}");
   82:                     _allianceAdapter.MakePeace(freeId, evilId);
   83:                 }
   84:             }
   85:         }
   86:     }
   87: }

   55:     {
   56:         if (state == null)
   57:             return false;
   58: 
   59:         var playerKingdomId = _playerContext.GetPlayerKingdomId();
   60:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(playerKingdomId))
   61:             return false;
   62: 
   63:         bool playerIsFree = state.Free.ContainsKingdom(playerKingdomId);
   64:         bool playerIsEvil = state.Evil.ContainsKingdom(playerKingdomId);
   65:         if (!playerIsFree && !playerIsEvil)
   66:             return false;
   67: 
   68:         // LOTRAOM parity: strict >, so an exact tie counts as Evil-stronger.
   69:         bool freeIsStronger = freeStrength > evilStrength;
   70:         return (playerIsFree && freeIsStronger) || (playerIsEvil && !freeIsStronger);
   71:     }
   72: }

  162:     {
  163:         // Key tail: {ActionType}.{index}
  164:         var tail = key.Substring(eventPrefix.Length);
  165:         var dot = tail.IndexOf('.');
  166:         var typeName = dot >= 0 ? tail.Substring(0, dot) : tail;
  167: 
  168:         if (!TryParseDefinedEnum<MomentumActionType>(typeName, out var type))
  169:         {

  171:             return null;

  173: 
  174:         var parts = value.Split(new[] { '|' }, 3);
  175:         if (parts.Length != 3
  176:             || !int.TryParse(parts[0], NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var eventValue)
  177:             || !double.TryParse(parts[1], NumberStyles.Float, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var endHours)
  178:             || double.IsNaN(endHours) || double.IsInfinity(endHours))
  179:         {
  180:             _logger.LogWarning($"MomentumStateStore: malformed event '{key}'='{value}' skipped");
  181:             return null;
  182:         }
  183: 
  184:         return new MomentumEvent(eventValue, parts[2], type, endHours);
  185:     }

  155:           WarOfTheRingBehavior
  156:           (DailyTick — uses CampaignStartTime)
  157: ```
  158: 
  159: ### Stateless Design
  160: 
  161: The WotR system stores **no save data**. Each campaign tick:
  162: 1. Calculates elapsed campaign days via `CampaignStartTime.ElapsedDaysUntilNow` (engine-provided, survives save/load)
  163: 2. Compares against phase thresholds (from MCM or JSON config)
  164: 3. Declares wars only for pairs not already at war (`AreAtWar` guard)
  165: 4. Peace blocking checks elapsed time in real-time
  166: 
  167: The behavior uses the engine's built-in `Campaign.Current.Models.CampaignTimeModel.CampaignStartTime.ElapsedDaysUntilNow` — the same pattern vanilla uses internally. This is computed from the persisted `MapTimeTracker` ticks and the deterministic campaign start constant. No custom `SyncData` serialization is needed, avoiding any save/load performance impact.
  168: 
  169: Benefits: MCM config changes take effect immediately on next tick. No save migration needed. Phase state is reconstructed from elapsed time on every tick, so save/load is seamless.
  170: 
  180: | File | Purpose |
  181: |------|---------|
  182: | `Main/Features/Diplomacy/Models/WarPhase.cs` | Phase enum (Peace/IsengardWar/FullWar) |
  183: | `Main/Features/Diplomacy/Models/WarOfTheRingConfig.cs` | Config data models |
  184: | `Main/Features/Diplomacy/Models/TaomDiplomacyModel.cs` | GameModel — IsAtConstantWar override |

    1: using TAOM.Features.Diplomacy.Models;
    2: 
    3: namespace TAOM.Features.WarOfTheRingMomentum.Domain;
    4: 
    5: /// <summary>
    6: /// Whole-war momentum state: both sides + lifecycle flags. Pure math — the tanh
    7: /// soft-cap and the ×100 scale live here. LOTRAOM parity source: WarOfTheRingData
    8: /// (minus its FactionManager/Inquiry side effects, which move to the victory service
    9: /// and behavior).
   10: /// </summary>
   11: public class MomentumWarState
   12: {
   13:     /// <summary>Internal momentum ints are stored ×100 for battle-scaling precision.</summary>
   14:     public const int MomentumScale = 100;
   15: 
   16:     public MomentumSideData Free { get; } = new();
   17:     public MomentumSideData Evil { get; } = new();
   18: 
   19:     public bool HasWarStarted { get; private set; }
   20:     public bool HasWarEnded { get; private set; }
   21:     public WarOutcome Victor { get; private set; } = WarOutcome.None;
   22: 
   23:     /// <summary>Signed momentum: positive = Free ahead, negative = Evil ahead.</summary>
   24:     public float InternalMomentum => (Free.SideMomentum - Evil.SideMomentum) / (float)MomentumScale;
   25: 
   26:     public MomentumSideData GetSide(MomentumSide side)
   27:     {
   28:         return side == MomentumSide.Free ? Free : Evil;
   29:     }
   30: 
   31:     public bool DoesKingdomTakePart(string kingdomId)
   32:     {
   33:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(kingdomId))
   34:             return false;
   35:         return Free.ContainsKingdom(kingdomId) || Evil.ContainsKingdom(kingdomId);
   36:     }
   37: 
   38:     public void MarkWarStarted()
   39:     {
   40:         HasWarStarted = true;
   41:     }
   42: 
   43:     /// <summary>Terminal: first non-None victor wins; later calls no-op.</summary>
   44:     public void MarkWarEnded(WarOutcome victor)
   45:     {
   46:         if (victor == WarOutcome.None) return;
   47:         if (Victor != WarOutcome.None) return;
   48: 
   49:         Victor = victor;
   50:         HasWarEnded = true;
   51:     }
   52: 
   53:     /// <summary>Save-load rehydration only.</summary>
   54:     public void RestoreFlags(bool warStarted, bool warEnded, WarOutcome victor)
   55:     {
   56:         HasWarStarted = warStarted;
   57:         HasWarEnded = warEnded;
   58:         Victor = victor;
   59:     }
   60: }

    1: # RCA — War of the Ring Momentum port (#327), deep-review 2026-07-03
    2: 
    3: Port of LOTRAOM's "Momentum" system to TAOM 1.4.6 (commits 0ea7e28d / 3408c2d9 / 5413d476 on `feature/wotr-momentum`). Five-agent `/deep-review` after the three feature commits. All six confirmed findings fixed in-session; three items accepted-with-note (donor parity / self-consistent design). No HIGH deferred.
    4: 
    5: ## Findings
    6: 
    7: | # | Sev | Bug | Category | Why missed | Preventive action |
    8: |---|-----|-----|----------|------------|-------------------|
    9: | 1 | HIGH | Popup registered `GenericCampaignPanelsGameKeyCategory` (window-toggle keys only) but queried `IsHotKeyReleased("Exit")` — the "Exit" key lives in `GenericPanelGameKeyCategory` (singular). Escape-close silently never fired. | Bannerlord API | Ported the category string verbatim from LOTRAOM's `MomentumInterface`, which was close-button-only — the Escape poll is NEW port code, so the donor never exercised the "Exit" key against that category. Two similarly-named categories; the wrong one binds without error. | LESSONS-LEARNED (Localization & UI): "a hotkey-category string is only correct against the specific key you query — verify the queried key id exists in the registered category." TAOM precedent `GauntletFiefManagementScreen` uses the correct pair. |
   10: | 2 | HIGH | `MomentumEnabled` master toggle couldn't retract an already-shown map meter: the only `RemoveMapMeter()` caller (`RefreshMapMeter`) sat *after* `OnDailyTick`'s `if (!MomentumEnabled) return`, and the item VM's `IsIndicatorVisible` never folded the master toggle. | GameModel/UI toggle fold | Same class as CombatMechanics 2026-07-02 (`GetHorseChargePenetration` unfolded). The retract path existed but was unreachable behind the very guard the toggle trips; the visibility poll checked `ShowMapMeter` but not `MomentumEnabled`. | Fixed: `RefreshMapMeter()` runs before the enabled-guard; `IsIndicatorVisible` folds `MomentumEnabled`. LESSONS-LEARNED (GameModels & Services) already has the master-toggle-fold rule; this is a UI-layer instance — extend the mental model to "the code path that DISABLES must not sit behind the disable guard." |
   11: | 3 | MED | `MomentumIndicatorMapView.OnFinalize` removed the layer without `ResetInputRestrictions()` (paired with the `SetInputRestrictions` in `CreateLayout`). | Standards (gui-ui) | Followed LOTRAOM's teardown verbatim; the donor's `GauntletView.OnFinalize` also omitted it (1.2.x was more forgiving). The gui-ui rule pairs Set/Reset. | Fixed. Rule already exists in `gui-ui.md` "Custom GauntletLayer Input Wiring"; port-from-donor didn't re-audit teardown against it. |
   12: | 4 | MED | `KingdomStrengthAdapter.GetTotalStrength` + `MomentumPopupVM.ResolveKingdom` used `Kingdom.All.FirstOrDefault` linear scan; strength adapter is called per enrolled kingdom inside per-battle / daily strength scoring (O(kingdoms²) per event). | Efficiency | Copied the existing TAOM idiom (`AllianceAdapter`, `KingdomBannerAdapter`, `SiegeDefenseService` all use `Kingdom.All.FirstOrDefault`) — an established but suboptimal pattern for hot-ish paths. | Fixed via `MBObjectManager.Instance.GetObject<Kingdom>(id)` hash lookup. Not per-frame/per-hit, so severity is really MED not HIGH; other TAOM adapters share the pattern but on cold paths. |
   13: | 5 | LOW | `Enum.GetValues(typeof(MomentumActionType))` allocated an array per popup rebuild. | Efficiency (GC) | Popup-open-only; trivial. | Fixed: cached `static readonly` array. |
   14: | 6 | MED | Elimination-victory path (`OnKingdomDestroyed`) didn't call `RefreshMapMeter()`, so after a side is wiped out the meter's MapView stayed registered (hidden only by the 1s poll) instead of being removed — unlike the daily-tick victory path. | Data flow (lifecycle) | The two victory entry points (daily tick, kingdom-destroyed) diverged: only one carried the meter-removal call. Parallel-path inconsistency. | Fixed: added `RefreshMapMeter()` to the elimination branch. |
   15: | 7 | — | Dead `softCapDivisor` config + `DisplayMomentum` query property + `GetDisplayMomentum` tanh domain method — zero consumers (slider uses linear `SliderValue`, popup uses raw `InternalMomentum`). | Simplicity / dead code | Ported the donor's tanh soft-cap faithfully, but the donor never wired it into its UI either (its slider + popup used the same linear/raw values the port does). Carried forward as dead-with-validation-and-tests. | Deleted per `simplicity-criterion.md` (dead code that holds parity → remove): config field + validation + domain method + query property + 8 tests. |
   16: 
   17: ## Root-cause pattern: faithful-port re-audit gap
   18: 
   19: Findings 1, 3, and 7 share one root: **a faithful port inherits the donor's latent defects and dead code.** LOTRAOM's `MomentumInterface` was close-button-only (so its wrong hotkey category never mattered), its `GauntletView.OnFinalize` skipped `ResetInputRestrictions` (1.2.x tolerated it), and its tanh soft-cap was UI-dead. Porting verbatim carried all three into 1.4.6 where #1 and #3 became real defects. This mirrors `feedback_native_port_hot_path_audit.md` (C++ ports inherit unaudited logging) — "the donor worked" does not mean "the port is fit to ship." The `/deep-review` agents caught all three because they audit against TAOM's *current* rules, not the donor's behavior — which is exactly their value on a port.
   20: 
   21: Finding 2 is a fresh instance of the master-toggle-fold class (GameModels & Services in LESSONS-LEARNED), first seen in CombatMechanics 2026-07-02 — here in the UI layer, where the disable path sat behind the disable guard.
   22: 
   23: ## Why each agent's result
   24: 
   25: - **Standards** caught #3 (its gui-ui GauntletLayer-input rule fired). Did not catch #1 (a hotkey *string* is a runtime binding, not a standards check) or #2 (routing/reachability, not a standards rule).
   26: - **Compatibility** caught #1 — it decompiled the two categories and confirmed "Exit" is absent from the registered one. This is the API agent's core competency (a silent-never-fires binding).
   27: - **Efficiency** caught #4 and #5.
   28: - **Completeness** confirmed 150→142 tests, IoC, localization — no functional finding (correct; nothing missing except the feature doc, written at close).
   29: - **Data flow** caught #2, #6, and #7 (the dead `softCapDivisor` trace) — the highest-value agent again, per the skill's own note that every prior HIGH in this project was a data-flow gap.
   30: 
   31: ## Accepted, documented (not bugs)
   32: 
   33: - **Raid / army-gathered don't apply the participation multiplier or victory-gate credit.** Donor parity — LOTRAOM applied both only to battles and sieges. Documented inline on `RaidOutcomeSnapshot` / `ArmyGatheredSnapshot` (the missing DTO field read as an oversight to the agent precisely because it lacked the comment other deliberate deviations carry).
   34: - **Popup "Total:" (positive = Free ahead) vs map slider (positive = Evil ahead) use opposite sign conventions.** Each is self-consistent within its own layout (the popup puts Gondor on the left, so positive-total = left-ahead matches; the slider fills rightward toward Mordor). No number is shown on the slider, so the two are never numerically contradictory on screen. Left as-is.
   35: - **Same-day FullWar-trigger race:** a battle resolving earlier in the campaign day than the daily enrollment sweep is dropped (war "starts" that tick). Genuine one-tick edge, accepted low-severity.
   36: - **Popup-rebuild allocations (`.ToList()` in `FillSplit`, per-side LINQ):** popup-open-only, imperceptible; not worth the churn per `simplicity-criterion.md`.
   37: 
   38: ## LESSONS-LEARNED entries appended
   39: 
   40: - Localization & UI: hotkey-category / queried-key verification on ported UI.
   41: - GameModels & Services: master-toggle fold extends to "the disable code path must not sit behind the disable guard" (UI-layer instance).

**VANILLA CODE**

Decompiled 1.4.6 evidence used:

- `MakePeaceAction.cs:17,20,34,37-39` -- `Apply(IFaction, IFaction)` routes to `ApplyInternal`; `ApplyInternal` calls `FactionManager.SetNeutral(...)`, then raises `OnMakePeace(...)`.
- `CampaignEvents.cs:195,753,1828-1830` -- `MakePeace` is its own event, separate from `KingdomDestroyedEvent`.
- `CampaignBehaviorDataStore.cs:33-38` -- load-side `SyncData` returns `false` when a key is missing; it does not throw and does not overwrite the ref.
- `MapEventSide.cs:55,667,677,690` -- `TroopCasualties` is an `int` troop count incremented per killed/routed troop.
- `Kingdom.cs:221-231` -- `CurrentTotalStrength` is current clan strength sum, not battle-start strength.
- `KingdomManager.cs:126` and `ChangeKingdomAction.cs:65` -- player-created kingdoms get ids from `new_kingdom` and then become `Clan.Kingdom`.
- `MBObjectManager.cs:573` -- `public T GetObject<T>(string objectName) where T : MBObjectBase`.

**Known Suspects**

1. CONFIRMED-PARTIAL -- battle momentum is uncapped. `MomentumEventService.cs:178-179` uses `casualties / loserSideStrength * MaxBattleMomentum * 100` with no `Math.Min`, while `MomentumConfig.cs:28-29` says it is capped. I do not have evidence for realistic `int` overflow with shipped config, but `casualties / current strength > 1` is possible because casualties are a troop count and denominator is post-battle current kingdom strength.

2. DISPUTED -- victory ordering/re-entrancy. `MomentumVictoryService.cs:64-68` marks momentum ended before `EndWar` and `MakePeace`; all momentum event processors early-return on `state.HasWarEnded` at `MomentumEventService.cs:45,84,107,124,137`. Vanilla `MakePeaceAction` raises `MakePeace`, not `KingdomDestroyed`, and grep found no momentum `CampaignEvents.MakePeace` listener.

3. DISPUTED -- save compatibility and delimiter round-trip. Missing new `WarOfTheRing_Outcome` is safe because vanilla `SyncData` returns false on missing keys; `WarOfTheRingBehavior.cs:48-54` then leaves the default `None`. Event descriptions are split with limit 3 at `MomentumStateStore.cs:174`, and pipe-in-description is tested at `MomentumStateStoreTests.cs:103-111`. Comma splitting is only for kingdom ids/player enum names at `MomentumStateStore.cs:56,67,209-213`, not arbitrary hero/faction display names.

4. CONFIRMED-PARTIAL -- shipped kingdom alignment is coherent, but player-founded kingdoms are not. `alignment.json` covers every shipped live kingdom id, with `shaghana`, `abanissa`, and `umbar` neutral at lines 19-21. A player-created `new_kingdom*` id is not in that file, so `AlignmentService.cs:36-41` returns Neutral and `MomentumEnrollmentService.cs:42-58` never enrolls it.

5. DISPUTED for the meter add path. Grep found the only `AddMapMeter` call at `WarOfTheRingMomentumBehavior.cs:137`, behind `wantMeter = MomentumEnabled && HasWarStarted && !HasWarEnded` at line 134. `OnGameLoadFinished` calls `RefreshMapMeter` at line 72, so disabled state removes/no-ops instead of adding.

6. CONFIRMED-PARTIAL -- empty/no-kingdom is handled, but player-founded kingdom side detection fails for the same reason as suspect 4. `PlayerMomentumService.cs:59-66` returns false for empty or non-enrolled ids. There is no cached stale id; `PlayerContextAdapter.cs:7` reads current `Clan.PlayerClan?.Kingdom?.StringId` per call.

**DEEP ANALYSIS**

Scenario trace: new game resets momentum state at `WarOfTheRingMomentumBehavior.cs:63`. On day 14, `SubModule.cs:484,487` registers WotR before Momentum, so WotR can enter `FullWar` first; Momentum then sweeps enrollment at `WarOfTheRingMomentumBehavior.cs:110-112` and `MomentumEnrollmentService.cs:37-67`, starts tracking, and adds the meter through `RefreshMapMeter`.

Three Evil sieges while player-uninvolved add Evil momentum but no player victory credit by design. Save/reload is coherent: WotR phase/outcome load via `WarOfTheRingBehavior.cs:48-54`, momentum loads via `_taom_wotr_momentum` at `WarOfTheRingMomentumBehavior.cs:75-83`, and the meter is added only after `OnGameLoadFinished`.

Two player-involved battles are not enough for shipped victory gating: `momentum.json:19,21` requires participation and minimum 5 player events, enforced at `MomentumVictoryService.cs:43-46`. So “Evil hits threshold -> victory inquiry” only occurs if prior player events already exist or MCM lowers/disables the gate. If the player is in a shipped enrolled kingdom, victory then freezes state, ends WotR phase, peaces cross-side pairs, removes the meter, and reload remains coherent. If the player founded `new_kingdom*`, battle/siege participation from that kingdom is not enrolled/credited, and the victory gate can remain blocked.

**CONFIG CROSS-REFERENCE**

No `rohan` or `dol_guldur` kingdom-id typo found in the momentum/alignment special cases. Popup leaders are valid: `MomentumPopupVM.cs:21-22` uses `empire_w` and `empire_s`, which exist in `spkingdoms.xslt:45,77` and `alignment.json:2,12`.

Every shipped kingdom id is represented: vanilla-overridden ids in `spkingdoms.xslt:13,45,77,109,137,165,193,221`; custom ids in `taom_spkingdoms.xml:5,92,178,265,352,443,534,625,716,811,910,1014,1118,1222`; alignment rows in `alignment.json:2-25`. `gondor` and `mordor` at `alignment.json:3-4` are culture aliases, not kingdom typos.

Fix: for player-ruled dynamic kingdoms, derive side from kingdom culture via `GetCultureSide`, or add an explicit player-kingdom enrollment rule with tests.

Scenario: loser current side strength 100, casualties 500, max 300 -> 1500 internal momentum instead of capped 300. Fix: clamp ratio to `<= 1f` before multiplying and add a regression test.

[MED] Main/Features/WarOfTheRingMomentum/WarOfTheRingMomentumBehavior.cs:196 -- Toggle/lifecycle reconciliation -- If Momentum is disabled when a kingdom is destroyed, `OnKingdomDestroyed` returns before removing it. Re-enable later: `SweepEnrollment` only adds non-eliminated kingdoms and never removes stale ids, so a wiped side can still have `KingdomIds.Count > 0`, blocking elimination victory at `MomentumVictoryService.cs:52-55`. Fix: reconcile enrolled lists against live non-eliminated kingdoms on sweep/load, or process kingdom removal even while disabled.

- `CampaignEvents.cs:195,753,1828-1830` -- `MakePeace` is its own event, separate from `KingdomDestroyedEvent`.
- `CampaignBehaviorDataStore.cs:33-38` -- load-side `SyncData` returns `false` when a key is missing; it does not throw and does not overwrite the ref.
- `MapEventSide.cs:55,667,677,690` -- `TroopCasualties` is an `int` troop count incremented per killed/routed troop.
- `Kingdom.cs:221-231` -- `CurrentTotalStrength` is current clan strength sum, not battle-start strength.
- `KingdomManager.cs:126` and `ChangeKingdomAction.cs:65` -- player-created kingdoms get ids from `new_kingdom` and then become `Clan.Kingdom`.
- `MBObjectManager.cs:573` -- `public T GetObject<T>(string objectName) where T : MBObjectBase`.

1. CONFIRMED-PARTIAL -- battle momentum is uncapped. `MomentumEventService.cs:178-179` uses `casualties / loserSideStrength * MaxBattleMomentum * 100` with no `Math.Min`, while `MomentumConfig.cs:28-29` says it is capped. I do not have evidence for realistic `int` overflow with shipped config, but `casualties / current strength > 1` is possible because casualties are a troop count and denominator is post-battle current kingdom strength.

2. DISPUTED -- victory ordering/re-entrancy. `MomentumVictoryService.cs:64-68` marks momentum ended before `EndWar` and `MakePeace`; all momentum event processors early-return on `state.HasWarEnded` at `MomentumEventService.cs:45,84,107,124,137`. Vanilla `MakePeaceAction` raises `MakePeace`, not `KingdomDestroyed`, and grep found no momentum `CampaignEvents.MakePeace` listener.

3. DISPUTED -- save compatibility and delimiter round-trip. Missing new `WarOfTheRing_Outcome` is safe because vanilla `SyncData` returns false on missing keys; `WarOfTheRingBehavior.cs:48-54` then leaves the default `None`. Event descriptions are split with limit 3 at `MomentumStateStore.cs:174`, and pipe-in-description is tested at `MomentumStateStoreTests.cs:103-111`. Comma splitting is only for kingdom ids/player enum names at `MomentumStateStore.cs:56,67,209-213`, not arbitrary hero/faction display names.

4. CONFIRMED-PARTIAL -- shipped kingdom alignment is coherent, but player-founded kingdoms are not. `alignment.json` covers every shipped live kingdom id, with `shaghana`, `abanissa`, and `umbar` neutral at lines 19-21. A player-created `new_kingdom*` id is not in that file, so `AlignmentService.cs:36-41` returns Neutral and `MomentumEnrollmentService.cs:42-58` never enrolls it.

5. DISPUTED for the meter add path. Grep found the only `AddMapMeter` call at `WarOfTheRingMomentumBehavior.cs:137`, behind `wantMeter = MomentumEnabled && HasWarStarted && !HasWarEnded` at line 134. `OnGameLoadFinished` calls `RefreshMapMeter` at line 72, so disabled state removes/no-ops instead of adding.

6. CONFIRMED-PARTIAL -- empty/no-kingdom is handled, but player-founded kingdom side detection fails for the same reason as suspect 4. `PlayerMomentumService.cs:59-66` returns false for empty or non-enrolled ids. There is no cached stale id; `PlayerContextAdapter.cs:7` reads current `Clan.PlayerClan?.Kingdom?.StringId` per call.
